拟一维 Euler 方程的离散伴随：格点格式

Discrete adjoints for quasi-one-dimensional Euler: node-centred

在 Burgers 的基础上，加入密度、动量、能量以及变截面积源项。本页先介绍方程组和它的作用，再从光滑亚声速流道出发，逐步学习一阶／二阶重构、守恒残差、matrix-free 前向与伴随、GS 及 GMRES 求解，最后用差分、复数步长和独立连续伴随检验设计梯度。读者只需具备微积分、线性代数与基础数值方法知识。

Extend Burgers to density, momentum, energy and variable-area source terms. After introducing the equations and what they are for, start with smooth subsonic duct flow and build first/second-order reconstruction, conservative residuals, matrix-free tangent and adjoint operators, and GS/GMRES solvers. Verify design gradients using finite differences, complex step and an independent continuous adjoint. Calculus, linear algebra and introductory numerical methods are the prerequisites.

阅读范围：教学主线与研究性选读

Reading scope: core teaching and optional research

本项目以离散伴随教学为主。第 1–15、17–18 节构成从残差、tangent、adjoint 到梯度验证与线性求解的主线；第 16 节先了解“离散导数正确”与“连续极限正确”的区别即可。附录 A、C 是连续参考与直接法的进阶教学，附录 B 的守恒离散、链式求导和固定网格验证也是进阶教学。

The teaching core is Sections 1–15 and 17–18: residuals, tangents, adjoints, gradient checks and linear solves. In Section 16, first distinguish correct discrete derivatives from a correct continuum limit. Appendices A and C teach continuous references and direct solves; conservation, chain-rule differentiation and fixed-grid checks in Appendix B are also advanced teaching.

以下标记只表示超出首次学习的研究性分析范围，不表示首次提出、学术空白或已经证明的新结论。可以跳过这些分析而完整学习离散伴随。附录 D.1 的分支切换、D.2 的链式法则是已知概念；研究性部分是把特定数值观察推广为收敛规律。

The labels identify analysis beyond a first course, not novelty, a literature gap or a newly proved result. These parts can be skipped without missing the discrete-adjoint method. Branch switching in D.1 and the chain rule in D.2 are established concepts; generalising particular observations into convergence laws is the research-oriented part.

第 1 节Section 1

方程：定常拟一维 Euler 方程组

The equations: steady quasi-one-dimensional Euler

从守恒律到定常方程组

From conservation laws to the steady system

Burgers 方程只有一个守恒量；本页换成可压缩气体的三个守恒量 U=(ρ,m,e)TU=(\rho,m,e)^T，即单位体积的质量、动量和总能量。考虑一条截面积 A(x)A(x) 沿轴线缓慢变化的流道，假设流动在每个截面上近似均匀、只随 xx 变化。流道中一段 [a,b][a,b] 里的总量 ∫abAU dx\int_a^bAU\,dx，只因两端截面上的通量 AF(U)AF(U) 而改变；动量还多一项：截面积变化的地方，壁面压力在单位长度上有沿轴线的分力 A′pA'p。写成微分形式，就是

The Burgers equation has one conserved quantity; this page has the three of a compressible gas, U=(ρ,m,e)TU=(\rho,m,e)^T: mass, momentum and total energy per unit volume. Consider a duct whose cross-section A(x)A(x) varies slowly along its axis, and assume that the flow is nearly uniform over each cross-section and varies only with xx. The amount ∫abAU dx\int_a^bAU\,dx in a piece [a,b][a,b] of the duct changes only through the fluxes AF(U)AF(U) across its two end sections; momentum has one more term: where the area changes, the wall pressure has an axial component A′pA'p per unit length. In differential form,

∂t(AU)+∂x(AF(U))=A′p(U)e2,F=[mm2/ρ+p(e+p)m/ρ],e2=(0,1,0)T.\partial_t(AU)+\partial_x(AF(U))=A'p(U)e_2,\quad F=\begin{bmatrix}m\\m^2/\rho+p\\(e+p)m/\rho\end{bmatrix},\quad e_2=(0,1,0)^T.

理想气体取 γ=1.4、气体常数 R=1。m=ρu 是动量密度，e 是总能量密度，不能把 e 当作单位质量能量。先从 U 恢复压力、速度和声速，再计算通量。

Use an ideal gas with γ=1.4 and gas constant R=1. Momentum density is m=ρu; e is total energy per unit volume, not per unit mass. Recover pressure, velocity and sound speed before evaluating flux.

u=m/ρ,p=(γ−1)(e−m2/(2ρ)),c=γp/ρ,T=p/ρ.u=m/\rho,\quad p=(\gamma-1)(e-m^2/(2\rho)),\quad c=\sqrt{\gamma p/\rho},\quad T=p/\rho.

这里的“拟一维”并非忽略横截面：截面积同时乘在面通量上，并通过壁面压力源项进入动量方程。本页只研究定常解。令时间导数为零，得到要在 [0,1][0,1] 上离散的方程组：

Quasi-one-dimensional flow retains cross-section effects through both area-weighted flux and the wall-pressure momentum source. This page studies steady solutions only. Setting the time derivative to zero gives the system to be discretised on [0,1][0,1]:

ddx(A F(U))=A′ p e2,x∈[0,1].\frac{d}{dx}\bigl(A\,F(U)\bigr)=A'\,p\,e_2,\qquad x\in[0,1].

入口 x=0x=0 给定总压 p₀ 和总温 T₀，出口 x=1x=1 给定静压 pbp_b；下一小节说明为什么是这三个量。我们研究光滑的亚声速解：处处 u>0u>0，马赫数 M=u/c<1M=u/c<1。本例不含激波，所以第 3 节的二阶重构不使用限制器；间断和激波留到附录 B。

The inlet x=0x=0 takes the total pressure p₀ and the total temperature T₀, the outlet x=1x=1 the static pressure pbp_b; the next subsection explains why these three. We study smooth subsonic solutions: u>0u>0 everywhere and the Mach number M=u/c<1M=u/c<1. This example has no shocks, so the second-order reconstruction of Section 3 uses no limiter; discontinuities and shocks are left to Appendix B.

图 1把这个问题画在一张图上（当前设计；离散解取页首默认的 N=12N=12、二阶）。上：流道，高度与截面积 A(x)A(x) 成正比，两端标出边界数据；13 个圆点是作为设计变量的节点截面积。中：马赫数 M(x)M(x)，实线是等熵精确解，圆点是本页算出的离散解（第 2 节起讲怎样算）；全流道都在声速线 M=1M=1 之下，喉部 x=0.5x=0.5 流速最快。下：压力 p(x)p(x)，喉部最低，出口回到 pbp_b；虚线是第 7 节反设计的目标压力 p⋆p^\star。圆点与实线的差别是离散误差，第 15 节测量它怎样随网格加密而减小。

Figure 1 draws the whole problem (the current design; the discrete solution at the defaults at the top of the page, N=12N=12 and second order). Top: the duct, drawn with height proportional to the area A(x)A(x), with the boundary data at its two ends; the 13 dots are the nodal areas that serve as design variables. Middle: the Mach number M(x)M(x); the solid curve is the exact isentropic solution and the dots are the discrete solution this page computes (Section 2 onwards shows how); the whole duct stays below the sonic line M=1M=1, and the flow is fastest at the throat x=0.5x=0.5. Bottom: the pressure p(x)p(x), lowest at the throat and back to pbp_b at the outlet; the dashed line is the target pressure p⋆p^\star of the inverse design of Section 7. The gap between the dots and the solid curves is the discretisation error, which Section 15 measures under mesh refinement.

特征速度：每一端给几个条件

Characteristic speeds: how many conditions each end takes

Burgers 方程只有一个波速 F′(u)=uF'(u)=u。这里的通量 Jacobian ∂F/∂U\partial F/\partial U 是 3×3 矩阵（附录 A.1 写出它），它的三个特征值 u−cu-c、uu、u+cu+c 是三族小扰动沿 xx 的传播速度，称为特征速度：u+cu+c 与 u−cu-c 是相对气流以声速向前、向后传播的声波，uu 是随气流一起运动的扰动（熵波）。在亚声速正向流动中，向后的声波逆流而上：

The Burgers equation has the single wave speed F′(u)=uF'(u)=u. Here the flux Jacobian ∂F/∂U\partial F/\partial U is a 3×3 matrix (Appendix A.1 writes it out), and its three eigenvalues u−cu-c, uu and u+cu+c are the speeds at which three families of small disturbances travel along xx, the characteristic speeds: u+cu+c and u−cu-c are sound waves travelling forward and backward relative to the gas at the speed of sound, and uu is a disturbance carried with the gas (the entropy wave). In positive subsonic flow the backward sound wave moves upstream:

u−c<0<u<u+c.u-c<0<u<u+c.

每一端要给的条件数，等于在这一端进入计算域的特征族数。入口 x=0x=0 处 uu 与 u+cu+c 两族进入，给两个条件：总压 p₀ 和总温 T₀，相当于上游接着一个静止的储气罐；第三族 u−cu-c 在这里离开计算域，它携带的信息由内部决定。出口 x=1x=1 处只有 u−cu-c 一族从外部进入，给一个条件：静压 pbp_b。多给会过约束，少给则解不唯一。出口压力正是沿 u−cu-c 这一族逆流传到整个流道，所以在给定 p₀、T₀ 时，pbp_b 决定流量。第 4 节说明离散格式怎样施加这三个条件；伴随沿同样的特征反向传播，两端的条件数正好对调（附录 A 的图 A.1）。

Each end takes as many conditions as characteristic families enter the domain there. At the inlet x=0x=0 the families uu and u+cu+c enter, so the inlet takes two conditions, the total pressure p₀ and the total temperature T₀, as if a reservoir at rest were attached upstream; the third family, u−cu-c, leaves the domain there and carries information set by the interior. At the outlet x=1x=1 only u−cu-c enters from outside, so the outlet takes one condition, the static pressure pbp_b. More conditions would overconstrain the problem; fewer would leave the solution undetermined. The outlet pressure travels upstream along the family u−cu-c through the whole duct, which is why, for given p₀ and T₀, pbp_b sets the mass flow. Section 4 shows how the discretisation imposes the three conditions; the adjoint travels along the same characteristics in reverse, so the counts at the two ends swap (Figure A.1 in Appendix A).

图 2用同样的解画出三个特征速度。u+cu+c 和 uu 处处为正，u−cu-c 处处为负，所以入口有两族进入、出口有一族进入，与边界数据的个数一致。喉部 uu 最大，u−cu-c 最接近零（u−c≈−0.40u-c\approx{-0.40}），但仍为负：气流没有达到声速。若把出口压力降得足够低，喉部会达到声速（u−c=0u-c=0），流道壅塞，扩张段可能出现超声速流和激波；附录 B.5 另取一个喷管研究这种流动。

Figure 2 plots the three characteristic speeds of the same solutions. u+cu+c and uu are positive everywhere and u−cu-c is negative everywhere, so two families enter at the inlet and one at the outlet, as many as the boundary data. At the throat uu is largest and u−cu-c comes closest to zero (u−c≈−0.40u-c\approx{-0.40}), but it stays negative: the flow does not reach the speed of sound. If the outlet pressure is lowered far enough, the throat reaches sonic speed (u−c=0u-c=0), the duct chokes, and supersonic flow and a shock can appear in the diverging part; Appendix B.5 studies such a flow in a separate nozzle.

本页的问题：流道、边界数据与设计变量

The problem on this page: the duct, the boundary data and the design variables

流道长度无量纲化为 1。截面积取 A(x)=1−d sin⁡2(πx)A(x)=1-d\,\sin^2(\pi x)，默认收缩深度 d=0.3d=0.3：两端截面积为 1，喉部 x=0.5x=0.5 处为 0.7，先收缩、后扩张。边界数据默认为 p₀ = 1、T₀ = 1、pbp_b = 0.9（无量纲，气体常数 R=1）。离散时，截面积在 NN 个等长区间的端点 xk=k/Nx_k=k/N 上取值 Ak=A(xk)A_k=A(x_k)，其间线性插值（第 2 节的网格）；这 N+1N+1 个节点截面积与三个边界数据一起构成设计变量 DD，改变它们就改变流场：

The duct length is scaled to 1. The area is A(x)=1−d sin⁡2(πx)A(x)=1-d\,\sin^2(\pi x) with the default contraction depth d=0.3d=0.3: both ends have area 1 and the throat x=0.5x=0.5 has 0.7; the duct first contracts, then expands. The default boundary data are p₀ = 1, T₀ = 1 and pbp_b = 0.9 (nondimensional, gas constant R=1). In the discretisation the area takes the values Ak=A(xk)A_k=A(x_k) at the ends xk=k/Nx_k=k/N of NN equal intervals and is linear in between (the mesh of Section 2); these N+1N+1 nodal areas and the three boundary data form the design variables DD; changing them changes the flow:

D=(A0,…,AN, pb, p0, T0).D=(A_0,\ldots,A_N,\,p_b,\,p_0,\,T_0).

按伴随优化文献的通常写法，设计变量记作 DD。默认 N=12N=12 时，DD 共有 16 个分量：13 个截面积和 3 个边界数据。

As is usual in the adjoint-optimization literature, the design variables are written DD. With the default N=12N=12, DD has 16 components: 13 areas and 3 boundary data.

顶部参数改变当前光滑亚声速问题。面积 A(x)=1−d sin²(πx)；参考目标面积固定为 (1−0.3sin²πx)(1−0.04sinπx)，使用本次选定的边界数据生成后冻结。主求解器要求正密度、正压力且所有检查状态 M<0.95；失败时不会显示上一次结果。第 15、16 节加密表仍是固定默认参数的离线基准。

Top controls change the current smooth subsonic problem. Area is A(x)=1−d sin²(πx). The target area remains (1−0.3sin²πx)(1−0.04sinπx); its flow uses the selected boundary data and is then frozen. The primal requires positive density and pressure and M<0.95 at all checked states. Failed runs clear previous results. Sections 15–16 retain offline refinement data for the default parameters.

当前数据下全流道都是亚声速，定常解由等熵关系确定，不需要网格。没有激波、摩擦和传热时，总压、总温和流量 qm=ρuAq_m=\rho uA 沿流道不变。出口静压与总压之比给出出口马赫数 Me≈0.39M_e\approx0.39；流量不变又给出每个截面的马赫数（面积—马赫数关系）：截面越小，亚声速气流越快、压力越低。喉部 M≈0.65M\approx0.65、p≈0.75p\approx0.75，是全流道流速最快、压力最低的地方。第 15 节用这个等熵解作为精确参考，附录 A 在它上面积分连续伴随。

With the current data the flow is subsonic throughout, and the steady solution follows from the isentropic relations, without a mesh. Without shocks, friction or heat transfer, the total pressure, the total temperature and the mass flow qm=ρuAq_m=\rho uA are constant along the duct. The ratio of the outlet static pressure to the total pressure gives the outlet Mach number Me≈0.39M_e\approx0.39; the constant mass flow then gives the Mach number at every section (the area–Mach relation): the smaller the section, the faster the subsonic flow and the lower the pressure. The throat has M≈0.65M\approx0.65 and p≈0.75p\approx0.75, the fastest flow and the lowest pressure in the duct. Section 15 uses this isentropic solution as the exact reference, and Appendix A integrates the continuous adjoint on it.

设计的目的在第 7 节给出。页首默认的目标是压力反设计 QIQ_I：调整设计，使压力接近目标压力 p⋆p^\star（图 1下部的虚线）；p⋆p^\star 由一个固定的目标流道 A⋆(x)=(1−0.3 sin⁡2πx)(1−0.04 sin⁡πx)A^\star(x)=(1-0.3\,\sin^2\pi x)(1-0.04\,\sin\pi x) 在同一网格上算出，所以这是一个反设计问题。另一个可选目标是壁面推力 QTQ_T，即壁面压力的轴向合力 ∫01pA′ dx\int_0^1pA'\,dx。目标都是一个标量，所以一次伴随求解就能给出全部 16 个设计分量的梯度。

Section 7 gives the purpose of the design. The default objective at the top of the page is the pressure inverse design QIQ_I: adjust the design so that the pressure approaches the target pressure p⋆p^\star (the dashed line in the lower part of Figure 1); p⋆p^\star is computed on the same mesh from a fixed target duct A⋆(x)=(1−0.3 sin⁡2πx)(1−0.04 sin⁡πx)A^\star(x)=(1-0.3\,\sin^2\pi x)(1-0.04\,\sin\pi x), which makes this an inverse-design problem. The other objective is the wall thrust QTQ_T, the axial force of the wall pressure, ∫01pA′ dx\int_0^1pA'\,dx. Each objective is a single number, so one adjoint solve gives the gradient with respect to all 16 design components.

这个方程组的作用

What these equations are for

在流体力学里，拟一维 Euler 方程描述截面积沿轴线缓慢变化的管道、喷管和扩压器中的无黏可压缩流动，前提是流动在每个截面上近似均匀。它把 Burgers 方程没有的东西带了进来：压力和状态方程把密度、动量和能量耦合在一起；声波既能顺流也能逆流传播；截面积的变化使亚声速气流在收缩段加速、在扩张段减速，本页默认的先收缩后扩张的流道就是一个文丘里管。出口压力足够低时，喉部达到声速，扩张段出现超声速流；出口压力在一定范围内时，超声速区以一道正激波结束。火箭发动机和超声速风洞的拉瓦尔喷管就是这种先收缩后扩张、在喉部达到声速的喷管。正因为它只有一维，却保留了可压缩流的这些主要特征，可压缩流的教科书常用它讲解喷管流动，数值通量和特征边界条件也常先在它上面检验。

In fluid dynamics the quasi-one-dimensional Euler equations describe inviscid compressible flow in pipes, nozzles and diffusers whose area varies slowly along the axis, provided that the flow is nearly uniform over each cross-section. They bring in what the Burgers equation lacks: the pressure and the equation of state couple the density, the momentum and the energy; sound waves travel both downstream and upstream; and a change of area accelerates a subsonic flow in a contraction and slows it down in an expansion, as in the converging–diverging duct of this page, a venturi. When the outlet pressure is low enough, the throat reaches sonic speed and the diverging part carries supersonic flow; for a range of outlet pressures the supersonic region ends in a normal shock. The Laval nozzles of rocket engines and supersonic wind tunnels are converging–diverging nozzles of this kind, sonic at the throat. Because they are one-dimensional yet keep these main features of compressible flow, textbooks on compressible flow commonly use them to explain nozzle flow, and numerical fluxes and characteristic boundary conditions are often tested on them first.

在本课程里，它排在一维 Burgers 之后、二维 Euler 之前：先在一维里单独面对方程组、热力学、特征边界和几何设计变量，再进入需要第二个空间方向和网格坐标导数的二维页面。网格仍然是一维的，每个数组都能完整地写在页面上，但比 Burgers 多了下面几样东西：

In this course it comes after 1-D Burgers and before 2-D Euler, so that a system, thermodynamics, characteristic boundaries and geometric design variables are met in one dimension, before the 2-D pages add a second space direction and derivatives with respect to mesh coordinates. The mesh is still one-dimensional and every array fits on the page, but compared with Burgers it adds the following:

  • 方程组。每个位置有三个未知量，Jacobian 由 3×3 块组成，第 6 节的 GS 按块扫描；默认网格有 39 个未知量。
  • A system. Each location has three unknowns, the Jacobian consists of 3×3 blocks and the GS of Section 6 sweeps block by block; the default mesh has 39 unknowns.
  • 热力学。通量经由压力依赖全部三个守恒量；前向与伴随都要沿压力、声速这些中间量逐步求导（第 8、9 节）。
  • Thermodynamics. Through the pressure the flux depends on all three conserved variables; the tangent and the adjoint differentiate step by step through intermediate quantities such as the pressure and the sound speed (Sections 8 and 9).
  • 特征边界条件。入口两个、出口一个；边界状态是内部状态和边界数据的非线性函数，前向与伴随也要经过这些边界映射（第 4 节）。
  • Characteristic boundary conditions. Two at the inlet and one at the outlet; the boundary states are nonlinear functions of the interior state and the boundary data, and the tangent and the adjoint pass through these boundary maps too (Section 4).
  • 几何作为设计变量。截面积同时出现在面通量、壁面压力源项和目标函数的积分里，第 12 节的设计导数要把这三处都算上；二维页面再把几何导数推广到全部网格节点坐标。
  • Geometry as design variables. The areas enter the face fluxes, the wall-pressure source and the integrals of the objective, and the design derivatives of Section 12 must include all three; the 2-D pages extend geometric derivatives to every mesh-node coordinate.
  • 可以对照的参考解。等熵解是网格收敛的精确参考（第 15 节）；连续伴随可以独立地数值积分（第 16 节、附录 A），与离散伴随对照。
  • References to compare with. The isentropic solution is the exact reference for mesh convergence (Section 15), and the continuous adjoint can be integrated independently (Section 16, Appendix A) for comparison with the discrete adjoint.

图 3把本页放在整个网站的路线上。每往右一步主要增加一类新内容：一维 Burgers 只有一个方程，设计变量在源项里；本页把它换成质量、动量、能量三个方程，引入压力和变截面积；二维 Euler 增加第二个空间方向，面有了法向，网格坐标也成为设计变量；二维层流 N–S 加入黏性应力和热传导，面上还要用到梯度；二维 RANS–SA 再加一个湍流模型方程。每点的未知量从 1 个增加到 5 个，但每一页的残差都由面循环组装，前向与伴随也沿同一个循环求导。另有一页与本页相邻：一维层流 N–S 页留在一维，但截面积不变，在 Euler 方程上加入黏性和热传导。图中的方框和这里的页面名都链接到各页的第 1 节。

Figure 3 places this page on the route through the site. Each step to the right mainly adds one kind of ingredient: 1-D Burgers has a single equation, with the design variables in its source; this page replaces it by three equations (mass, momentum and energy) and brings in the pressure and a varying cross-section; 2-D Euler adds a second space direction, so faces have normals and the mesh coordinates become design variables; 2-D laminar N–S adds viscous stresses and heat conduction, which need gradients at the faces; 2-D RANS–SA adds one turbulence-model equation. The unknowns per point grow from 1 to 5, yet every page still assembles its residual with face loops, and the tangent and the adjoint differentiate the same loops. One more page sits next to this one: the 1-D laminar N–S page stays in one dimension, at constant area, and adds viscosity and heat conduction to the Euler equations. The boxes of the figure and the page names here link to Section 1 of each page.

本页要回答的问题

The question this page answers

本页只回答一个问题：设计 DD 改变一点，目标 QQ 改变多少；页首的全页路线图把后面各节串成一条线。按页首默认设置（二阶、GS 预处理的 GMRES、压力反设计）实际计数，16 次前向求解共用 468 次 GMRES 迭代，1 次伴随求解只用 27 次。

This page answers one question: how much does the objective QQ change when the design DD changes a little? The page roadmap at the top strings the later sections together. Counted with the default settings at the top of the page (second order, GS-preconditioned GMRES, pressure inverse design), the 16 tangent solves take 468 GMRES iterations in total and the single adjoint solve only 27.

要在计算机上回答这个问题，先要把连续方程组换成有限个未知量的代数方程。第 2 节先建立网格、决定三个守恒量放在哪里，第 3 节再把守恒律写成面上的通量差，并在每个面的两侧重构状态。

To answer it on a computer, the continuous equations must first become algebraic equations in finitely many unknowns. Section 2 builds the mesh and decides where the three conserved variables live; Section 3 writes the conservation laws as flux differences across faces and reconstructs the states on the two sides of each face.

第 2 节Section 2

网格：一个位置对应三个守恒量

Mesh: three conserved variables at each location

第 1 节的方程组在流道的每一个 xx 上都成立，但计算机只能存储有限个数。本节选定网格，决定三个守恒量存放在哪里，并把全部状态排成一个数组。

The equations of Section 1 hold at every xx of the duct, but a computer stores finitely many numbers. This section chooses the mesh, decides where the three conserved variables are stored and arranges the whole state in one array.

先从 Burgers 的一个未知量走向 Euler 的三个未知量。把流道长度无量纲化为 1，在 N 个等长区间上给出截面积 A。数组下标从 0 开始，状态排列为 [ρ₀,m₀,e₀,ρ₁,m₁,e₁,…]。

Move from one Burgers unknown to three Euler unknowns. Scale duct length to one and specify area A at the endpoints of N equal intervals. Arrays are zero-based; the state ordering is [ρ₀,m₀,e₀,ρ₁,m₁,e₁,…].

本页把 U 保存于原始节点 xi=i h。内部控制体为 [xi−h/2,xi+h/2]，端点控制体只有半宽；对偶面截面积由原始节点的 A 线性插值得到。状态有 3(N+1) 个自由度。端点的三条强边界约束在残差装配完成后替换指定方程。

U is stored at primal nodes xi=i h. Interior dual volumes extend half an interval to either side; endpoint volumes have half width. Dual-face areas interpolate primal-node A values. There are 3(N+1) state degrees of freedom. Three strong endpoint constraints replace selected equations after residual assembly.

h=1/N,A(x)=1−0.3sin⁡2(πx),Ui=(ρi,mi,ei)T.h=1/N,\qquad A(x)=1-0.3\sin^2(\pi x),\qquad U_i=(\rho_i,m_i,e_i)^T.

下面选取控制体与显示分量。蓝色点是未知量位置，竖线是计算面，淡紫色区域是当前控制体；流道轮廓表示截面积，不是二维网格。所有后续交互共享顶端选择的空间阶数与线性求解方法。

Select a volume and component below. Blue dots locate unknowns, vertical lines mark computational faces, and violet shading selects a volume. The duct outline represents area, not a two-dimensional mesh. All subsequent interactions share the spatial order and solver selected at the top.

有了网格和未知量，还要把第 1 节的守恒律写到每个控制体上。第 3 节把它写成面上的通量差，并说明面两侧的状态从哪里来。

With the mesh and the unknowns in place, the conservation laws of Section 1 must be written for every control volume. Section 3 writes them as flux differences across faces and shows where the states on the two sides of a face come from.

第 3 节Section 3

面上的通量：通量差与二阶重构

The flux on a face: flux differences and second-order reconstruction

本节实验：改变一个未知量，哪些面值会变化？先预测重构邻域，再用图验证。

Experiment: Which traces change when one unknown changes? Predict the stencil, then inspect the diagram.

第 2 节的每个控制体存着一组守恒量。本节先把守恒律写成面上的通量差，再说明二阶格式怎样重构每个面两侧的状态，以及数值通量怎样把两侧的状态合成一个面通量。

Each control volume of Section 2 stores one set of conserved variables. This section first writes the conservation laws as flux differences across faces, then shows how the second-order scheme reconstructs the states on the two sides of each face and how the numerical flux combines them into one face flux.

从守恒律到面上的通量差

From conservation laws to flux differences on faces

把第 1 节的定常方程组在一个控制体上积分，控制体的两个面记作 xi−1/2x_{i-1/2} 和 xi+1/2x_{i+1/2}（位置见第 2 节的网格）。由微积分基本定理，导数变成两个面上面积加权通量之差，壁面压力项变成体积分：

Integrate the steady equations of Section 1 over one control volume, with faces xi−1/2x_{i-1/2} and xi+1/2x_{i+1/2} (their positions are given by the mesh of Section 2). By the fundamental theorem of calculus the derivative becomes the difference of the area-weighted fluxes at the two faces, and the wall-pressure term becomes a volume integral:

[A F(U)]xi−1/2xi+1/2=e2∫xi−1/2xi+1/2A′p dx.\bigl[A\,F(U)\bigr]_{x_{i-1/2}}^{x_{i+1/2}}=e_2\int_{x_{i-1/2}}^{x_{i+1/2}}A'p\,dx.

每个守恒量流出控制体的净通量，等于控制体内的源项；只有动量有源项，即壁面压力的轴向分力。这就是有限体积法的出发点。相邻两个控制体在同一个面 ff 上可能给出不同的状态 Uf−U_f^- 和 Uf+U_f^+；数值通量把它们合成一个共同的面通量 HfH_f，左右两个控制体以相反的符号共用它，所以内部面的贡献在全域求和时相互抵消。第 5 节把面通量和体积分装配成残差。HfH_f 用哪两个状态，由下面的重构决定。

For each conserved variable the net outward flux of a control volume equals the source inside it; only momentum has a source, the axial force of the wall pressure. This is the starting point of finite volumes. At a face ff the two neighbouring volumes may supply different states Uf−U_f^- and Uf+U_f^+; a numerical flux combines them into one shared face flux HfH_f, which the two volumes use with opposite signs, so the contributions of interior faces cancel in a global sum. Section 5 assembles the face fluxes and the volume integrals into the residual. Which two states HfH_f receives is decided by the reconstruction below.

二阶重构与数值通量

Second-order reconstruction and the numerical flux

一阶直接读取 Ui；二阶把守恒量在控制体内重构为直线。内部斜率采用中心差分，两个端点采用单边差分；同一条重构既用于面状态，也用于源项和目标函数的积分点。当前仅研究光滑亚声速流动，不使用限制器。高阶重构的导数包含邻点，不能把斜率冻结后仍称为精确二阶导数。

First order reads Ui directly. Second order reconstructs a linear conservative state inside each volume, using centred interior slopes and one-sided endpoint slopes. The same reconstruction supplies faces, source quadrature and objective quadrature. This smooth subsonic example has no limiter. Reconstruction derivatives include neighbouring states; freezing slopes would not give an exact second-order derivative.

Ui(x)=Ui+(x−xi)si,si=Ui+1−Ui−12h,s0=U1−U0h,sm−1=Um−1−Um−2h.U_i(x)=U_i+(x-x_i)s_i,\quad s_i=\frac{U_{i+1}-U_{i-1}}{2h},\quad s_0=\frac{U_1-U_0}{h},\quad s_{m-1}=\frac{U_{m-1}-U_{m-2}}h.
Hf=Af[F(Uf−)+F(Uf+)2−αf2(Uf+−Uf−)],αf=u−+c−+u++c+2.H_f=A_f\left[\frac{F(U_f^-)+F(U_f^+)}2-\frac{\alpha_f}2(U_f^+-U_f^-)\right],\quad\alpha_f=\frac{u^-+c^-+u^++c^+}{2}.

在本例的正向光滑分支上 u>0；上述平均波速是明确选择的耗散形式，不是 max 波速的近似求导。α 随状态变化，其全部导数保留。每次更新检查密度、压力和重构状态的亚声速条件。图中一阶两侧常值与二阶两侧直线使用同一收敛状态，便于看清重构本身的作用。

On the selected positive-flow branch u>0. The averaged speed defines the chosen dissipation; it is not a differentiated approximation to max. All state derivatives of α are retained. Updates check density, pressure and subsonic reconstructed states. The diagram compares constant and linear traces using the same converged state to isolate reconstruction.

面通量的局部导数

The local derivatives of the face flux

第 8 节的前向与第 9 节的伴随都要对面通量求导；这里先把它们需要的局部导数逐项写出。记 U=(ρ,m,e)TU=(\rho,m,e)^T、u=m/ρu=m/\rho、E=e/ρE=e/\rho，速度、压力和声速对 UU 的偏导数都是行向量：

The tangent of Section 8 and the adjoint of Section 9 both differentiate the face flux; the local derivatives they need are written out here. With U=(ρ,m,e)TU=(\rho,m,e)^T, u=m/ρu=m/\rho and E=e/ρE=e/\rho, the derivatives of the velocity, the pressure and the sound speed with respect to UU are rows:

uU=(−uρ, 1ρ, 0),pU=(γ−1)(u22, −u, 1),cU=c2(pUp−(1,0,0)ρ).u_U=\Bigl(-\frac u\rho,\ \frac1\rho,\ 0\Bigr),\quad p_U=(\gamma-1)\Bigl(\frac{u^2}2,\ -u,\ 1\Bigr),\quad c_U=\frac c2\Bigl(\frac{p_U}p-\frac{(1,0,0)}\rho\Bigr).

逐行对 F=(m, mu+p, (e+p)u)TF=(m,\ mu+p,\ (e+p)u)^T 求导，得到通量 Jacobian（附录 A.1 把同一个矩阵记作 BB；它的三个特征值就是第 1 节的 u−cu-c、uu、u+cu+c）：

Differentiating F=(m, mu+p, (e+p)u)TF=(m,\ mu+p,\ (e+p)u)^T row by row gives the flux Jacobian (Appendix A.1 writes the same matrix as BB; its three eigenvalues are the u−cu-c, uu and u+cu+c of Section 1):

FU=[010γ−32u2(3−γ)uγ−1(γ−1)u3−γuEγE−32(γ−1)u2γu].F_U=\begin{bmatrix}0&1&0\\\frac{\gamma-3}2u^2&(3-\gamma)u&\gamma-1\\(\gamma-1)u^3-\gamma uE&\gamma E-\frac32(\gamma-1)u^2&\gamma u\end{bmatrix}.

每单位面积的数值通量 H^=Hf/Af\widehat H=H_f/A_f 既直接依赖两侧状态，也经由平均波速 α\alpha 依赖它们。记 ΔU=Uf+−Uf−\Delta U=U_f^+-U_f^-，α∓=12(uU+cU)\alpha_\mp=\tfrac12(u_U+c_U) 在 Uf∓U_f^\mp 处取值（行向量），则

The numerical flux per unit area, H^=Hf/Af\widehat H=H_f/A_f, depends on the two face states directly and through the averaged speed α\alpha. With ΔU=Uf+−Uf−\Delta U=U_f^+-U_f^- and the rows α∓=12(uU+cU)\alpha_\mp=\tfrac12(u_U+c_U) evaluated at Uf∓U_f^\mp,

∂H^∂Uf−=FU(Uf−)2+α2I−12ΔU α−,∂H^∂Uf+=FU(Uf+)2−α2I−12ΔU α+,∂Hf∂Af=H^.\frac{\partial\widehat H}{\partial U_f^-}=\frac{F_U(U_f^-)}2+\frac\alpha2I-\frac12\Delta U\,\alpha_-,\qquad\frac{\partial\widehat H}{\partial U_f^+}=\frac{F_U(U_f^+)}2-\frac\alpha2I-\frac12\Delta U\,\alpha_+,\qquad\frac{\partial H_f}{\partial A_f}=\widehat H.

两个式子的最后一项都是列向量乘行向量，秩为一：它来自耗散速度随状态的变化，只在两侧状态相同的地方为零。把它丢掉（“冻结 α\alpha”）得到的矩阵就不再是这个通量的导数。面状态对存储状态是线性的：Uf±=∑jWfj±UjU_f^\pm=\sum_jW^\pm_{fj}U_j，权重就是上面重构公式的系数（本页的权重是标量，三个分量相同）。二阶时，控制体 ii 与 i+1i+1 之间的内部面取

The last term of each is a column times a row, a rank-one matrix: it carries the change of the dissipation speed with the state and vanishes only where the two states agree. Dropping it (“freezing α\alpha”) gives a matrix that is no longer the derivative of this flux. The face states are linear in the stored states, Uf±=∑jWfj±UjU_f^\pm=\sum_jW^\pm_{fj}U_j, with the coefficients of the reconstruction above as weights (scalars on this page, the same for the three components). At second order an interior face between volumes ii and i+1i+1 takes

Uf−=Ui+14(Ui+1−Ui−1),Uf+=Ui+1−14(Ui+2−Ui),Af=(1−tf)Ak+tfAk+1,U_f^-=U_i+\tfrac14(U_{i+1}-U_{i-1}),\qquad U_f^+=U_{i+1}-\tfrac14(U_{i+2}-U_i),\qquad A_f=(1-t_f)A_k+t_fA_{k+1},

所以每个面读取 4 个存储状态（一阶只读 2 个），端点控制体用单边斜率。面积在设计截面积之间线性插值：格点页的内部面位于两个节点的中点，tf=12t_f=\tfrac12，两个端面在端节点上。

so each face reads four stored states (two at first order), and the end volumes use one-sided slopes. The face area is interpolated linearly between design areas: on the node page the interior faces sit halfway between two nodes, tf=12t_f=\tfrac12, and the two end faces on the end nodes.

算例（页首默认设置）：面 f=6f=6 位于 xf=0.4583x_f=0.4583，在控制体 55 与 66 之间，Af=0.71A_f=0.71。两侧重构状态与平均波速为

Worked example (the defaults at the top of the page): the face f=6f=6 lies at xf=0.4583x_f=0.4583, between volumes 55 and 66, with Af=0.71A_f=0.71. Its reconstructed states and averaged speed are

Uf−=(0.8192, 0.6082, 2.118)T,Uf+=(0.8157, 0.6103, 2.11)T,α=1.882,U_f^-=\bigl(0.8192,\ 0.6082,\ 2.118\bigr)^T,\quad U_f^+=\bigl(0.8157,\ 0.6103,\ 2.11\bigr)^T,\quad\alpha=1.882,

两个 Jacobian 为

and its two Jacobians are

∂H^∂Uf−=[0.93980.50092.636×10−4−0.21971.5350.1998−1.2651.6471.461],∂H^∂Uf+=[−0.94250.50092.649×10−4−0.2231−0.34310.1998−1.2741.645−0.4168].\frac{\partial\widehat H}{\partial U_f^-}=\begin{bmatrix}0.9398&0.5009&2.636\times10^{-4}\\-0.2197&1.535&0.1998\\-1.265&1.647&1.461\end{bmatrix},\qquad\frac{\partial\widehat H}{\partial U_f^+}=\begin{bmatrix}-0.9425&0.5009&2.649\times10^{-4}\\-0.2231&-0.3431&0.1998\\-1.274&1.645&-0.4168\end{bmatrix}.

两者主要差在对角线上，约为 ±α/2\pm\alpha/2；秩一项的大小约为 12∥ΔU∥ ∥α−∥=0.0044\tfrac12\|\Delta U\|\,\|\alpha_-\|=0.0044（这里 ∥ΔU∥=0.0095\|\Delta U\|=0.0095，而整个矩阵的范数约为 3.23.2），在光滑解上很小，但不能省略。第 8 节用这两个矩阵做前向，第 9 节用它们的转置做伴随；两处都与 core.js 的运算记录（tape）比较，差在舍入量级。

They differ mainly on the diagonal, by about ±α/2\pm\alpha/2; the rank-one term has the size 12∥ΔU∥ ∥α−∥=0.0044\tfrac12\|\Delta U\|\,\|\alpha_-\|=0.0044 (here ∥ΔU∥=0.0095\|\Delta U\|=0.0095, while the whole matrix has norm about 3.23.2), small on a smooth solution but not negligible. Section 8 carries tangents through these two matrices and Section 9 their transposes; both agree with the operation tape of core.js to rounding.

到这里，每个内部面都由两侧的重构状态得到通量。两个端点不同：格点页的端点控制体只有半宽，外侧没有状态；按第 1 节的特征计数，入口只能给两个数据、出口只能给一个。第 4 节说明格点页的做法：端面直接用端点状态的物理通量，残差装配完成后，再用三条边界条件替换入口的两行和出口的一行。

Every interior face now gets its flux from the reconstructed states on its two sides. The two ends differ: on the node page the end volumes have half width and nothing lies outside them, and by the characteristic count of Section 1 the inlet can take only two data and the outlet only one. Section 4 shows what the node page does: the end faces use the physical flux of the end state, and after the residual is assembled, three boundary conditions replace two inlet rows and one outlet row.

第 4 节Section 4

边界条件：给定哪些量，哪些量由内部决定

Boundary conditions: prescribed and outgoing information

第 1 节由三条特征速度 u−c、u、u+c（通量 Jacobian ∂F/∂U 的三个特征值；附录 A.1 写出这个 3×3 矩阵）说明了边界条件的个数：左端两条进入计算域、右端一条进入计算域，所以给定入口总压 p₀、总温 T₀ 和出口静压 pbp_b。把入口全部三个守恒量再加出口压力一起钉死，会过度约束问题。本节说明离散格式怎样施加这三个条件。

Section 1 counted the boundary conditions from the three characteristic speeds u−c, u and u+c (the eigenvalues of the flux Jacobian ∂F/∂U; Appendix A.1 writes out this 3×3 matrix): two characteristics enter at the left and one at the right, so the inlet total pressure p₀, total temperature T₀ and outlet static pressure pbp_b are prescribed. Prescribing all three inlet conservative values as well as exit pressure would overconstrain the problem. This section shows how the discretisation imposes these three conditions.

T0=T(1+γ−12M2),p0=p(1+γ−12M2)γ/(γ−1),M=u/c.T_0=T\left(1+\frac{\gamma-1}{2}M^2\right),\quad p_0=p\left(1+\frac{\gamma-1}{2}M^2\right)^{\gamma/(\gamma-1)},\quad M=u/c.

格点页把入口节点的第 0、1 行（质量行与动量行）换成 p₀(U₀)−p₀ 和 T₀(U₀)−T₀，把出口节点的质量行（第 3N 行）换成 p(UNU_N)−pbp_b；右边的 p₀、T₀、pbp_b 是给定的边界数据，也就是设计变量。其余行仍为积分守恒方程。被覆盖的旧行必须在前向和反向计算中一并移除。

At the inlet node, rows 0 and 1 (the mass and momentum rows) become p₀(U₀)−p₀ and T₀(U₀)−T₀; the mass row of the outlet node (row 3N) becomes p(UNU_N)−pbp_b; the p₀, T₀ and pbp_b on the right are the prescribed boundary data, which are design variables. Remaining rows retain integral balances. Both tangent and reverse calculations must remove the overwritten contributions.

格点页出口的总温、总压与入口略有差别（默认 N=12、二阶时出口总温约 1.034）。原因在边界行：两端的质量行都换成了边界条件，没有方程把两端的质量流量 qm=ρuAq_m=\rho uA 联系起来；保留的能量行相加后要求两端能量通量相等，所以 T0(1)/T0(0)=qm(0)/qm(1)T_0(1)/T_0(0)=q_m(0)/q_m(1)。这是离散误差，随网格加密以二阶减小：二阶格式在 N=12、24、48、96 时 T0(1)−T0(0)T_0(1)-T_0(0) 为 3.4×10⁻²、8.1×10⁻³、2.0×10⁻³、5.0×10⁻⁴。

On the node page the outlet total temperature and pressure differ slightly from the inlet values (outlet total temperature about 1.034 at the default N=12, second order). The cause is the boundary rows: both end mass rows are replaced by boundary conditions, so no equation ties the two end mass flows qm=ρuAq_m=\rho uA together, while the kept energy rows sum to equal end energy fluxes, giving T0(1)/T0(0)=qm(0)/qm(1)T_0(1)/T_0(0)=q_m(0)/q_m(1). This is a discretisation error that decreases at second order: T0(1)−T0(0)T_0(1)-T_0(0) is 3.4×10⁻², 8.1×10⁻³, 2.0×10⁻³, 5.0×10⁻⁴ at N = 12, 24, 48, 96 for the second-order scheme.

B˙=BUU˙+BDD˙,Uˉ+=BUTBˉ,Dˉ+=BDTBˉ.\dot B=B_U\dot U+B_D\dot D,\qquad \bar U\mathrel{\text{+=}}B_U^T\bar B,\quad\bar D\mathrel{\text{+=}}B_D^T\bar B.

上式中的点表示前向（tangent）导数，横线表示反向（adjoint）累加权重，记号在第 8 节说明。边界也是计算图的一部分。固定设计参数不等于固定边界状态：即使 p₀、T₀、pbp_b 不变，内部扰动仍通过出域特征改变边界状态。

In the formula above a dot marks a forward (tangent) derivative and a bar a reverse (adjoint) accumulation weight; Section 8 introduces the notation. Boundaries belong to the computational graph. Fixed boundary parameters do not imply fixed boundary states: interior perturbations still propagate through outgoing characteristics.

边界行的导数

The derivatives of the boundary rows

格点页的边界条件是装配后替换的三行，而不是通量闭合：第 0、1 行（节点 0 的质量行和动量行）换成 p0(U0)−p0p_0(U_0)-p_0 与 T0(U0)−T0T_0(U_0)-T_0，第 3N3N 行（节点 NN 的质量行）换成 p(UN)−pbp(U_N)-p_b，其中 T=p/ρT=p/\rho、T0(U)=T+u2/7T_0(U)=T+u^2/7、p0(U)=p (T0/T)3.5p_0(U)=p\,(T_0/T)^{3.5}（γ=1.4\gamma=1.4，气体常数为 1）。它们对 UU 的行向量为

On the node page the boundary conditions are three rows replaced after assembly, not flux closures: rows 0 and 1 (the mass and momentum rows of node 0) become p0(U0)−p0p_0(U_0)-p_0 and T0(U0)−T0T_0(U_0)-T_0, and row 3N3N (the mass row of node NN) becomes p(UN)−pbp(U_N)-p_b, with T=p/ρT=p/\rho, T0(U)=T+u2/7T_0(U)=T+u^2/7 and p0(U)=p (T0/T)3.5p_0(U)=p\,(T_0/T)^{3.5} (γ=1.4\gamma=1.4, gas constant 1). Their rows with respect to UU are

TU=pUρ−pρ2(1,0,0),(T0)U=TU+2u7uU,(p0)U=p0(pUp+3.5((T0)UT0−TUT)),pU(UN).T_U=\frac{p_U}\rho-\frac p{\rho^2}(1,0,0),\qquad(T_0)_U=T_U+\frac{2u}7u_U,\qquad(p_0)_U=p_0\Bigl(\frac{p_U}p+3.5\Bigl(\frac{(T_0)_U}{T_0}-\frac{T_U}T\Bigr)\Bigr),\qquad p_U(U_N).

Each row depends on one design variable, with coefficient −1-1, and no other row depends on p0p_0, T0T_0 or pbp_b. In g=QDT+RDTψg=Q_D^T+R_D^T\psi these three components are therefore the multipliers of the replaced rows:

（页首默认设置；第 12 节说明 gT0g_{T_0} 在精确算术中为零）。这与附录 A.4 的连续结论同构：那里边界数据的梯度由边界乘子给出，(p0,T0)(p_0,T_0) 的梯度是 μ0\mu_0，pbp_b 的梯度是 −μ1-\mu_1（μ1\mu_1 前有负号）。替换是覆盖赋值，所以前向直接覆盖这三行的切向量，伴随先把这三行的种子送入约束，再把它们清零，被覆盖的守恒行就不会再传到面通量：

(the defaults at the top of the page; Section 12 explains why gT0g_{T_0} is zero in exact arithmetic). This mirrors the continuous result of Appendix A.4, where the gradients with respect to the boundary data are given by boundary multipliers: that with respect to (p0,T0)(p_0,T_0) is μ0\mu_0 and that with respect to pbp_b is −μ1-\mu_1 (with a minus sign in front of μ1\mu_1). A replacement is an overwrite, so the tangent overwrites the tangents of these three rows, and the adjoint first sends their seeds into the constraints and then zeroes them, so the overwritten balance rows never reach the face fluxes:

R˙0=(p0)UU˙0−p˙0,R˙1=(T0)UU˙0−T˙0,R˙3N=pUU˙N−p˙b;Uˉ0+=(p0)UTRˉ0+(T0)UTRˉ1,UˉN+=pUTRˉ3N,pˉ0-=Rˉ0,Tˉ0-=Rˉ1,pˉb-=Rˉ3N,Rˉ0,Rˉ1,Rˉ3N←0.\begin{aligned}&\dot R_0=(p_0)_U\dot U_0-\dot p_0,\quad\dot R_1=(T_0)_U\dot U_0-\dot T_0,\quad\dot R_{3N}=p_U\dot U_N-\dot p_b;\\&\bar U_0\mathrel{\text{+=}}(p_0)_U^T\bar R_0+(T_0)_U^T\bar R_1,\quad\bar U_N\mathrel{\text{+=}}p_U^T\bar R_{3N},\quad\bar p_0\mathrel{\text{-=}}\bar R_0,\quad\bar T_0\mathrel{\text{-=}}\bar R_1,\quad\bar p_b\mathrel{\text{-=}}\bar R_{3N},\quad\bar R_0,\bar R_1,\bar R_{3N}\leftarrow0.\end{aligned}

图 4 把这三行排成一条运算记录，列出页首默认设置下每个量的值、设计种子 p˙b=1\dot p_b=1（配第 10 节解出的状态切向量）下的切向量，以及种子 Rˉ=ψ\bar R=\psi、Qˉ=1\bar Q=1 反传到它的横线量。解出的切向量使三行的 R˙\dot R 都为零：出口压力的切向量恰为 p˙(UN)=p˙b=1\dot p(U_N)=\dot p_b=1。

Figure 4 lays the three rows out as a tape and lists, at the defaults, every quantity’s value, its tangent for the design seed p˙b=1\dot p_b=1 (with the state tangent solved in Section 10), and the bar the seeds Rˉ=ψ\bar R=\psi, Qˉ=1\bar Q=1 send back to it. The solved tangent makes R˙\dot R of all three rows zero: the outlet pressure has exactly the tangent p˙(UN)=p˙b=1\dot p(U_N)=\dot p_b=1.

第 5 节Section 5

残差：面循环、体积分与强边界行

Residual: face loops, volume quadrature and boundary rows

先固定离散问题与符号

Fix the discrete problem and its notation

本页每个节点存储 3 个未知量。以下用 𝐔\mathbf U 表示把所有位置、所有分量按代码顺序排成的列向量。它是一个有限维向量，不是连续函数。物理方程中的空间导数只用于说明模型；求离散伴随时，求导对象是本页实际装配的有限维函数。

Each node stores 3 unknowns. Below, 𝐔\mathbf U stacks all locations and components in code order. It is a finite-dimensional vector, not a continuous function. Spatial derivatives in the physical equations explain the model; discrete differentiation acts on the actual finite-dimensional functions assembled on this page.

𝐔∈ℝnu,D∈ℝna,\mathbf U\in\mathbb R^{n_u},\quad D\in\mathbb R^{n_a},
R:ℝnu×ℝna→ℝnu,Q:ℝnu×ℝna→ℝ.R:\mathbb R^{n_u}\times\mathbb R^{n_a}\to\mathbb R^{n_u},\quad Q:\mathbb R^{n_u}\times\mathbb R^{n_a}\to\mathbb R.

DD 是本页全部设计变量排成的向量：截面积 AkA_k、背压 pbp_b、入口总压 p0p_0 与总温 T0T_0。本页的 AA 是截面积，所以全局残差 Jacobian 记作 JJ，目标记作 QQ；局部通量 Jacobian ∂F/∂U\partial F/\partial U 又是另一个对象。每个位置的局部状态 UiU_i 是一个小列向量，全局的 𝐔\mathbf U 才是 Jacobian 的输入。

DD stacks all design variables of this page: the areas AkA_k, the back pressure pbp_b, the inlet total pressure p0p_0 and the total temperature T0T_0. On this page AA is the area, so the global residual Jacobian is JJ and the objective is QQ; a local flux Jacobian ∂F/∂U\partial F/\partial U is yet another object. A local state UiU_i is a small column vector; the global 𝐔\mathbf U is the input of the Jacobian.

J=∂R∂𝐔∈ℝnu×nu,RD=∂R∂D∈ℝnu×na,J=\frac{\partial R}{\partial \mathbf U}\in\mathbb R^{n_u\times n_u},\quad R_D=\frac{\partial R}{\partial D}\in\mathbb R^{n_u\times n_a},
QUT=(∂Q∂𝐔)T∈ℝnu,QDT=(∂Q∂D)T∈ℝna.Q_U^T=\Big(\frac{\partial Q}{\partial \mathbf U}\Big)^{T}\in\mathbb R^{n_u},\quad Q_D^T=\Big(\frac{\partial Q}{\partial D}\Big)^{T}\in\mathbb R^{n_a}.

这里 QUTQ_U^T、QDTQ_D^T 都是列向量，它们的转置才是偏导数行。求导采用自动微分（AD）的记号：程序变量 xx 上加点的 x˙\dot x 是前向（tangent）模式沿给定种子方向的导数，加横线的 xˉ\bar x 是反向（adjoint）模式累加到 xx 上的权重，例如 𝐔˙\dot{\mathbf U} 与 𝐔ˉ\bar{\mathbf U}。两者都是对本页有限维代码求导；变分符号 δ\delta 只用于附录 A、B 的连续推导里连续函数的变分。

Both QUTQ_U^T and QDTQ_D^T are columns; their transposes are the derivative rows. Derivatives use the notation of automatic differentiation (AD): a dot x˙\dot x on a program variable xx is its forward (tangent) derivative along the chosen seed direction, and a bar xˉ\bar x is the weight accumulated into xx in reverse (adjoint) mode, for example 𝐔˙\dot{\mathbf U} and 𝐔ˉ\bar{\mathbf U}. Both differentiate the finite-dimensional code of this page; the variation symbol δ\delta is kept for variations of continuous functions in the continuous derivations of Appendices A and B.

Ri 是积分残差，没有除以体积。内部面只算一次，向左控制体加 H、向右控制体减 H；随后从动量分量减去压力壁面源项。面积在各原始区间内为直线；每段采用两点 Gauss 积分。格点对偶体若跨越原始节点，必须先拆成两段，不能跨过 A′ 的跳变只做一次积分。

Ri is an integrated residual, without volume division. Evaluate each internal face once, adding H to the left volume and subtracting it from the right. Subtract the wall-pressure source from momentum afterwards. Area is linear on each primal interval. Apply two-point Gauss quadrature on each piece; split node-centred dual volumes at primal nodes where A′ changes.

Ri=Hi+1/2−Hi−1/2−e2Si,Si=∑q∈Viwqp(Ui(xq))A′(xq).R_i=H_{i+1/2}-H_{i-1/2}-e_2 S_i,\quad S_i=\sum_{q\in V_i}w_qp(U_i(x_q))A'(x_q).
R[:] = 0
for face f:
    UL, UR = reconstruct_and_apply_boundary(U, f)
    H = area[f] * numerical_flux(UL, UR)
    if L exists: R[L] += H
    if R exists: R[R] -= H
for volume i:
    S[i] = sum(wq * pressure(reconstruct(U,i,xq)) * area_derivative(xq))
    R[i, momentum] -= S[i]
if node_centred: replace_three_boundary_rows(R, U, D)

播放器按照真实装配顺序展示累加。最后的强边界行覆盖是一个单独步骤；在格点页，全域所有“最终残差行”相加不再等于边界通量差，因为其中三行已经不是守恒方程。

The player follows the actual assembly order, including a separate final boundary-row replacement. Summing all final rows on the node page no longer yields only boundary flux differences because three rows are constraints rather than conservation equations.

第 6 节Section 6

Jacobian 与 GS：精确算子和低阶近似各做什么

Jacobian and GS: exact operator versus low-order approximation

把所有残差堆成向量，Newton 修正满足 J₂ ΔU=−R₂，J₂=∂R₂/∂U。这里用 J₂ 表示所选离散阶数的精确 Jacobian；一阶选择时它就是 J₁。二阶重构扩展了依赖范围。程序不存储 J₂，而沿标量计算图实施 Jv 和 JTw。为解线性系统，单独建立一阶近似 P=J₁；P 的每个对角块是 3×3。

Stack the residuals into a vector. Newton corrections satisfy J₂ ΔU=−R₂, with J₂ denoting the exact Jacobian of the selected order (J₁ when first order is selected). Reconstruction broadens dependencies. The program applies Jv and JTw through a scalar computational graph without storing J₂. A separate first-order approximation P=J₁ supplies 3×3 diagonal blocks for linear solves.

P=diag⁡(Pii)+L+V,zi(k+1)=Pii−1(ri−∑j<iPijzj(k+1)−∑j>iPijzj(k)).P=\operatorname{diag}(P_{ii})+L+V,\qquad z_i^{(k+1)}=P_{ii}^{-1}\left(r_i-\sum_{j<i}P_{ij}z_j^{(k+1)}-\sum_{j>i}P_{ij}z_j^{(k)}\right).

一次 GS 扫描使用已更新的左侧块和旧的右侧块。每次预处理从零开始做 12 次扫描，记所得线性映射为 B。外层固定点更新 x←x+0.7 B(b−J₂x)。多次内扫描使二阶缺陷校正在本页网格上稳定；不能把“一次扫描”等同于已解完 Pz=r。伴随使用整个 B 的转置，而不只是把某个局部 3×3 块转置。

A GS sweep uses updated earlier blocks and previous later blocks. Each preconditioner application starts from zero and performs 12 sweeps, defining a linear map B. Outer defect correction updates x←x+0.7 B(b−J₂x). Multiple inner sweeps stabilise this example’s second-order correction; one sweep is not an exact solution of Pz=r. The adjoint uses the transpose of the entire B map, not merely transposed diagonal blocks.

z = 0
repeat 12 times:
    z += solve_lower_blocks(diag(P_ii)+L, rhs-P*z)
# Transposed map: reverse block order, transpose blocks and residual operator.
# Never replace the exact residual J2*x by P*x in the outer equation.

符号提示：本页 A(x) 表示截面积；线性系统中的残差 Jacobian 记作 J 或 JhJ_h，目标函数记作 Q（其他页面分别记作 A 与 J）。P 是低阶近似矩阵，B 是从零开始固定次数 GS 扫描形成的预处理映射，通常不等于精确 P⁻¹。

Notation: on this page A(x) denotes area; in a linear system the residual Jacobian is written J or JhJ_h, and the objective Q (A and J on the other pages). P is the low-order matrix; B is the fixed number of zero-start GS sweeps, generally not the exact inverse of P.

精确算子与低阶近似的块结构

The block structure of the exact operator and of the low-order matrix

图 5 画出上面两个矩阵。二阶重构让一个面读取 i−1i-1 到 i+2i+2 的存储状态（第 3 节），所以 JJ 的每个块行读 5 个块，共 59 个非零块；一阶近似 PP 只读相邻块，共 37 个。块 GS 精确地倒转 diag⁡(Pii)+L\operatorname{diag}(P_{ii})+L，VV 和 J−PJ-P 留给 12 次内扫描与外层迭代；转置时 LL 与 VV 交换位置，所以伴随的扫描方向相反（第 11 节）。格点页被替换的三行只依赖一个端点的状态。

Figure 5 draws the two matrices above. Second-order reconstruction makes a face read the stored states i−1i-1 to i+2i+2 (Section 3), so a block row of JJ reads 5 blocks, 59 nonzero blocks in all; the first-order PP reads only neighbouring blocks, 37 in all. Block GS inverts diag⁡(Pii)+L\operatorname{diag}(P_{ii})+L exactly and leaves VV and J−PJ-P to the 12 inner sweeps and the outer iteration; transposing swaps LL and VV, which is why the adjoint sweeps the other way (Section 11). On the node page the three replaced rows depend on the state of one end only.

第 7 节Section 7

目标函数：壁面推力与压力反设计

Objectives: wall thrust and pressure inverse design

目标是一个标量，所以其伴随只需求一次，就能得到全部面积和边界参数的梯度。壁面推力取 ∫pA′dx；本例入口出口面积相同，光滑等熵参考解的净推力为零，但粗网格离散值不必为零。反设计目标比较当前压力和固定目标压力，目标面积固定，以便改变当前收缩深度时仍比较同一个目标流道。

A scalar objective needs one adjoint solve for gradients with respect to all area and boundary parameters. Wall thrust is ∫pA′dx. Equal inlet and exit areas give zero thrust for the smooth isentropic reference, although a coarse discrete result need not vanish. Inverse design compares current pressure with a fixed target pressure obtained from a fixed target duct, even when the current contraction depth changes.

QT=∑qwqpqAq′,QI=12∑qwqAq(pq−pq⋆)2,A⋆(x)=(1−0.3sin⁡2πx)(1−0.04sin⁡πx).Q_T=\sum_qw_qp_qA'_q,\qquad Q_I=\frac12\sum_qw_q A_q(p_q-p_q^\star)^2,\quad A^\star(x)=(1-0.3\sin^2\pi x)(1-0.04\sin\pi x).

目标状态由同一阶数、同一种网格的独立收敛计算生成，并在所有扰动计算中保持不变。重构后再求压力；目标压力也重构到同一积分点。若每次扰动都重新生成目标，验证的就变成了另一个函数。在目标流道及目标状态上，Q 与总梯度应归零。

Generate the target with a separate converged solve using the same order and grid, then hold it fixed during perturbations. Reconstruct both states to the same quadrature locations before computing pressure. Regenerating the target after every perturbation would differentiate a different objective. At the target geometry and state, both Q and its total gradient should vanish.

从离散目标得到伴随右端

From a discrete objective to the adjoint right-hand side

不能只对连续积分写一个形式导数就结束。先确定代码实际使用的求积点、权重、重构状态及边界值，再对这个标量表达式求导。一般的求积和及其链式法则是：

A formal derivative of a continuous integral is not enough. First identify the quadrature points, weights, reconstructed states and boundary values actually used by the code, then differentiate that scalar expression. A general quadrature sum and its chain rule are:

Q=∑qωq(D) θq(𝐔,D),Q=\sum_q\omega_q(D)\,\theta_q(\mathbf U,D),
Q˙=∑q[ωq θ˙q+θq ω˙q].\dot Q=\sum_q\left[\omega_q\,\dot\theta_q+\theta_q\,\dot\omega_q\right].

平方跟踪目标是它的特例：θq=12eq2\theta_q=\tfrac12e_q^2，eqe_q 是被跟踪量减去它的目标值，于是 θ˙q=eq e˙q\dot\theta_q=e_q\,\dot e_q；e˙q\dot e_q 在被跟踪量的切向量之外，只多出目标值本身的切向量（目标冻结时为零）。

A squared tracking objective is the special case θq=12eq2\theta_q=\tfrac12e_q^2, where eqe_q is the tracked quantity minus its target; then θ˙q=eq e˙q\dot\theta_q=e_q\,\dot e_q, and e˙q\dot e_q adds to the tangent of the tracked quantity only the tangent of the target itself (zero for a frozen target).

本页的两个目标都是这种求积和。推力 QT=∑qwqpqAq′Q_T=\sum_qw_qp_qA'_q 取 θq=pqAq′\theta_q=p_qA'_q，所以 θ˙q=Aq′ p˙q+pq A˙q′\dot\theta_q=A'_q\,\dot p_q+p_q\,\dot A'_q。逆设计 QI=12∑qwqAq(pq−pq⋆)2Q_I=\tfrac12\sum_qw_qA_q(p_q-p_q^\star)^2 是带面积因子的平方跟踪型，θq=12Aq(pq−pq⋆)2\theta_q=\tfrac12A_q(p_q-p_q^\star)^2；目标压力 pq⋆p_q^\star 冻结，截面积 AqA_q 却随设计变化，所以上面的 θ˙q=eq e˙q\dot\theta_q=e_q\,\dot e_q 要乘上面积，再多一项：θ˙q=Aq(pq−pq⋆) p˙q+12(pq−pq⋆)2 A˙q\dot\theta_q=A_q(p_q-p_q^\star)\,\dot p_q+\tfrac12(p_q-p_q^\star)^2\,\dot A_q。第一项经过状态（p˙q\dot p_q 是求积点上压力的切向量），进入 QUTQ_U^T；第二项是截面积经过目标本身的直接路径，进入 QDTQ_D^T。

Both objectives on this page are such quadrature sums. The thrust QT=∑qwqpqAq′Q_T=\sum_qw_qp_qA'_q takes θq=pqAq′\theta_q=p_qA'_q, so θ˙q=Aq′ p˙q+pq A˙q′\dot\theta_q=A'_q\,\dot p_q+p_q\,\dot A'_q. The inverse design QI=12∑qwqAq(pq−pq⋆)2Q_I=\tfrac12\sum_qw_qA_q(p_q-p_q^\star)^2 is a squared tracking objective with an area factor, θq=12Aq(pq−pq⋆)2\theta_q=\tfrac12A_q(p_q-p_q^\star)^2; the target pressure pq⋆p_q^\star is frozen but the area AqA_q changes with the design, so the θ˙q=eq e˙q\dot\theta_q=e_q\,\dot e_q above is multiplied by the area and gains a term: θ˙q=Aq(pq−pq⋆) p˙q+12(pq−pq⋆)2 A˙q\dot\theta_q=A_q(p_q-p_q^\star)\,\dot p_q+\tfrac12(p_q-p_q^\star)^2\,\dot A_q. The first term runs through the state (p˙q\dot p_q is the tangent of the pressure at the quadrature point) and enters QUTQ_U^T; the second is the direct path of the area through the objective itself and enters QDTQ_D^T.

求 QUTQ_U^T 时固定所有设计变量；求 QDTQ_D^T 时固定全部离散状态槽位。本页轴向网格固定，采样点与求积权重 wqw_q 不随设计变化；但被积函数里的截面积（QIQ_I 的面积因子 AqA_q、QTQ_T 的斜率 Aq′A'_q）随设计变化，这部分导数必须保留。目标中的体积权重已经进入 QUTQ_U^T，不应在伴随右端再乘一次体积。

Hold every design variable fixed for QUTQ_U^T, and every stored state entry fixed for QDTQ_D^T. The axial mesh of this page is fixed, so the samples and the quadrature weights wqw_q do not move; the areas inside the integrands (the area factor AqA_q of QIQ_I, the slope Aq′A'_q of QTQ_T) do change with the design, and those derivatives must be kept. Objective volume weights already enter QUTQ_U^T and must not be multiplied into the adjoint right-hand side again.

伴随右端本身也可以由一次反向扫描得到：以 Qˉ=1\bar Q=1 为种子，把上面的求积和逐项反过来执行，

The adjoint right-hand side is itself obtained by a reverse sweep: seed Qˉ=1\bar Q=1 and run the terms of the quadrature sum above backwards,

Qˉ=1,θˉq=ωq Qˉ,𝐔ˉ+=(∂θq∂𝐔)Tθˉq,\bar{Q}=1,\qquad \bar\theta_q=\omega_q\,\bar{Q},\qquad \bar{\mathbf U}\mathrel{\text{+=}}\Big(\frac{\partial \theta_q}{\partial \mathbf U}\Big)^T\bar\theta_q,
Dˉ+=(∂θq∂D)Tθˉq+θq(∂ωq∂D)TQˉ.\bar D\mathrel{\text{+=}}\Big(\frac{\partial \theta_q}{\partial D}\Big)^T\bar\theta_q+\theta_q\Big(\frac{\partial\omega_q}{\partial D}\Big)^T\bar{Q}.

从 𝐔ˉ←0\bar{\mathbf U}\leftarrow0、Dˉ←0\bar D\leftarrow0 开始，扫完全部求积点后 𝐔ˉ=QUT\bar{\mathbf U}=Q_U^T、Dˉ=QDT\bar D=Q_D^T：一个状态被多个求积点读取，所以要先置零、再累加。前向的 Q˙\dot Q 与反向的这两个结果满足同一个对偶关系 Qˉ Q˙=𝐔ˉT𝐔˙+DˉTD˙\bar Q\,\dot Q=\bar{\mathbf U}^T\dot{\mathbf U}+\bar D^T\dot D。

Starting from 𝐔ˉ←0\bar{\mathbf U}\leftarrow0 and Dˉ←0\bar D\leftarrow0, after all quadrature points 𝐔ˉ=QUT\bar{\mathbf U}=Q_U^T and Dˉ=QDT\bar D=Q_D^T: a state is read by several quadrature points, so its adjoint is zeroed first and then accumulated. The forward Q˙\dot Q and these two reverse results satisfy one duality, Qˉ Q˙=𝐔ˉT𝐔˙+DˉTD˙\bar Q\,\dot Q=\bar{\mathbf U}^T\dot{\mathbf U}+\bar D^T\dot D.

两个目标的偏导数

The partial derivatives of the two objectives

两个目标都是第 5 节 Gauss 点上的求和，所以它们的偏导数由与源项相同的局部量组成。记 Uq=∑jWqjUjU_q=\sum_jW_{qj}U_j（控制体在 xqx_q 处的重构，WqjW_{qj} 是它的权重），pq=p(Uq)p_q=p(U_q)，Gq=(Ak+1−Ak)/hG_q=(A_{k+1}-A_k)/h 是 xqx_q 所在区间 kk 的斜率，Aq=(1−tq)Ak+tqAk+1A_q=(1-t_q)A_k+t_qA_{k+1}。固定 DD 对状态求导，固定 𝐔\mathbf U 对设计求导：

Both objectives are sums over the Gauss points of Section 5, so their partial derivatives are made of the same local pieces as the source. Write Uq=∑jWqjUjU_q=\sum_jW_{qj}U_j (the reconstruction of the volume at xqx_q, with weights WqjW_{qj}), pq=p(Uq)p_q=p(U_q), Gq=(Ak+1−Ak)/hG_q=(A_{k+1}-A_k)/h the slope on the interval kk of xqx_q, and Aq=(1−tq)Ak+tqAk+1A_q=(1-t_q)A_k+t_qA_{k+1}. Holding DD fixed for the state derivatives and 𝐔\mathbf U fixed for the design derivatives:

∂QT∂Uj=∑qwqGq pU(Uq) Wqj,∂QT∂Ak=∑qwqpq∂Gq∂Ak,∂Gq∂Ak=−1h, ∂Gq∂Ak+1=1h;∂QI∂Uj=∑qwqAq(pq−pq⋆) pU(Uq) Wqj,∂QI∂Ak=∑q12wq(pq−pq⋆)2∂Aq∂Ak.\begin{aligned}&\frac{\partial Q_T}{\partial U_j}=\sum_qw_qG_q\,p_U(U_q)\,W_{qj},&&\frac{\partial Q_T}{\partial A_k}=\sum_qw_qp_q\frac{\partial G_q}{\partial A_k},\quad\frac{\partial G_q}{\partial A_k}=-\frac1h,\ \frac{\partial G_q}{\partial A_{k+1}}=\frac1h;\\&\frac{\partial Q_I}{\partial U_j}=\sum_qw_qA_q(p_q-p_q^\star)\,p_U(U_q)\,W_{qj},&&\frac{\partial Q_I}{\partial A_k}=\sum_q\tfrac12w_q(p_q-p_q^\star)^2\frac{\partial A_q}{\partial A_k}.\end{aligned}

两个目标都不直接读取 pbp_b、p0p_0、T0T_0：QDQ_D 的这三个分量为零，对应的梯度完全来自 RDTψR_D^T\psi（第 4、12 节）。目标压力 pq⋆p_q^\star 冻结，没有切向量。用上面一般求积和的记号，反设计是按截面积加权的跟踪项 θq=12Aq(pq−pq⋆)2\theta_q=\tfrac12A_q(p_q-p_q^\star)^2，所以 θ˙q=Aq(pq−pq⋆) p˙q+12(pq−pq⋆)2A˙q\dot\theta_q=A_q(p_q-p_q^\star)\,\dot p_q+\tfrac12(p_q-p_q^\star)^2\dot A_q；第二项是面积梯度的“目标路径”（图 11），默认设置下它的最大分量只有 3.5×10−53.5\times10^{-5}，因为 pp 与 p⋆p^\star 很接近。第 9 节以 Qˉ=1\bar Q=1 为种子的反向扫描执行的正是这些语句：pˉq+=Qˉ wqAq(pq−pq⋆)\bar p_q\mathrel{\text{+=}}\bar Q\,w_qA_q(p_q-p_q^\star)（推力为 Qˉ wqGq\bar Q\,w_qG_q），再经 Uˉq=pUTpˉq\bar U_q=p_U^T\bar p_q 与重构权重散回存储状态。

Neither objective reads pbp_b, p0p_0 or T0T_0 directly: those three entries of QDQ_D are zero, and their gradients come entirely from RDTψR_D^T\psi (Sections 4 and 12). The target pressure pq⋆p_q^\star is frozen and has no tangent. In the notation of the general quadrature sum above, the inverse design is a tracking term weighted by the area, θq=12Aq(pq−pq⋆)2\theta_q=\tfrac12A_q(p_q-p_q^\star)^2, so θ˙q=Aq(pq−pq⋆) p˙q+12(pq−pq⋆)2A˙q\dot\theta_q=A_q(p_q-p_q^\star)\,\dot p_q+\tfrac12(p_q-p_q^\star)^2\dot A_q; the second term is the “objective path” of the area gradient (Figure 11), whose largest entry is only 3.5×10−53.5\times10^{-5} at the defaults because pp is close to p⋆p^\star. The reverse sweep of Section 9 with the seed Qˉ=1\bar Q=1 performs exactly these statements: pˉq+=Qˉ wqAq(pq−pq⋆)\bar p_q\mathrel{\text{+=}}\bar Q\,w_qA_q(p_q-p_q^\star) (for the thrust Qˉ wqGq\bar Q\,w_qG_q), then Uˉq=pUTpˉq\bar U_q=p_U^T\bar p_q and the reconstruction weights scatter it to the stored states.

第 8 节Section 8

前向传播：把每一步变成乘积法则

Tangent propagation: apply the product rule at every step

本节实验：一次 tangent 计算给出残差对指定方向的变化，不是已经求出了状态对设计的敏感度。比较第 10 节的线性求解。

Experiment: One tangent application gives the residual change along a supplied direction. It is not yet the solved state sensitivity; compare the linear solve in Section 10.

给状态切向量 U˙=v\dot U=v 和设计切向量 D˙\dot D，前向传播同时给出 R˙=RUv+RDD˙\dot R=R_Uv+R_D\dot D 与 Q˙=QUv+QDD˙\dot Q=Q_Uv+Q_D\dot D。先对重构加权和求导，再经过压力、声速、边界和通量，最后沿同样的面循环累加。对每个标量操作保存其输入和局部偏导，这就是本页自行实现的前向计算图。

For a state tangent U˙=v\dot U=v and a design tangent D˙\dot D, the tangent returns R˙=RUv+RDD˙\dot R=R_Uv+R_D\dot D and Q˙=QUv+QDD˙\dot Q=Q_Uv+Q_D\dot D. Differentiate reconstruction, pressure, sound speed, boundary closure and flux, then scatter in the primal face order. The self-contained scalar graph stores inputs and local derivatives for each arithmetic operation.

记号：x˙\dot x 是离散程序变量 xx 的前向（tangent）导数，xˉ\bar x 是它的反向（adjoint）累加权重，二者都是对本页离散代码求导；δ\delta 只用于附录 A 与附录 B 中连续函数的变分。伪代码与执行演示沿用 Tapenade 的命名：后缀 _d 表示 x˙\dot x（x_d）。Tapenade 用后缀 _b 表示 xˉ\bar x，但本页的 pbp_b 是背压，所以这里写作 x_bar。

Notation: x˙\dot x is the forward-mode (tangent) derivative of a discrete program variable xx and xˉ\bar x its reverse-mode (adjoint) accumulation weight; both differentiate this page’s discrete code. δ\delta is kept for variations of continuous functions in Appendices A and B. Pseudo-code and the execution players follow Tapenade’s names: the suffix _d marks x˙\dot x (x_d). Tapenade marks xˉ\bar x with _b, but on this page pbp_b is the back pressure, so the code here writes x_bar.

p˙=(γ−1)(e˙−um˙+u22ρ˙),c˙=c2(p˙p−ρ˙ρ).\dot p=(\gamma-1)\left(\dot e-u\dot m+\frac{u^2}{2}\dot\rho\right),\quad\dot c=\frac{c}{2}\left(\frac{\dot p}{p}-\frac{\dot\rho}{\rho}\right).
H˙=A˙fH^+Af[FU−U˙−+FU+U˙+2−α˙2(U+−U−)−α2(U˙+−U˙−)].\dot H=\dot A_f\widehat H+A_f\left[\frac{F_U^-\dot U^-+F_U^+\dot U^+}{2}-\frac{\dot\alpha}{2}(U^+-U^-)-\frac\alpha2(\dot U^+-\dot U^-)\right].

其中 Ĥ=HfH_f/AfA_f 是方括号内、单位面积上的数值通量。

Here Ĥ=HfH_f/AfA_f is the numerical flux per unit area inside the brackets.

S˙i=∑qwq{Aq′pUU˙i(xq)+pqA˙q′}.\dot S_i=\sum_qw_q\{A'_q p_U\dot U_i(x_q)+p_q\dot A'_q\}.
for operation in forward_order:
    z_d = sum(local_partial[z,input] * input_d)
# e.g. z=x*y: z_d=y*x_d+x*y_d
# reconstruction: Uf_d=sum(weight[j]*U_d[j])
# final rows use the differentiated boundary constraints

局部导数怎样组成全局 Jacobian

How local derivatives form the global Jacobian

固定网格和当前可微分支，把一个面的所有输入记为 zfz_f；它包括两侧的重构状态与面面积（边界面只读相邻的那一个状态与它的面积：边界数据 pbp_b、p0p_0、T0T_0 进入被替换的行，不进入任何面）。令 TfT_f、KfK_f 分别是 zfz_f 对存储状态和设计变量的导数，Hz,fH_{z,f} 是局部通量 Jacobian。于是每个残差行的导数按同一个有向面关联矩阵 ℬ\mathcal B 装配，这里的求和包括相应的边界通量映射（本页的这些求和是面循环的，即覆盖之前的残差 RrawR_{raw} 的）；被替换的边界行另按第 9 节处理。前向模式按计算顺序传播切向量，状态种子是 v≡𝐔˙v\equiv\dot{\mathbf U}，设计种子是 D˙\dot D：

At fixed mesh and differentiable branch, let zfz_f collect all face inputs: the reconstructed states of both sides and the face area (a boundary face reads only the state next to it and its area: the boundary data pbp_b, p0p_0 and T0T_0 enter the replaced rows, not the faces). Let TfT_f and KfK_f be the derivatives of zfz_f with respect to the stored states and the design variables, and Hz,fH_{z,f} the local flux Jacobian. Assemble each residual derivative with the same oriented face incidence ℬ\mathcal B, including the boundary flux maps (on this page these sums are those of the face loop, that is of the residual RrawR_{raw} before any row is overwritten); replaced boundary rows are handled in Section 9. Forward mode carries the tangents in the order of the computation, with the state seed v≡𝐔˙v\equiv\dot{\mathbf U} and the design seed D˙\dot D:

z˙f=Tfv+KfD˙,H˙f=Hz,fz˙f,\dot z_f=T_fv+K_f\dot D,\quad\dot H_f=H_{z,f}\dot z_f,
R˙raw,i=∑fℬifH˙f−e2S˙i,\dot R_{raw,i}=\sum_f\mathcal B_{if}\dot H_f-e_2\dot S_i,
(Jraw)ij=∑fℬifHz,f(Tf)j−e2∂Si∂Uj,(J_{raw})_{ij}=\sum_f\mathcal B_{if}H_{z,f}(T_f)_j-e_2\frac{\partial S_i}{\partial U_j},
(RD,raw)ik=∑fℬifHz,f(Kf)k−e2∂Si∂Dk.(R_{D,raw})_{ik}=\sum_f\mathcal B_{if}H_{z,f}(K_f)_k-e_2\frac{\partial S_i}{\partial D_k}.

无体源项时 Si=0S_i=0。本页的 SiS_i 是每个控制体上的一个标量，只进入第 ii 行的动量分量，e2e_2 标出这个分量。面面积插值与源项里的截面积随设计变化，这些依赖属于 zfz_f，不能只对状态求导。二阶重构使 TfT_f 连接更多邻居，因此精确 Jacobian 的模板变宽；matrix-free 仍只需依次执行这些局部乘积，不必存储全局矩阵。

Set Si=0S_i=0 when there is no volume source. On this page SiS_i is one scalar per control volume and enters only the momentum component of row ii, which e2e_2 marks. The areas in the face-area interpolation and in the source change with the design; that dependence belongs in zfz_f, so differentiating the states alone is insufficient. Second-order reconstruction connects TfT_f to more neighbours and widens the exact Jacobian stencil. Matrix-free evaluation performs these local products without storing the global matrix.

截面积的导数也是离散运算

Area differentiation is also a discrete operation

源项中写作 A′(xq)A'(x_q) 的量，是相邻设计截面积 AkA_k、Ak+1A_{k+1} 之间的分段线性斜率，不是对未知连续面积函数另求导。固定轴向网格时：

The A′(xq)A'(x_q) in the source is the piecewise linear slope between neighbouring design areas AkA_k and Ak+1A_{k+1}, not a separate derivative of an unknown continuous area function. On the fixed axial mesh:

GqA=Ak+1−Akh,G˙qA=A˙k+1−A˙kh,G_q^{A}=\frac{A_{k+1}-A_k}{h},\quad\dot G_q^{A}=\frac{\dot A_{k+1}-\dot A_k}{h},
Aˉk-=GˉqA/h,Aˉk+1+=GˉqA/h.\bar A_k\mathrel{\text{-=}}\bar G_q^{A}/h,\quad\bar A_{k+1}\mathrel{\text{+=}}\bar G_q^{A}/h.

面面积插值、压力求值及源项求积还有各自的导数路径；截面积对目标的直接影响也必须保留。二阶模式的重构权重不等于一阶模式，不能只换预处理器而沿用旧的精确算子。

Face-area interpolation, pressure evaluation and source quadrature have additional derivative paths; retain the direct area dependence in the objective too. Second-order reconstruction has different weights from first order, so changing only the preconditioner cannot update the exact operator.

从程序到切向量：面循环的四条语句逐条线性化

From program to tangent: linearise the four statements of the face loop one by one

上面的 z˙f\dot z_f、H˙f\dot H_f 与 R˙raw,i\dot R_{raw,i} 来自同一段短程序：残差代码对每个面依次执行四条语句。设 𝒮f\mathcal S_f 是面 ff 读取的存储位置（两侧的 LL、RR，以及重构需要时它们的邻居），把这些位置上的状态排成 𝐔f\mathbf U_f：

The z˙f\dot z_f, H˙f\dot H_f and R˙raw,i\dot R_{raw,i} above come from one short program: the residual code runs four statements on every face. Let 𝒮f\mathcal S_f be the stored locations that face ff reads (its two sides LL and RR, and their neighbours when the reconstruction needs them), and stack the states stored there as 𝐔f\mathbf U_f:

(1)𝐔f=𝒢f 𝐔,(1)\quad \mathbf U_f=\mathcal G_f\,\mathbf U,
(2)zf=zf(D,𝐔f),(2)\quad z_f=z_f(D,\mathbf U_f),
(3)Hf=H(zf),(3)\quad H_f=H(z_f),
(4)Rraw+=ℬ:,f Hf.(4)\quad R_{raw}\mathrel{\text{+=}}\mathcal B_{:,f}\,H_f.

（1）取值：𝒢f\mathcal G_f 的每一行只有一个 1，从全局数组里挑出 𝒮f\mathcal S_f 上的状态；（2）重构：由这些状态和设计变量算出面的全部输入 zfz_f，在本页是两侧的重构状态 Uf−U_f^-、Uf+U_f^+ 与面面积 AfA_f；（3）通量：Hf=H(zf)H_f=H(z_f)；（4）分发：ℬ:,f\mathcal B_{:,f} 是有向关联矩阵 ℬ\mathcal B 的第 ff 列，在第 LL 行为 +1+1、第 RR 行为 −1-1，即 Rraw,L+=HfR_{raw,L}\mathrel{\text{+=}}H_f、Rraw,R-=HfR_{raw,R}\mathrel{\text{-=}}H_f（边界面只写一行）；本页每个位置有 3 个分量，±1\pm1 代表 ±I\pm I。这四条语句是残差代码的骨架；本页代码里的每一条语句（含边界面与源项）都在本节里逐句写出，并附各自的切向量语句。

(1) Gather: each row of 𝒢f\mathcal G_f holds a single 1 and picks one state of 𝒮f\mathcal S_f out of the global array. (2) Reconstruct: the states and the design give all inputs zfz_f of the face, on this page the reconstructed states Uf−U_f^-, Uf+U_f^+ and the face area AfA_f. (3) Flux: Hf=H(zf)H_f=H(z_f). (4) Scatter: ℬ:,f\mathcal B_{:,f} is column ff of the oriented incidence ℬ\mathcal B, +1+1 in row LL and −1-1 in row RR, that is Rraw,L+=HfR_{raw,L}\mathrel{\text{+=}}H_f and Rraw,R-=HfR_{raw,R}\mathrel{\text{-=}}H_f (a boundary face writes one row); with 3 components per location, ±1\pm1 stands for ±I\pm I. These four statements are the skeleton of the residual code; every statement of this page's code, boundary faces and sources included, is written out with its tangent statement in this section.

前向模式对每条语句用一次链式法则：每条语句输出的切向量是它输入的切向量的线性组合，每个中间变量都有自己的切向量：

Forward mode applies the chain rule once per statement: the tangent of each output is a linear combination of the tangents of the statement's inputs, and every intermediate variable gets a tangent of its own:

(1)𝐔˙f=𝒢f 𝐔˙,(1)\quad \dot{\mathbf U}_f=\mathcal G_f\,\dot{\mathbf U},
(2)z˙f=Zf 𝐔˙f+Kf D˙,(2)\quad \dot z_f=Z_f\,\dot{\mathbf U}_f+K_f\,\dot D,
(3)H˙f=Hz,f z˙f,(3)\quad \dot H_f=H_{z,f}\,\dot z_f,
(4)R˙raw+=ℬ:,f H˙f,(4)\quad \dot R_{raw}\mathrel{\text{+=}}\mathcal B_{:,f}\,\dot H_f,
Zf=∂zf∂𝐔f,Kf=∂zf∂D,Hz,f=∂H∂zf.Z_f=\frac{\partial z_f}{\partial \mathbf U_f},\qquad K_f=\frac{\partial z_f}{\partial D},\qquad H_{z,f}=\frac{\partial H}{\partial z_f}.

取值与分发都是线性的，它们的切向量就是同样的取值与分发作用在切向量上；只有重构与通量两条语句带来依赖当前状态的局部导数 ZfZ_f、KfK_f 与 Hz,fH_{z,f}。把（1）代入（2），（2）代入（3），（3）代入（4），对所有面求和，再减去体源项的切向量 e2S˙e_2\dot S（e2e_2 把每个 SiS_i 放进它那一行的动量分量），就逐条语句得到 R˙raw=Jraw𝐔˙+RD,rawD˙\dot R_{raw}=J_{raw}\dot{\mathbf U}+R_{D,raw}\dot D：

Gather and scatter are linear: their tangents are the same gather and scatter applied to the tangents. Only the reconstruct and flux statements bring local derivatives that depend on the current state: ZfZ_f, KfK_f and Hz,fH_{z,f}. Substituting (1) into (2), (2) into (3) and (3) into (4), summing over all faces and subtracting the tangent e2S˙e_2\dot S of the volume source (e2e_2 puts each SiS_i into the momentum component of its row) assembles R˙raw=Jraw𝐔˙+RD,rawD˙\dot R_{raw}=J_{raw}\dot{\mathbf U}+R_{D,raw}\dot D statement by statement:

R˙raw=∑fℬ:,fHz,f(Zf𝒢f 𝐔˙+KfD˙)−e2S˙\dot R_{raw}=\sum_f\mathcal B_{:,f}H_{z,f}\big(Z_f\mathcal G_f\,\dot{\mathbf U}+K_f\dot D\big)-e_2\dot S
=(∑fℬ:,fHz,fZf𝒢f−e2∂S∂𝐔⏟Jraw)𝐔˙=\Big(\underbrace{\sum_f\mathcal B_{:,f}H_{z,f}Z_f\mathcal G_f-e_2\frac{\partial S}{\partial \mathbf U}}_{J_{raw}}\Big)\dot{\mathbf U}
+(∑fℬ:,fHz,fKf−e2∂S∂D⏟RD,raw)D˙.+\Big(\underbrace{\sum_f\mathcal B_{:,f}H_{z,f}K_f-e_2\frac{\partial S}{\partial D}}_{R_{D,raw}}\Big)\dot D.

上面的 TfT_f 就是 Zf𝒢fZ_f\mathcal G_f。所以一个面对 JrawJ_{raw} 的贡献是四个初等 Jacobian 的乘积

The TfT_f above is Zf𝒢fZ_f\mathcal G_f. One face therefore contributes to JrawJ_{raw} the product of four elementary Jacobians,

Jraw,f=ℬ:,f Hz,f Zf 𝒢f,J_{raw,f}=\mathcal B_{:,f}\,H_{z,f}\,Z_f\,\mathcal G_f,
Jraw,f𝐔˙=ℬ:,f(Hz,f(Zf(𝒢f 𝐔˙))).J_{raw,f}\dot{\mathbf U}=\mathcal B_{:,f}\Big(H_{z,f}\Big(Z_f\big(\mathcal G_f\,\dot{\mathbf U}\big)\Big)\Big).

它从右往左作用在 𝐔˙\dot{\mathbf U} 上，与程序执行的顺序相同：先取值，再重构、通量，最后分发。𝒮f\mathcal S_f 只有几个位置，所以 Jraw,fJ_{raw,f} 只有一小块非零，matrix-free 乘积就是按面执行这几次局部运算，不存储任何全局矩阵。下面的面板按这四条语句逐条播放本页一个面的数值。

It acts on 𝐔˙\dot{\mathbf U} from right to left, in the order in which the program runs: gather first, then reconstruct and flux, scatter last. 𝒮f\mathcal S_f holds only a few locations, so Jraw,fJ_{raw,f} has a small nonzero block, and the matrix-free product runs these local operations face by face without storing any global matrix. The panel below plays the four statements with the numbers of one face of this page.

所有面与源项的这些贡献加起来是替换之前的残差的切向量 Jrawv+RD,raw ekJ_{raw}v+R_{D,raw}\,e_k。它在保留的行上于收敛解处为零；在被替换的行上它不为零（那里模最大的一项是 −0.01626-0.01626），因为残差代码在面循环之后把这些行整行覆盖，覆盖之后的切向量是约束的切向量。下面前向求解的方程是整个方程组的：

Summed over all faces and the source terms, these contributions give the tangent of the raw residual, Jrawv+RD,raw ekJ_{raw}v+R_{D,raw}\,e_k. In the retained rows it vanishes at the converged solution; in the replaced rows it does not (its entry of largest magnitude there is −0.01626-0.01626), because the residual code overwrites those rows after the face loop and the tangent after the overwrite is the constraint's. The tangent equation solved further on is the system's:

R˙=MbcR˙raw+Ebcc˙bc,c˙bc=∂cbc∂𝐔 v+∂cbc∂D D˙,\dot R=M_{\mathrm{bc}}\dot R_{raw}+E_{\mathrm{bc}}\dot c_{\mathrm{bc}},\qquad \dot c_{\mathrm{bc}}=\frac{\partial c_{\mathrm{bc}}}{\partial \mathbf U}\,v+\frac{\partial c_{\mathrm{bc}}}{\partial D}\,\dot D,
Jv+RDD˙=Mbc(Jrawv+RD,rawD˙)Jv+R_D\dot D=M_{\mathrm{bc}}\big(J_{raw}v+R_{D,raw}\dot D\big)
+Ebcc˙bc=0.+E_{\mathrm{bc}}\dot c_{\mathrm{bc}}=0.

它与 core.js 运算记录对这个面的结果相差 1.1×10−161.1\times10^{-16}。整个扫描结束时 ∥R˙∥2=1.9×10−12\|\dot R\|_2=1.9\times10^{-12}；同一设计种子配 U˙=0\dot U=0 时，∥R˙∥2=∥RDD˙∥2=1.61\|\dot R\|_2=\|R_D\dot D\|_2=1.61。解出的切向量正好使所有面与控制体的贡献相互抵消（三条被替换的行除外，见下一段）——这就是切线方程 JU˙+RDD˙=0J\dot U+R_D\dot D=0。同时第 ⑨ 句累加出 Q˙=6.687323×10−4\dot Q=6.687323\times10^{-4}，即第 12 节梯度的分量 gA6g_{A_{6}}（伴随给出 6.687323×10−46.687323\times10^{-4}）。

It differs from the result of core.js’s tape for this face by 1.1×10−161.1\times10^{-16}. At the end of the sweep ∥R˙∥2=1.9×10−12\|\dot R\|_2=1.9\times10^{-12}, whereas the same design seed with U˙=0\dot U=0 gives ∥R˙∥2=∥RDD˙∥2=1.61\|\dot R\|_2=\|R_D\dot D\|_2=1.61. The solved tangent makes the contributions of all faces and volumes cancel exactly (except in the three replaced rows, see the next paragraph): this is the tangent equation JU˙+RDD˙=0J\dot U+R_D\dot D=0. Statement ⑨ accumulates Q˙=6.687323×10−4\dot Q=6.687323\times10^{-4} at the same time, the component gA6g_{A_{6}} of the gradient of Section 12 (the adjoint gives 6.687323×10−46.687323\times10^{-4}).

格点页有一点不同：①–⑩ 得到的是覆盖之前的残差 RrawR_{raw} 的切向量（上面共享推导里的 R˙raw=Jrawv+RD,rawD˙\dot R_{raw}=J_{raw}v+R_{D,raw}\dot D），它在三条被替换的行（第 0、1、3N3N 行）上不为零（这里最大为 0.0160.016，其余各行合起来只有 1.9×10−121.9\times10^{-12}）；⑪ 就是上面共享推导里的覆盖语句（5），它用约束的切向量覆盖这三行，解出的切向量使覆盖后的三个分量为零。所以切线方程 JU˙+RDD˙=0J\dot U+R_D\dot D=0 的三条约束行由 ⑪ 给出，其余各行由 ①–⑩ 给出。

The node page differs in one point: ①–⑩ give the tangent of the raw residual RrawR_{raw}, before any row is overwritten (the R˙raw=Jrawv+RD,rawD˙\dot R_{raw}=J_{raw}v+R_{D,raw}\dot D of the shared derivation above), which is not zero in the three replaced rows (rows 0, 1 and 3N3N): here at most 0.0160.016, against 1.9×10−121.9\times10^{-12} in all the other rows together. ⑪ is the overwrite (5) of that derivation: it replaces those rows with the tangents of the constraints, which the solved tangent makes zero. So the three constraint rows of the tangent equation JU˙+RDD˙=0J\dot U+R_D\dot D=0 come from ⑪ and the other rows from ①–⑩.

图 6 逐句播放这一扫描：先是全部面（第 ①–⑥ 句），再是全部控制体（第 ⑦–⑩ 句），最后是三条边界行（第 ⑪ 句）。可以选择设计种子（任一截面积或边界数据）与状态种子：U˙=0\dot U=0 时扫描结束于右端项 RDD˙R_D\dot D，一个截面积只触及用到它的面和它两侧区间的控制体；U˙\dot U 取第 10 节解出的切向量时，所有贡献相互抵消，R˙\dot R 结束于零（格点页要等 ⑪ 覆盖了三条被替换的行之后）。

Figure 6 plays this sweep statement by statement: all faces first (statements ①–⑥), then all volumes (⑦–⑩), then the three boundary rows (⑪). Choose the design seed (any area or boundary datum) and the state seed: with U˙=0\dot U=0 the sweep ends at the right-hand side RDD˙R_D\dot D, and an area touches only the faces that read it and the volumes of the two intervals beside it; with U˙\dot U set to the tangent solved in Section 10 every contribution cancels and R˙\dot R ends at zero (on the node page once ⑪ has overwritten the three replaced rows).

第 9 节Section 9

伴随传播：同一条依赖链反向累加

Adjoint propagation: reverse the same dependency graph

本节实验：只给一个输出非零权重，预测反向影响能传到哪些输入；共享输入应累加所有路径。

Experiment: Seed one output and predict which inputs receive reverse contributions. Shared inputs accumulate every path.

反向传播接受残差种子 Rˉ\bar R（常记作 w）和目标种子 Qˉ\bar Q，返回 Uˉ=RUTRˉ+QUTQˉ\bar U=R_U^T\bar R+Q_U^T\bar Q 与 Dˉ=RDTRˉ+QDTQˉ\bar D=R_D^T\bar R+Q_D^T\bar Q。在内部面，H 的种子为 RˉL−RˉR\bar R_L-\bar R_R；源项 S 的种子为 −Rˉi,m-\bar R_{i,m}。二阶面状态的伴随通过重构权重散回多个节点。共享输入必须用 += 累加，不能用赋值覆盖另一条路径；语句按原始计算的逆序执行。

A reverse sweep takes a residual seed Rˉ\bar R (often called w) and an objective seed Qˉ\bar Q, and returns Uˉ=RUTRˉ+QUTQˉ\bar U=R_U^T\bar R+Q_U^T\bar Q and Dˉ=RDTRˉ+QDTQˉ\bar D=R_D^T\bar R+Q_D^T\bar Q. An internal face receives the seed RˉL−RˉR\bar R_L-\bar R_R; a source receives −Rˉi,m-\bar R_{i,m}. Second-order trace adjoints scatter through reconstruction weights to several states. Shared inputs accumulate every path with += instead of being overwritten, and the statements run in the reverse of the primal order.

Hˉf=RˉL−RˉR,Uˉj+=WfjTUˉf,Sˉi=−Rˉi,m,RˉTR˙=UˉTU˙.\bar H_f=\bar R_L-\bar R_R,\quad \bar U_j\mathrel{\text{+=}}W_{fj}^T\bar U_f,\quad \bar S_i=-\bar R_{i,m},\quad \bar R^T\dot R=\bar U^T\dot U.

强边界行反传时，先把这三行的种子 Rˉr\bar R_r 送入边界约束，再令旧守恒行的种子 Rˉr←0\bar R_r\leftarrow0，之后才反传源项和面通量。否则会把已经被覆盖的旧行又加回导数。

For strong boundary rows, first send the seeds Rˉr\bar R_r of these three rows into the boundary constraints, then set the overwritten balance-row seeds Rˉr←0\bar R_r\leftarrow0, and only then reverse sources and faces. Otherwise derivatives of erased rows would be reintroduced.
