for operation in reverse_order:
    for input in operation.inputs:
        input_bar += local_partial * z_bar
    z_bar = 0
# z=x*y: x_bar += y*z_bar; y_bar += x*z_bar
#        z_bar = 0
# second-order reconstruction: U_bar[j] += weight[j]*Uf_bar

为什么反向累加给出矩阵转置

Why reverse accumulation gives the matrix transpose

把所有残差和状态分量展平后，下面只是交换两个有限求和的次序。残差种子 Rˉ\bar R 是任意给定的，尚未求解伴随方程；只有选择满足第 11 节线性方程的 Rˉ=ψ\bar R=\psi，才得到该目标对应的离散伴随解。取 D˙=0\dot D=0、𝐔˙=v\dot{\mathbf U}=v，前向得到 R˙=Jv\dot R=Jv；以 Rˉ\bar R 为种子反向扫描，得到 𝐔ˉ=JTRˉ\bar{\mathbf U}=J^T\bar R。下式就是 AD 的对偶（点积）恒等式：

After flattening all residual and state components, the following simply exchanges two finite sums. The residual seed Rˉ\bar R is arbitrary and has not solved an adjoint equation; only Rˉ=ψ\bar R=\psi satisfying Section 11 gives the discrete adjoint solution for the chosen objective. With D˙=0\dot D=0 and 𝐔˙=v\dot{\mathbf U}=v the forward sweep gives R˙=Jv\dot R=Jv; the reverse sweep seeded with Rˉ\bar R gives 𝐔ˉ=JTRˉ\bar{\mathbf U}=J^T\bar R. The identity below is the duality (dot-product) identity of AD:

RˉTR˙=RˉT(Jv)=∑r=1nu∑j=1nuRˉr∂Rr∂Ujvj\bar R^T\dot R=\bar R^T(Jv)=\sum_{r=1}^{n_u}\sum_{j=1}^{n_u}\bar R_r\frac{\partial R_r}{\partial U_j}v_j
=∑j=1nuvj(∑r=1nu∂Rr∂UjRˉr)=vT(JTRˉ)=𝐔˙T𝐔ˉ.=\sum_{j=1}^{n_u}v_j\left(\sum_{r=1}^{n_u}\frac{\partial R_r}{\partial U_j}\bar R_r\right)=v^T(J^T\bar R)=\dot{\mathbf U}^T\bar{\mathbf U}.

本页的残差代码在面循环与源项之后还有一条语句（5）：把三行守恒方程覆盖为边界约束 cbcc_{\mathrm{bc}}，即第一个节点的第 0、1 行覆盖为 p0(U0)−p0p_0(U_0)-p_0 与 T0(U0)−T0T_0(U_0)-T_0，最后一个节点的质量行（第 3N3N 行）覆盖为 p(UN)−pbp(U_N)-p_b。MbcM_{\mathrm{bc}} 是保留行的对角掩码，EbcE_{\mathrm{bc}} 把 cbcc_{\mathrm{bc}} 放入被替换的行，它们在固定网格拓扑上是常矩阵；覆盖之前的残差、Jacobian 与设计 Jacobian 记作 RrawR_{raw}、JrawJ_{raw}、RD,rawR_{D,raw}，面循环与源项写出的就是它们。

The residual code of the node page has one more statement (5) after the face loop and the sources: it overwrites three balance rows by the boundary constraints cbcc_{\mathrm{bc}}, namely rows 0 and 1 of the first node by p0(U0)−p0p_0(U_0)-p_0 and T0(U0)−T0T_0(U_0)-T_0 and the mass row of the last node (row 3N3N) by p(UN)−pbp(U_N)-p_b. MbcM_{\mathrm{bc}} masks the retained rows and EbcE_{\mathrm{bc}} inserts cbcc_{\mathrm{bc}} into the replaced rows; both are constant for fixed topology. The residual, Jacobian and design Jacobian before the overwrite are RrawR_{raw}, JrawJ_{raw} and RD,rawR_{D,raw}, and the face loop and the sources write exactly these.

这条语句最后执行，所以它的反向语句（5′）最先执行：种子 Rˉ\bar R 分成两部分，保留行的部分 Rˉraw=MbcRˉ\bar R_{raw}=M_{\mathrm{bc}}\bar R 交给转置的面循环与源项，被替换的行的部分 cˉbc=EbcTRˉ\bar c_{\mathrm{bc}}=E_{\mathrm{bc}}^T\bar R 交给约束，𝐔ˉ\bar{\mathbf U} 与 Dˉ\bar D 各加上它的状态路径与设计路径；设计路径在本页就是 pˉ0-=Rˉ0\bar p_0\mathrel{\text{-=}}\bar R_0、Tˉ0-=Rˉ1\bar T_0\mathrel{\text{-=}}\bar R_1、pˉb-=Rˉ3N\bar p_b\mathrel{\text{-=}}\bar R_{3N}（这三行里的设计导数是 −1-1）。完整转置必须包含约束的 Jacobian，而不是简单地把边界伴随设为零；被替换的行也不能把种子交给面循环与源项：第一个节点的动量行被 T0T_0 约束覆盖，写进这一行的源项因此得不到权重。

This statement runs last, so its reverse statement (5′) runs first: the seed Rˉ\bar R splits into the part of the retained rows, Rˉraw=MbcRˉ\bar R_{raw}=M_{\mathrm{bc}}\bar R, which goes to the transposed face loop and the sources, and the part of the replaced rows, cˉbc=EbcTRˉ\bar c_{\mathrm{bc}}=E_{\mathrm{bc}}^T\bar R, which goes to the constraints, and 𝐔ˉ\bar{\mathbf U} and Dˉ\bar D each receive its state path and its design path; on this page the design path is pˉ0-=Rˉ0\bar p_0\mathrel{\text{-=}}\bar R_0, Tˉ0-=Rˉ1\bar T_0\mathrel{\text{-=}}\bar R_1 and pˉb-=Rˉ3N\bar p_b\mathrel{\text{-=}}\bar R_{3N} (the design derivative is −1-1 in these three rows). The transpose includes the constraint Jacobian; it does not simply zero the boundary adjoints, and the replaced rows must not hand their seeds to the face loop or to the sources: the momentum row of the first node is overwritten by the T0T_0 constraint, so a source written into that row receives no weight.

R=MbcRraw+Ebccbc,R=M_{\mathrm{bc}}R_{raw}+E_{\mathrm{bc}}c_{\mathrm{bc}},
J=MbcJraw+Ebc∂cbc∂𝐔,J=M_{\mathrm{bc}}J_{raw}+E_{\mathrm{bc}}\frac{\partial c_{\mathrm{bc}}}{\partial \mathbf U},
𝐔ˉ=JTRˉ=JrawTMbcTRˉ+(∂cbc∂𝐔)TEbcTRˉ.\bar{\mathbf U}=J^T\bar R=J_{raw}^TM_{\mathrm{bc}}^T\bar R+\Big(\frac{\partial c_{\mathrm{bc}}}{\partial \mathbf U}\Big)^TE_{\mathrm{bc}}^T\bar R.

内部面通量向左加、向右减，所以先把这两条路径合并成通量的伴随 Hˉf\bar H_f；之后按通量、重构、原始状态的相反依赖顺序传播。反向语句中的 += 很重要：同一状态会被多个面和多个求积点读取，这些贡献必须累加。这里没有分部积分，也没有另行猜测连续伴随边界条件。

An interior flux is added on the left and subtracted on the right, so combine those two paths into its adjoint Hˉf\bar H_f before reversing fluxes, reconstruction and stored states. The += is essential: multiple faces and quadrature points read the same state, and their contributions must accumulate. There is no integration by parts and no separately guessed continuous adjoint boundary condition.

Rraw,L+=Hf, Rraw,R-=HfR_{raw,L}\mathrel{\text{+=}}H_f,\ R_{raw,R}\mathrel{\text{-=}}H_f
⟹Hˉf=Rˉraw,L−Rˉraw,R,\Longrightarrow\quad\bar H_f=\bar R_{raw,L}-\bar R_{raw,R},
z˙f=∑j∈𝒮f(Tf)j U˙j+KfD˙\dot z_f=\sum_{j\in\mathcal S_f}(T_f)_j\,\dot U_j+K_f\dot D
⟹Uˉj+=(Tf)jT zˉf.\Longrightarrow\quad\bar U_j\mathrel{\text{+=}}(T_f)_j^T\,\bar z_f.

第 8 节局部链里的每个切向量都有对应的伴随。反向语句按与前向相反的顺序执行，每个输入的横线量都用 += 累加：

Every tangent of the local chain of Section 8 has its adjoint. The reverse statements run in the opposite order of the forward ones, and the bar of every input accumulates with +=:

𝐔ˉ←0, Dˉ←0;Hˉf=∑iℬifRˉraw,i,\bar{\mathbf U}\leftarrow0,\ \bar D\leftarrow0;\quad \bar H_f=\sum_i\mathcal B_{if}\bar R_{raw,i},
Sˉi=−Rˉraw,i,m,zˉf=Hz,fTHˉf,\bar S_i=-\bar R_{raw,i,m},\quad \bar z_f=H_{z,f}^T\bar H_f,
𝐔ˉ+=TfTzˉf+(∂S∂𝐔)TSˉ,\bar{\mathbf U}\mathrel{\text{+=}}T_f^T\bar z_f+\Big(\frac{\partial S}{\partial \mathbf U}\Big)^T\bar S,
Dˉ+=KfTzˉf+(∂S∂D)TSˉ.\bar D\mathrel{\text{+=}}K_f^T\bar z_f+\Big(\frac{\partial S}{\partial D}\Big)^T\bar S.

从切向量到伴随：转置把语句顺序反过来

From tangent to adjoint: the transpose runs the statements backwards

一个面的切向量是四个初等 Jacobian 的乘积。乘积的转置等于各个因子的转置按相反的顺序相乘：

The tangent of one face is the product of four elementary Jacobians. The transpose of a product is the product of the transposes in the reverse order:

Jraw,fT=(ℬ:,f Hz,f Zf 𝒢f)T=𝒢fT ZfT Hz,fT ℬ:,fT,J_{raw,f}^T=\big(\mathcal B_{:,f}\,H_{z,f}\,Z_f\,\mathcal G_f\big)^T=\mathcal G_f^T\,Z_f^T\,H_{z,f}^T\,\mathcal B_{:,f}^T,
(ℬ:,f Hz,f Kf)T=KfT Hz,fT ℬ:,fT.\big(\mathcal B_{:,f}\,H_{z,f}\,K_f\big)^T=K_f^T\,H_{z,f}^T\,\mathcal B_{:,f}^T.

仍从右往左读，这就是反向扫描的语句顺序：程序最后执行的分发最先处理，最先执行的取值最后处理。先把所有伴随置零，再以 Rˉ\bar R 为种子逐条执行；覆盖（5）在整个面循环之后执行，所以它的反向语句（5′）排在最前：

Read again from right to left, this is the order of the reverse sweep: the scatter, which the program ran last, comes first, and the gather, which it ran first, comes last. Zero every adjoint, seed with Rˉ\bar R, and run; the overwrite (5) ran after the whole face loop, so its reverse statement (5′) comes first:

(0)𝐔ˉ←0,  Dˉ←0,(0)\quad \bar{\mathbf U}\leftarrow0,\ \ \bar D\leftarrow0,
(5′)Rˉraw=MbcRˉ,cˉbc=EbcTRˉ,(5')\quad \bar R_{raw}=M_{\mathrm{bc}}\bar R,\quad \bar c_{\mathrm{bc}}=E_{\mathrm{bc}}^T\bar R,
𝐔ˉ+=(∂cbc∂𝐔)Tcˉbc,Dˉ+=(∂cbc∂D)Tcˉbc.\bar{\mathbf U}\mathrel{\text{+=}}\Big(\frac{\partial c_{\mathrm{bc}}}{\partial \mathbf U}\Big)^T\bar c_{\mathrm{bc}},\quad \bar D\mathrel{\text{+=}}\Big(\frac{\partial c_{\mathrm{bc}}}{\partial D}\Big)^T\bar c_{\mathrm{bc}}.
(4′)Hˉf=ℬ:,fTRˉraw=Rˉraw,L−Rˉraw,R,(4')\quad \bar H_f=\mathcal B_{:,f}^T\bar R_{raw}=\bar R_{raw,L}-\bar R_{raw,R},
(3′)zˉf=Hz,fT Hˉf,(3')\quad \bar z_f=H_{z,f}^T\,\bar H_f,
(2′)𝐔ˉf=ZfT zˉf,Dˉ+=KfT zˉf,(2')\quad \bar{\mathbf U}_f=Z_f^T\,\bar z_f,\quad \bar D\mathrel{\text{+=}}K_f^T\,\bar z_f,
(1′)𝐔ˉ+=𝒢fT 𝐔ˉf.(1')\quad \bar{\mathbf U}\mathrel{\text{+=}}\mathcal G_f^T\,\bar{\mathbf U}_f.

面循环结束后，源项的一对也按同样的规则反过来：Sˉi=−Rˉraw,i,m\bar S_i=-\bar R_{raw,i,m}，𝐔ˉ+=(∂S/∂𝐔)TSˉ\bar{\mathbf U}\mathrel{\text{+=}}(\partial S/\partial \mathbf U)^T\bar S，Dˉ+=(∂S/∂D)TSˉ\bar D\mathrel{\text{+=}}(\partial S/\partial D)^T\bar S；被替换的行已由上面的（5′）处理：它们的种子不进入面循环，写进这些行的源项因此得不到权重。本页代码里每一条语句的伴随语句（顺序与前向相反）也都在本节里逐句写出。

After the face loop the source is reversed by the same rule: Sˉi=−Rˉraw,i,m\bar S_i=-\bar R_{raw,i,m}, 𝐔ˉ+=(∂S/∂𝐔)TSˉ\bar{\mathbf U}\mathrel{\text{+=}}(\partial S/\partial \mathbf U)^T\bar S, Dˉ+=(∂S/∂D)TSˉ\bar D\mathrel{\text{+=}}(\partial S/\partial D)^T\bar S; the replaced rows were handled by (5′) above: their seeds do not enter the face loop, so a source written into such a row receives no weight. The adjoint statement of every statement of this page's code, in the reverse order, is written out in this section as well.

分发与取值互为转置。分发 Rraw+=ℬ:,fHfR_{raw}\mathrel{\text{+=}}\mathcal B_{:,f}H_f 把一个面通量写进两行；它的转置 Hˉf=ℬ:,fTRˉraw\bar H_f=\mathcal B_{:,f}^T\bar R_{raw} 从这两行读回一个数，是一次取值。取值 𝐔f=𝒢f𝐔\mathbf U_f=\mathcal G_f\mathbf U 从全局数组读出几个状态；它的转置 𝒢fT\mathcal G_f^T 把它们的伴随加回原来的位置，是一次带累加的分发。

Scatter and gather are transposes of each other. The scatter Rraw+=ℬ:,fHfR_{raw}\mathrel{\text{+=}}\mathcal B_{:,f}H_f writes one face flux into two rows; its transpose Hˉf=ℬ:,fTRˉraw\bar H_f=\mathcal B_{:,f}^T\bar R_{raw} reads those two rows back into one number: a gather. The gather 𝐔f=𝒢f𝐔\mathbf U_f=\mathcal G_f\mathbf U reads a few states out of the global array; its transpose 𝒢fT\mathcal G_f^T adds their adjoints back into their places: a scatter with accumulation.

为什么要先置零、再用 += 累加：程序里的一次扇出（一个值被多处读取）在反向扫描里变成扇入。一个存储状态属于它每个相邻面的 𝒮f\mathcal S_f，设计变量也进入许多面与源项；链式法则对变量的每一次使用各给出一项，xˉ\bar x 是所有这些项的和：

Why zero first and then +=: a fan-out of the program (one value read in several places) becomes a fan-in of the reverse sweep. A stored state belongs to the 𝒮f\mathcal S_f of every neighbouring face, and the design enters many faces and the sources; the chain rule gives one term per use of a variable, and xˉ\bar x is the sum of all these terms:

Uˉj=∑f: j∈𝒮f(𝒢fT 𝐔ˉf)j+(∂S∂Uj)TSˉ.\bar U_j=\sum_{f:\ j\in\mathcal S_f}\big(\mathcal G_f^T\,\bar{\mathbf U}_f\big)_j+\Big(\frac{\partial S}{\partial U_j}\Big)^T\bar S.

xˉ←0\bar x\leftarrow0 让这个和从零开始，每个 += 加上一次使用的贡献。反过来，程序里的扇入（Rraw,LR_{raw,L} 收集它各个面的通量）在反向扫描里变成扇出：Rˉraw,L\bar R_{raw,L} 只被读取，不需要累加。

xˉ←0\bar x\leftarrow0 starts this sum at zero, and each += adds the term of one use. Conversely, a fan-in of the program (Rraw,LR_{raw,L} collecting the fluxes of all its faces) becomes a fan-out of the reverse sweep: Rˉraw,L\bar R_{raw,L} is only read and needs no accumulation.

对偶恒等式的逐步证明，以及它的数值形式：点积测试

The duality identity step by step, and its numerical form: the dot-product test

把同一个面的前向语句与反向语句配对。每一步只用一次转置的定义 ⟨xˉ,ℰx˙⟩=⟨ℰTxˉ,x˙⟩\langle\bar x,\mathcal E\dot x\rangle=\langle\mathcal E^T\bar x,\dot x\rangle，把一个初等 Jacobian 从内积的右边移到左边，所以内积在每一级都相同：

Pair the forward and reverse statements of the same face. Each step uses the definition of the transpose once, ⟨xˉ,ℰx˙⟩=⟨ℰTxˉ,x˙⟩\langle\bar x,\mathcal E\dot x\rangle=\langle\mathcal E^T\bar x,\dot x\rangle, to move one elementary Jacobian from the right of the inner product to the left, so the inner product is the same at every stage:

RˉrawT(ℬ:,f H˙f)=(ℬ:,fTRˉraw)TH˙f=HˉfTH˙f,\bar R_{raw}^T\big(\mathcal B_{:,f}\,\dot H_f\big)=\big(\mathcal B_{:,f}^T\bar R_{raw}\big)^T\dot H_f=\bar H_f^T\dot H_f,
HˉfTH˙f=HˉfTHz,f z˙f=(Hz,fTHˉf)Tz˙f=zˉfTz˙f,\bar H_f^T\dot H_f=\bar H_f^TH_{z,f}\,\dot z_f=\big(H_{z,f}^T\bar H_f\big)^T\dot z_f=\bar z_f^T\dot z_f,
zˉfTz˙f=zˉfT(Zf𝐔˙f+KfD˙)\bar z_f^T\dot z_f=\bar z_f^T\big(Z_f\dot{\mathbf U}_f+K_f\dot D\big)
=𝐔ˉfT𝐔˙f+(KfTzˉf)TD˙,=\bar{\mathbf U}_f^T\dot{\mathbf U}_f+\big(K_f^T\bar z_f\big)^T\dot D,
𝐔ˉfT𝐔˙f=𝐔ˉfT𝒢f 𝐔˙=(𝒢fT𝐔ˉf)T𝐔˙.\bar{\mathbf U}_f^T\dot{\mathbf U}_f=\bar{\mathbf U}_f^T\mathcal G_f\,\dot{\mathbf U}=\big(\mathcal G_f^T\bar{\mathbf U}_f\big)^T\dot{\mathbf U}.

对所有面求和，再加上源项的一对 SˉTS˙\bar S^T\dot S（Sˉi=−Rˉraw,i,m\bar S_i=-\bar R_{raw,i,m}），右边的两项正好累加成反向扫描的输出 𝐔ˉ\bar{\mathbf U} 与 Dˉ\bar D：

Summed over all faces, with the pair of the source added (SˉTS˙\bar S^T\dot S with Sˉi=−Rˉraw,i,m\bar S_i=-\bar R_{raw,i,m}), the two terms on the right accumulate exactly into the outputs 𝐔ˉ\bar{\mathbf U} and Dˉ\bar D of the reverse sweep:

RˉrawTR˙raw=𝐔ˉT𝐔˙+DˉTD˙.\bar R_{raw}^T\dot R_{raw}=\bar{\mathbf U}^T\dot{\mathbf U}+\bar D^T\dot D.

被替换的行再加上它们约束的一对 cˉbcTc˙bc\bar c_{\mathrm{bc}}^T\dot c_{\mathrm{bc}}（c˙bc\dot c_{\mathrm{bc}} 是切向量一节里覆盖语句的切向量）：它正是（5′）里约束的状态路径与设计路径对 𝐔ˉT𝐔˙+DˉTD˙\bar{\mathbf U}^T\dot{\mathbf U}+\bar D^T\dot D 的贡献；所以同一个恒等式对本页的方程组也成立（𝐔ˉ\bar{\mathbf U} 与 Dˉ\bar D 取整个反向扫描结束时的值），下面的测试用的就是它：

The replaced rows add the pair of their constraints, cˉbcTc˙bc\bar c_{\mathrm{bc}}^T\dot c_{\mathrm{bc}} (c˙bc\dot c_{\mathrm{bc}} is the tangent of the overwrite in the tangent section): it is exactly what the state path and the design path of the constraints in (5′) contribute to 𝐔ˉT𝐔˙+DˉTD˙\bar{\mathbf U}^T\dot{\mathbf U}+\bar D^T\dot D. The same identity therefore holds for this page's system (𝐔ˉ\bar{\mathbf U} and Dˉ\bar D taken at the end of the whole reverse sweep), and the test below uses that system:

RˉTR˙=RˉrawTR˙raw+cˉbcTc˙bc=𝐔ˉT𝐔˙+DˉTD˙.\bar R^T\dot R=\bar R_{raw}^T\dot R_{raw}+\bar c_{\mathrm{bc}}^T\dot c_{\mathrm{bc}}=\bar{\mathbf U}^T\dot{\mathbf U}+\bar D^T\dot D.

这就是 AD 的点积测试：任取种子 (𝐔˙,D˙)(\dot{\mathbf U},\dot D) 与 Rˉ\bar R，前向扫描算出 R˙\dot R，反向扫描算出 (𝐔ˉ,Dˉ)(\bar{\mathbf U},\bar D)，两边之差应在舍入误差量级；只要有一条反向语句的转置写错，差就是 O(1)O(1) 的。本页在构建时用它自己的 matrix-free 前向与反向乘积（nu=39n_u=39 个分量的确定性种子，设计方向取下面算例的 DkD_k）做了这个测试：RˉTR˙=17.220812929\bar R^T\dot R=17.220812929，𝐔ˉT𝐔˙+DˉTD˙=17.220812929\bar{\mathbf U}^T\dot{\mathbf U}+\bar D^T\dot D=17.220812929，相对差 2×10−162\times10^{-16}。

This is the dot-product test of AD: take any seeds (𝐔˙,D˙)(\dot{\mathbf U},\dot D) and Rˉ\bar R, run the forward sweep for R˙\dot R and the reverse sweep for (𝐔ˉ,Dˉ)(\bar{\mathbf U},\bar D); the two sides must agree to round-off, and a single wrong transpose in the reverse statements gives an O(1)O(1) difference. This page ran the test on its own matrix-free forward and reverse products at build time (deterministic seeds with nu=39n_u=39 components, the design direction the DkD_k of the example below): RˉTR˙=17.220812929\bar R^T\dot R=17.220812929 and 𝐔ˉT𝐔˙+DˉTD˙=17.220812929\bar{\mathbf U}^T\dot{\mathbf U}+\bar D^T\dot D=17.220812929, a relative difference of 2×10−162\times10^{-16}.

逐句的伴随：逆序与累加

The adjoint, statement by statement: reverse order and accumulation

伴随把上一节的语句表倒过来执行：从最后一句开始，每一句把它输出的横线量乘以局部偏导数，用 += 累加到它的每个输入上；第 3、4 节的矩阵在这里以转置出现。

The adjoint executes the statement table of the previous section backwards: starting from the last statement, each multiplies the bar of its output by its local partial derivatives and accumulates the result into every input with +=; the matrices of Sections 3 and 4 appear transposed.

##伴随语句（逆序，累加 +=）adjoint statement (reverse order, accumulate +=)

表中有两类语句。⑥ 与 ⑩ 是累加（RL+=HfR_L\mathrel{\text{+=}}H_f、Ri,m-=SiR_{i,m}\mathrel{\text{-=}}S_i）：正如上面“从切向量到伴随”所说，程序里的扇入在反向扫描里变成扇出，所以它们的伴随只读取 Rˉ\bar R，不把它清零；⑧、⑨ 对 Sˉi\bar S_i 与 Qˉ\bar Q 也是如此。只有覆盖赋值——本页的 ⑪——在反传后把种子清零。把累加当成覆盖会丢掉路径：例如处理完源项就把 Rˉi,m\bar R_{i,m} 清零，面通量就再也得不到这一行的种子；把覆盖当成累加，则会把已擦除的守恒行重新算进来。格点页的 ⑪ 就是上面共享推导里的覆盖语句（5），它的反向语句（5′）最先执行：三条被替换的行的种子已送进约束并清零，后面的 ⑩ 与 ⑥ 读到的就是掩码后的种子 Rˉraw=MbcRˉ\bar R_{raw}=M_{\mathrm{bc}}\bar R。所以节点 0 的源项得到 Sˉ0=−Rˉraw,0,m=0\bar S_0=-\bar R_{raw,0,m}=0（它的动量行是被替换的第 1 行），面 0 的 Hˉf\bar H_f 只剩节点 0 种子的能量分量（质量与动量分量已被 ⑪ 清零）。

The table has two kinds of statement. ⑥ and ⑩ accumulate (RL+=HfR_L\mathrel{\text{+=}}H_f, Ri,m-=SiR_{i,m}\mathrel{\text{-=}}S_i): as “From tangent to adjoint” above explains, a fan-in of the program becomes a fan-out of the reverse sweep, so their adjoints only read Rˉ\bar R and leave it; the same holds for Sˉi\bar S_i and Qˉ\bar Q in ⑧ and ⑨. Only an overwrite, ⑪ on this page, zeroes its seed after the reverse step. Treating an accumulation as an overwrite loses paths: zeroing Rˉi,m\bar R_{i,m} after the source, for instance, would leave the face fluxes without the seed of that row; treating an overwrite as an accumulation brings erased balance rows back. On the node page ⑪ is the overwrite (5) of the shared derivation above, so its reverse statement (5′) runs first: the seeds of the three replaced rows have been sent into the constraints and zeroed, so ⑩ and ⑥ read the masked seed Rˉraw=MbcRˉ\bar R_{raw}=M_{\mathrm{bc}}\bar R. The source of node 0 therefore gets Sˉ0=−Rˉraw,0,m=0\bar S_0=-\bar R_{raw,0,m}=0 (its momentum row is the replaced row 1), and Hˉf\bar H_f of face 0 keeps only the energy component of the seed of node 0 (the mass and momentum components were zeroed by ⑪).

经第 ②① 句的重构权重散回存储状态后，它们与运算记录对这个面的反传结果相差 8.7×10−198.7\times10^{-19}（面积分量相差 00）。所有语句执行完，𝐔ˉ=JTψ+QUT\bar{\mathbf U}=J^T\psi+Q_U^T 的范数为 1.2×10−121.2\times10^{-12}，这是伴随方程的残差；Dˉ\bar D 与梯度 gg 相差 7.8×10−187.8\times10^{-18}。边界行的伴随（⑪）见第 4 节：它直接给出 gp0=−ψ0g_{p_0}=-\psi_0 等三个分量。

Scattered to the stored states by the reconstruction weights of ② and ①, they differ from the tape’s reverse of this face by 8.7×10−198.7\times10^{-19} (the area entries by 00). After all statements 𝐔ˉ=JTψ+QUT\bar{\mathbf U}=J^T\psi+Q_U^T has norm 1.2×10−121.2\times10^{-12}, the residual of the adjoint equation, and Dˉ\bar D differs from the gradient gg by 7.8×10−187.8\times10^{-18}. The adjoint of the boundary rows (⑪) is in Section 4: it gives gp0=−ψ0g_{p_0}=-\psi_0 and the two other components directly.

两个种子同时出现时，上面的对偶恒等式扩展为

With both seeds present, the duality identity above extends to

RˉTR˙+Qˉ Q˙=UˉTU˙+DˉTD˙.\bar R^T\dot R+\bar Q\,\dot Q=\bar U^T\dot U+\bar D^T\dot D.

它逐句成立，证明与上面“对偶恒等式的逐步证明”相同，只是这里对本页两张表的每一条语句都适用。图 8 用随机种子把两边逐项累加：两条折线的路径不同，终点相同。图 7 逐句播放 Rˉ=ψ\bar R=\psi、Qˉ=1\bar Q=1 的反向扫描：Uˉ\bar U 结束于伴随方程的残差（大小由线性求解的容差决定，不是舍入误差，数值见上），Dˉ\bar D 结束于梯度，并按路径着色。

It holds statement by statement, by the proof of “The duality identity step by step” above, here applied to every statement of the two tables of this page. Figure 8 accumulates the two sides term by term for random seeds: the two polylines take different paths and end at the same value. Figure 7 plays the reverse sweep of Rˉ=ψ\bar R=\psi, Qˉ=1\bar Q=1 statement by statement: Uˉ\bar U ends at the residual of the adjoint equation (its size is set by the tolerance of the linear solve, not by rounding; the value is given above) and Dˉ\bar D at the gradient, coloured by path.

第 10 节Section 10

前向方程的求解：一个设计方向一次线性求解

Tangent solve: one linear system per design direction

收敛方程 R(U(D),D)=0 对参数求导，得到 J UDU_D=−RDR_D。这里 J 是收敛状态处的精确算子，不是预处理矩阵 P。解出 UDU_D 后再计算 dQ/dD=QDQ_D+QUQ_U UDU_D。图中状态敏感度是一个解向量，和直接在任意 v 上做一次前向传播是两件不同的事。对一个设计方向 D˙\dot D，解出的状态切向量是 U˙=UDD˙\dot U=U_D\dot D；下面的推导记作 v，伪代码记作 x，即 v≡U˙v\equiv\dot U。

Differentiate the converged equation R(U(D),D)=0 to obtain J UDU_D=−RDR_D. J is the exact operator at the converged state, not preconditioner P. Then dQ/dD=QDQ_D+QUQ_U UDU_D. The plotted state sensitivity is a solved vector, distinct from a single tangent application to an arbitrary v. For one design direction D˙\dot D the solved state tangent is U˙=UDD˙\dot U=U_D\dot D; the derivation below calls it v and the pseudo-code x, so v≡U˙v\equiv\dot U.

JU˙=−RDD˙,r(k)=−RDD˙−JU˙(k),U˙(k+1)=U˙(k)+0.7Br(k).J\dot U=-R_D\dot D,\quad r^{(k)}=-R_D\dot D-J\dot U^{(k)},\quad\dot U^{(k+1)}=\dot U^{(k)}+0.7Br^{(k)}.
# D_d: design tangent; x = v = U_d: state tangent
rhs = -residual_d(U, U_d=0, D_d)
x = 0
repeat until norm(rhs-J_times(x)) < tolerance:
    x += 0.7 * twelve_GS_sweeps(P, rhs-J_times(x))
Q_d = objective_d(U, U_d=x, D_d)

把隐函数求导展开成可求解的系统

Expand implicit differentiation into a solvable system

设原始残差已经收敛，且当前光滑分支上的 JJ 非奇异。取设计种子（方向）D˙\dot D，令 D(t)=D+t D˙D(t)=D+t\,\dot D；前向求解得到的状态切向量是 v≡𝐔˙=ddt𝐔(D+t D˙)∣t=0v\equiv\dot{\mathbf U}=\frac{d}{dt}\mathbf U(D+t\,\dot D)\big|_{t=0}。对每一个残差分量逐项求导，零残差的切向量仍为零：

Assume the primal residual is converged and JJ is nonsingular on the current smooth branch. Choose a design seed (direction) D˙\dot D and set D(t)=D+t D˙D(t)=D+t\,\dot D; the state tangent returned by the tangent solve is v≡𝐔˙=ddt𝐔(D+t D˙)∣t=0v\equiv\dot{\mathbf U}=\frac{d}{dt}\mathbf U(D+t\,\dot D)\big|_{t=0}. Differentiate each residual component: the tangent of a zero residual is zero.

0=R˙r=∑j∂Rr∂Ujvj0=\dot R_r=\sum_j\frac{\partial R_r}{\partial U_j}v_j
+∑k∂Rr∂DkD˙k(1≤r≤nu)+\sum_k\frac{\partial R_r}{\partial D_k}\dot D_k\quad(1\le r\le n_u)
⟹Jv=−RD D˙.\Longrightarrow\quad Jv=-R_D\,\dot D.
Q^(D)=Q(𝐔(D),D),\widehat{Q}(D)=Q(\mathbf U(D),D),
Q˙=ddtQ^(D+t D˙)∣t=0=QUv+QD D˙.\dot Q=\frac{d}{dt}\widehat{Q}(D+t\,\dot D)\Big|_{t=0}=Q_Uv+Q_D\,\dot D.

实现分三步：状态种子 𝐔˙=0\dot{\mathbf U}=0、设计种子 D˙\dot D，前向求值残差得到 R˙=RD D˙\dot R=R_D\,\dot D；用精确 JJ 的乘积求解 vv；再以 𝐔˙=v\dot{\mathbf U}=v 和 D˙\dot D 为种子对目标前向求导，得到 Q˙\dot Q。一次 JvJv 只是算子调用（一次前向扫描），不是求解 vv。稳态导数的对象是收敛残差方程，不是 块 GS／GMRES 的迭代次数。在不可微点（如 limiter 的切换或分支判别处）以上普通导数需要另外讨论，不能无条件套用。

Implementation has three steps: seed the state with 𝐔˙=0\dot{\mathbf U}=0 and the design with D˙\dot D and evaluate the residual tangent R˙=RD D˙\dot R=R_D\,\dot D; solve for vv with exact JJ products; then differentiate the objective forward with the seeds 𝐔˙=v\dot{\mathbf U}=v and D˙\dot D to obtain Q˙\dot Q. One JvJv is an operator application (one forward sweep), not the solution vv. The steady derivative concerns the converged residual equation, not the block GS/GMRES iteration count. At nondifferentiable points (a limiter switch or a branch test) these ordinary derivatives need separate treatment.

用面循环的语句来看：右端 RDD˙R_D\dot D 是 𝐔˙=0\dot{\mathbf U}=0 时的一次前向扫描。它在保留的行上是面循环的 MbcRD,rawD˙M_{\mathrm{bc}}R_{D,raw}\dot D，只有 KfD˙K_f\dot D 与源项两条路径起作用；在被替换的行上是约束自己的设计路径，即第 0、1、3N3N 行里的 −p˙0-\dot p_0、−T˙0-\dot T_0、−p˙b-\dot p_b，任何面循环里都没有它：对边界数据 p0p_0、T0T_0 与 pbp_b，整个右端都来自这条路径（没有任何面读到它们，这三个分量的 RD,raw ek=0R_{D,raw}\,e_k=0）。迭代中的每个 JvJv 是 D˙=0\dot D=0 时的一次前向扫描：保留的行是面循环的，被替换的行是约束对状态的路径。一次前向求解的全部工作就是这段面循环与覆盖以不同的种子反复执行。对 nan_a 个设计分量逐个求导，要做 nan_a 次这样的求解。

In terms of the face loop's statements: the right-hand side RDD˙R_D\dot D is one forward sweep with 𝐔˙=0\dot{\mathbf U}=0. In the retained rows it is the face loop's MbcRD,rawD˙M_{\mathrm{bc}}R_{D,raw}\dot D, in which only the paths KfD˙K_f\dot D and the source are active; in the replaced rows it is the constraint's own design path, −p˙0-\dot p_0, −T˙0-\dot T_0 and −p˙b-\dot p_b in rows 0, 1 and 3N3N, which no face loop contains: for the boundary data p0p_0, T0T_0 and pbp_b the whole right-hand side comes from that path (no face reads them: RD,raw ek=0R_{D,raw}\,e_k=0 for these three components). Every JvJv of the iteration is one forward sweep with D˙=0\dot D=0: the face loop in the retained rows and the constraint's state path in the replaced rows. All the work of a tangent solve is this face loop and overwrite run again and again with different seeds, and the derivatives with respect to all nan_a design components take nan_a such solves.

一个设计种子的右端项

The right-hand side of one design seed

图 6 在 U˙=0\dot U=0 时算出的正是这里的 RDD˙R_D\dot D。截面积 AkA_k 只出现在读取它的面面积（节点 kk 两侧的面）、区间 k−1k-1 与 kk 的源项斜率和目标积分中，所以 RD ekR_D\,e_k 只有这些面和控制体的行非零：默认设置下 A6A_{6} 的列在 39 行中只有 7 行非零，属于控制体 5、6、7。pbp_b、p0p_0、T0T_0 只出现在三条边界行。右端项是稀疏的，解 U˙=−J−1RDD˙\dot U=-J^{-1}R_D\dot D 却在整个流道上都不为零：一个局部的设计变化会改变全部流动，所以每个设计分量都要一次完整的线性求解。

Figure 6 computes exactly the RDD˙R_D\dot D of this section when U˙=0\dot U=0. The area AkA_k appears only in the face areas that read it (the faces on either side of node kk), in the source slopes of the intervals k−1k-1 and kk, and in the objective integrals there, so only the rows of those faces and volumes are nonzero in RD ekR_D\,e_k: at the defaults the column of A6A_{6} has 7 nonzero rows out of 39, in volumes 5, 6, 7. pbp_b, p0p_0 and T0T_0 appear only in the three boundary rows. The right-hand side is sparse, yet the solution U˙=−J−1RDD˙\dot U=-J^{-1}R_D\dot D is nonzero along the whole duct: a local change of the design changes the whole flow, so every design component needs a complete linear solve.

第 11 节Section 11

伴随方程的求解：一次求解，全部设计变量

Adjoint solve: one solution for all design variables

采用离散 Lagrangian ℒ=Q+ψTR。令状态扰动系数为零，得到 JTψ=−QUTQ_U^T，然后 g=QDTQ_D^T+RDTR_D^Tψ。这个负号来自 ℒ 的约定，不能凭记忆同采用 Q−λR 的连续公式直接对照。附录 A 讨论连续参考；其内部对应还依赖变量、符号及残差尺度，不能把有限网格上的乘子直接等同于连续场。

Use the discrete Lagrangian ℒ=Q+ψTR. Cancelling the coefficient of the state tangent gives JTψ=−QUTQ_U^T and g=QDTQ_D^T+RDTR_D^Tψ. The minus sign follows from this convention. It cannot be compared blindly with a continuous Q−λR convention; Appendix A discusses the continuous reference; an interior correspondence also depends on variables, sign and residual scaling, not pointwise equality on a finite grid.

JTψ=−QUT,ra=−QUT−JTψ,ψ←ψ+0.7BTra,g=QDT+RDTψ.J^T\psi=-Q_U^T,\quad r_a=-Q_U^T-J^T\psi,\quad \psi\leftarrow\psi+0.7B^Tr_a,\quad g=Q_D^T+R_D^T\psi.

用第 9 节的记号：以 Rˉ=ψ\bar R=\psi、Qˉ=1\bar Q=1 为种子做一次反向传播，得到 Uˉ=JTψ+QUT\bar U=J^T\psi+Q_U^T，它正是伴随方程的真残差，解对时为零；同时得到 Dˉ=RDTψ+QDT=g\bar D=R_D^T\psi+Q_D^T=g，就是总梯度。

In the notation of Section 9, one reverse sweep with seeds Rˉ=ψ\bar R=\psi and Qˉ=1\bar Q=1 returns Uˉ=JTψ+QUT\bar U=J^T\psi+Q_U^T, the true residual of the adjoint equation, which vanishes at the solution, and Dˉ=RDTψ+QDT=g\bar D=R_D^T\psi+Q_D^T=g, the total gradient.

转置预处理从出口向入口逆序处理块，并转置各块及所有累加路径。每次迭代用精确 JT 重新计算真残差；只监控近似系统 PT 的残差不能证明已解对伴随方程。

The transposed preconditioner visits blocks from outlet to inlet and transposes blocks and accumulation paths. Every iteration recomputes the true residual using exact JT. A residual for PT alone cannot establish convergence of the adjoint equation.

从有限维 Lagrangian 逐步消去状态敏感度

Eliminate state sensitivity from a finite-dimensional Lagrangian

ℒ(𝐔,D,ψ)=Q(𝐔,D)+ψTR(𝐔,D).\mathcal L(\mathbf U,D,\psi)=Q(\mathbf U,D)+\psi^TR(\mathbf U,D).

在满足 R=0R=0 的解上 ℒ=Q\mathcal L=Q。先把 ψ\psi 固定，沿切向量 𝐔˙\dot{\mathbf U}、D˙\dot D 对 ℒ\mathcal L 前向求导，再按 𝐔˙\dot{\mathbf U} 和 D˙\dot D 收集系数。即使 ψ\psi 随设计改变，额外的 ψ˙TR\dot\psi^TR 项也在收敛解上为零。

At a feasible state R=0R=0, ℒ=Q\mathcal L=Q. Hold ψ\psi fixed, differentiate ℒ\mathcal L forward along the tangents 𝐔˙\dot{\mathbf U} and D˙\dot D, then collect the coefficients of 𝐔˙\dot{\mathbf U} and D˙\dot D. Even if ψ\psi varies with the design, the extra ψ˙TR\dot\psi^TR term vanishes at the converged state.

ℒ˙=QU𝐔˙+QDD˙+ψT(J𝐔˙+RDD˙)\dot{\mathcal L}=Q_U\dot{\mathbf U}+Q_D\dot D+\psi^T(J\dot{\mathbf U}+R_D\dot D)
=(QUT+JTψ)T𝐔˙+(QDT+RDTψ)TD˙.=(Q_U^T+J^T\psi)^T\dot{\mathbf U}+(Q_D^T+R_D^T\psi)^T\dot D.

选择 ψ\psi 使未知的状态敏感度前面的系数为零。于是一个目标只需求解一次伴随线性系统，再进行设计反传；总设计梯度是列向量 gg。注意符号来自这里的加号约定，并不是因为“伴随一定带负号”。

Choose ψ\psi to cancel the coefficient of the unknown state sensitivity. One objective then requires one adjoint solve followed by design reverse accumulation; the total design gradient gg is a column. Its sign follows from the plus convention in this Lagrangian, not from a universal negative sign for adjoints.

JTψ=−QUT,g=QDT+RDTψ,\boxed{J^T\psi=-Q_U^T},\qquad\boxed{g=Q_D^T+R_D^T\psi},
gk=∂Q∂Dk+∑rψr∂Rr∂Dk.g_k=\frac{\partial Q}{\partial D_k}+\sum_r\psi_r\frac{\partial R_r}{\partial D_k}.

用反向模式的横线记号：以 Rˉ=ψ\bar R=\psi 为种子运行残差的反向扫描，得到 𝐔ˉ=JTψ=−QUT\bar{\mathbf U}=J^T\psi=-Q_U^T，这就是伴随方程。再把目标自己的反向语句（种子 Qˉ=1\bar Q=1）累加进同一组横线量：它们给 𝐔ˉ\bar{\mathbf U} 加上 QUTQ_U^T，给 Dˉ\bar D 加上 QDTQ_D^T，于是 𝐔ˉ=QUT+JTψ=0\bar{\mathbf U}=Q_U^T+J^T\psi=0。伴随方程说的正是状态的横线量总和为零：状态不再把敏感度往下传，同一次扫描的设计伴随 Dˉ=QDT+RDTψ\bar D=Q_D^T+R_D^T\psi 就是梯度 gg。也可以直接检查与 tangent 的等价性：利用 Jv=−RD D˙Jv=-R_D\,\dot D，QUv=−ψTJv=ψTRD D˙Q_Uv=-\psi^TJv=\psi^TR_D\,\dot D，所以两条路线给出同一个 Q˙=DˉTD˙\dot Q=\bar D^T\dot D。更换为 ℒ=Q−λTR\mathcal L=Q-\lambda^TR 会得到 λ=−ψ\lambda=-\psi，但这只是两个离散乘子的符号约定，不能据此认定连续场 λ(x)\lambda(x) 与离散向量逐点相等。

In the bar notation of reverse mode: the residual's reverse sweep seeded with Rˉ=ψ\bar R=\psi returns 𝐔ˉ=JTψ=−QUT\bar{\mathbf U}=J^T\psi=-Q_U^T, which is the adjoint equation. Accumulate the objective's own reverse statements (seeded with Qˉ=1\bar Q=1) into the same bars: they add QUTQ_U^T to 𝐔ˉ\bar{\mathbf U} and QDTQ_D^T to Dˉ\bar D, so 𝐔ˉ=QUT+JTψ=0\bar{\mathbf U}=Q_U^T+J^T\psi=0. The adjoint equation says exactly that the state's total bar vanishes: the state passes no sensitivity on, and the design adjoint of the same sweep, Dˉ=QDT+RDTψ\bar D=Q_D^T+R_D^T\psi, is the gradient gg. Check equivalence with the tangent: Jv=−RD D˙Jv=-R_D\,\dot D gives QUv=−ψTJv=ψTRD D˙Q_Uv=-\psi^TJv=\psi^TR_D\,\dot D, so both routes give the same Q˙=DˉTD˙\dot Q=\bar D^T\dot D. Changing to ℒ=Q−λTR\mathcal L=Q-\lambda^TR yields λ=−ψ\lambda=-\psi, but that relates two discrete sign conventions; it does not prove pointwise equality with a continuous field λ(x)\lambda(x).

精确算子决定求解哪个方程；块 GS 固定点、GS 预处理 GMRES 与 LU（附录 C）决定如何求解。较便宜的近似 Jacobian（例如一阶或冻结部分系数的 Jacobian）可以用于迭代修正或预处理，但不能替代精确转置。应监控真残差 rψ=JTψ+QUTr_\psi=J^T\psi+Q_U^T。若其不为零，当前伴随与精确 tangent 的方向导数差为 −rψTv-r_\psi^Tv，因此只看迭代次数或预处理残差不够。

The exact operator determines the equation; the block-GS fixed point, GS-preconditioned GMRES and LU (Appendix C) determine how it is solved. A cheaper approximate Jacobian (first order, or with some coefficients frozen) may supply corrections or preconditioning, but cannot replace the exact transpose. Monitor the true residual rψ=JTψ+QUTr_\psi=J^T\psi+Q_U^T. If it is nonzero, the current adjoint directional derivative minus the exact tangent derivative is −rψTv-r_\psi^Tv; an iteration count or a preconditioned residual alone is insufficient.

为什么一次伴随求解能代替 nan_a 次前向求解

Why one adjoint solve replaces nan_a tangent solves

同样的结论也可以不经过 Lagrangian，直接由前向求解的两个关系得到：

The same result follows without a Lagrangian, directly from the two relations of the tangent solve:

Q˙=QU𝐔˙+QDD˙,𝐔˙=−J−1RDD˙\dot Q=Q_U\dot{\mathbf U}+Q_D\dot D,\qquad \dot{\mathbf U}=-J^{-1}R_D\dot D
⟹Q˙=QDD˙−QU J−1 RDD˙.\Longrightarrow\qquad \dot Q=Q_D\dot D-Q_U\,J^{-1}\,R_D\dot D.

最后一项是三个因子 QUQ_U、J−1J^{-1}、RDD˙R_D\dot D 的乘积，括号可以从两边加。前向路线先算 J−1(RDD˙)J^{-1}(R_D\dot D)：它依赖方向 D˙\dot D，每个设计分量都要解一次以 JJ 为系数的方程，全部分量要解 nan_a 次。伴随路线先算行向量 QUJ−1Q_UJ^{-1}：它与 D˙\dot D 无关，只要解一次。把这个行向量记作 −ψT-\psi^T：

The last term is the product of three factors, QUQ_U, J−1J^{-1} and RDD˙R_D\dot D, which can be bracketed from either side. The tangent route computes J−1(RDD˙)J^{-1}(R_D\dot D) first: it depends on the direction D˙\dot D, so every design component needs one solve with JJ, nan_a solves for all of them. The adjoint route computes the row QUJ−1Q_UJ^{-1} first: it does not depend on D˙\dot D, so it is solved once. Call this row −ψT-\psi^T:

ψT=−QU J−1⟺JTψ=−QUT,\psi^T=-Q_U\,J^{-1}\quad\Longleftrightarrow\quad J^T\psi=-Q_U^T,
Q˙=(QDT+RDTψ)TD˙=DˉTD˙.\dot Q=\big(Q_D^T+R_D^T\psi\big)^T\dot D=\bar D^T\dot D.

这对每个方向 D˙\dot D 都成立，所以梯度就是上面方框里的 g=Dˉg=\bar D：一次伴随求解之后，再以 Rˉ=ψ\bar R=\psi 为种子做一次反向扫描，就得到全部分量。两条路线的计算量（本页的 nan_a 与 nun_u 由本页代码数出，与页首路线图相同）：

This holds for every direction D˙\dot D, so the gradient is the boxed g=Dˉg=\bar D above: after one adjoint solve, one reverse sweep seeded with Rˉ=ψ\bar R=\psi gives every component. The cost of the two routes (nan_a and nun_u of this page, counted by its code, as in the page roadmap at the top):

求解之后After the solvesnan_a 次前向扫描，各得一个 Q˙\dot Qnan_a forward sweeps, one Q˙\dot Q each1 次反向扫描，得到整个 Dˉ\bar D1 reverse sweep, the whole Dˉ\bar D
一次求解给出One solve gives一个分量 dQ^/dDkd\widehat{Q}/dD_kone component dQ^/dDkd\widehat{Q}/dD_k全部 nan_a 个分量all nan_a components

本页 na=16n_a=16、nu=39n_u=39：前向路线要解 16 个 39 阶的线性方程组，伴随路线只解 1 个。设计变量多而目标少时（形状优化通常如此）伴随路线便宜得多；设计变量少而目标多时，前向路线更合适。

This page has na=16n_a=16 and nu=39n_u=39: the tangent route solves 16 linear systems of order 39, the adjoint route one. With many design variables and few objectives (the usual case in shape optimisation) the adjoint route is far cheaper; with few design variables and many objectives the tangent route is the better choice.

伴随沿哪个方向传播

Which way the adjoint travels

原始问题的 uu、u+cu+c 两族向下游传播，u−cu-c 向上游；伴随沿同样的特征反向传播（附录 A），所以它从原始问题离开的地方进入：入口一族（c−uc-u），出口两族（−u-u、−(u+c)-(u+c)）。图 9 用本页离散解的 u−cu-c、uu、u+cu+c 画出两者的特征线，并让扰动沿它们移动。这也解释了两种扫描的方向：第 6 节的原始 GS 从入口扫到出口，顺着 uu 与 u+cu+c；本节的转置预处理从出口扫到入口，顺着伴随的 −u-u 与 −(u+c)-(u+c)——一次前向扫描精确倒转下三角部分 diag⁡(Pii)+L\operatorname{diag}(P_{ii})+L，它的转置是上三角的，只能从最后一块倒着解，正好是一次反向扫描。逆着扫描方向传播的第三族（原始的 u−cu-c、伴随的 c−uc-u）要靠 12 次内扫描与外层迭代来处理。

The primal families uu and u+cu+c travel downstream and u−cu-c upstream; the adjoint travels along the same characteristics in the opposite direction (Appendix A), so it enters where the primal leaves: one family at the inlet (c−uc-u) and two at the outlet (−u-u, −(u+c)-(u+c)). Figure 9 draws the characteristics of both from this page’s discrete u−cu-c, uu and u+cu+c and lets disturbances move along them. This also explains the direction of the two sweeps: the primal GS of Section 6 sweeps from the inlet to the outlet, along uu and u+cu+c; the transposed preconditioner of this section sweeps from the outlet to the inlet, along the adjoint’s −u-u and −(u+c)-(u+c). A forward sweep inverts the lower part diag⁡(Pii)+L\operatorname{diag}(P_{ii})+L exactly; its transpose is upper triangular and can only be solved from the last block backwards, which is a reverse sweep. The third family, which runs against each sweep (the primal u−cu-c, the adjoint c−uc-u), is left to the 12 inner sweeps and the outer iteration.

多次前向求解与一次伴随求解

Many tangent solves against one adjoint solve

图 10 在本页上度量上面代价表里的两条路线：每个设计分量一次前向求解 JU˙=−RDD˙J\dot U=-R_D\dot D（第 10 节），对比一次伴随求解 JTψ=−QUTJ^T\psi=-Q_U^T 加一次反向扫描。页首默认设置下，16 次前向求解共用 468 次 GMRES 迭代，伴随求解用 27 次（第 1 节）。每次迭代做两次精确算子乘积（一次用于 Krylov 步，一次重新计算真残差，第 17 节）和一次 GS 预处理（12 次块扫描），每个求解结束时再乘一次；按调用计数，前向路线共 952 次 JJ 乘向量，伴随求解 55 次 JTJ^T 乘向量。迭代数之比 17.3 与调用数之比 17.3 几乎相同，因为两条路线每次迭代做的事一样；每次迭代的代价只是近似相同，Krylov 正交化的代价随迭代序号增长，没有计入。两条路线的梯度相差至多 8.3×10−138.3\times10^{-13}，来自两个线性求解的容差。设计分量越多，差距越大，如上面的表所计。

Figure 10 measures on this page the two routes of the cost table above: one tangent solve JU˙=−RDD˙J\dot U=-R_D\dot D per design component (Section 10) against one adjoint solve JTψ=−QUTJ^T\psi=-Q_U^T and one reverse sweep. At the defaults the 16 tangent solves take 468 GMRES iterations in total and the adjoint solve 27 (Section 1). Every iteration makes two exact operator products (one for the Krylov step, one to recompute the true residual, Section 17) and applies the GS preconditioner once (12 block sweeps), and every solve multiplies once more at the end; counted by calls, the tangent route makes 952 products with JJ and the adjoint solve 55 with JTJ^T. The ratio of the iteration counts, 17.3, and the ratio of the call counts, 17.3, are nearly the same because both routes do the same in an iteration; the cost of an iteration is only approximately the same, since the cost of the Krylov orthogonalisation grows with the iteration index and is not counted. The gradients of the two routes differ by at most 8.3×10−138.3\times10^{-13}, the tolerance of the two linear solves. The more design components, the larger the gap, as the table above counts.

第 12 节Section 12

设计导数：面积、入口总量和出口压力

Design derivatives: area, inlet totals and exit pressure

设计向量包含 N+1 个面积值以及 pbp_b、p₀、T₀。面积变化同时影响面通量、源项中的 A′ 和反设计目标的积分权重。漏掉其中任意一项，状态导数点积测试仍可能通过，但全链路几何梯度会错。节点坐标固定，因此本页不包含移动节点导致的 h、重构权重或积分点导数。

The design vector contains N+1 area values plus pbp_b, p₀ and T₀. Area changes affect face flux, source A′ and inverse-objective integration weights. Omitting one may still pass a state dot-product test while corrupting the full geometry gradient. Node coordinates are fixed; derivatives of spacing, reconstruction weights or moving quadrature points are outside this example.

Q˙=gATA˙+gpbp˙b+gp0p˙0+gT0T˙0,A˙′=A˙k+1−A˙kh.\dot Q=g_A^T\dot A+g_{p_b}\dot p_b+g_{p_0}\dot p_0+g_{T_0}\dot T_0,\quad\dot A'=\frac{\dot A_{k+1}-\dot A_k}{h}.

选择一个设计变量，比较前向与伴随得到的同一个标量梯度。面积分量是对节点面积值的偏导，不是连续梯度密度；比较连续结果时，应沿同一光滑方向：把附录 A 的连续变分 δA(x)\delta A(x) 在面积节点 xkx_k 上取样作离散种子 A˙k=δA(xk)\dot A_k=\delta A(x_k)，再比较 gATA˙g_A^T\dot A 与连续的 δQ\delta Q，而不能直接比较数组元素大小。

Select a design variable and compare tangent and adjoint evaluations of the same scalar gradient. Area entries differentiate nodal area values, not a continuous gradient density. Compare continuous and discrete results along the same smooth direction: sample the continuous variation δA(x)\delta A(x) of Appendix A at the area nodes xkx_k as the discrete seed A˙k=δA(xk)\dot A_k=\delta A(x_k), then compare gATA˙g_A^T\dot A with the continuous δQ\delta Q, rather than matching array magnitudes.

在 T₀>0 的精确离散根处，若实际状态 Jacobian 非奇异，则同一光滑局部分支上，两个压力目标（压力参考固定）对 T₀ 的导数均为零。取 λ>0，把 T₀ 换成 λT₀，同时取 ρ→ρ/λ、u→√λu、p 不变。格点未被替换的守恒残差分量分别乘以 1/√λ、1、√λ；入口总压和出口背压替换行保持不变，入口总温替换行乘以 λ。因此完整零残差解映为完整零残差解，压力及两个目标保持不变。数值表中的总温分量不为零，只是因为线性求解只算到容差（量级约 10⁻¹³ 或更小；稠密求解只剩舍入量级），也可受原始方程残差影响；第 13、14 节检查它时只看绝对误差。

At an exact discrete root with T₀>0 and a nonsingular actual state Jacobian, both pressure objectives, with the reference pressure field fixed, have zero T₀ derivative on the same smooth local branch. For λ>0, replace T₀ by λT₀ and take ρ→ρ/λ, u→√λu with p unchanged. The unreplaced node conservation residual components scale by 1/√λ, 1 and √λ. The inlet total-pressure and outlet back-pressure replacement rows are unchanged; the inlet total-temperature replacement row scales by λ. Thus a complete zero-residual solution maps to another complete zero-residual solution with unchanged pressures and objectives. That temperature entry in the numerical table is not zero only because the linear solve stops at its tolerance (about 10⁻¹³ or smaller; a dense solve leaves only rounding level), and it can also reflect the primal equation residual; use absolute error for this component in Sections 13 and 14.

面积梯度的三条路径

The three paths of an area gradient

每个截面积 AkA_k 在残差和目标里出现在三处：面面积 AfA_f（第 3 节）、源项斜率 GqG_q（第 5 节）和目标的积分项（第 7 节）。第 9 节的反向扫描沿这三条路径分别累加 Aˉk\bar A_k；图 11 把它们分开画出（页首默认设置）。反设计目标下，面路径与源项路径各自比它们的和大得多，而且几乎相互抵消：节点 k=12k=12 处面路径为 0.01660.0166、源项路径为 −0.0183-0.0183、目标路径为 2.2×10−82.2\times10^{-8}，三者之和 gA12=−0.00179g_{A_{12}}=-0.00179；整个流道上面路径的最大值是梯度最大值的 2.1 倍，源项路径是 2.3 倍。漏掉面路径或源项路径，误差比梯度本身还大；漏掉目标路径的误差小得多（最大 3.5×10−53.5\times10^{-5}，约为梯度最大值的 0.44%），但同样是错的。这就是上面“漏掉其中任意一项……几何梯度会错”的具体含义。推力目标下两端由目标路径主导，那里的梯度为 gA0=−0.878g_{A_0}=-0.878、gA12=0.892g_{A_{12}}=0.892。边界数据各只有一条路径：被替换行的乘子（第 4 节）。

Every area AkA_k enters the residual and the objective in three places: the face areas AfA_f (Section 3), the source slopes GqG_q (Section 5) and the objective integrals (Section 7). The reverse sweep of Section 9 accumulates Aˉk\bar A_k along each of the three paths; Figure 11 draws them separately (the defaults at the top of the page). For the inverse design the face path and the source path are each much larger than their sum and nearly cancel: at node k=12k=12 the face path is 0.01660.0166, the source path −0.0183-0.0183 and the objective path 2.2×10−82.2\times10^{-8}, which sum to gA12=−0.00179g_{A_{12}}=-0.00179; along the duct the largest face path is 2.1 times the largest gradient entry, and the largest source path 2.3 times. Omitting the face path or the source path makes an error larger than the gradient itself; omitting the objective path makes a much smaller error (at most 3.5×10−53.5\times10^{-5}, about 0.44% of the largest gradient entry), but still an error. This is what “omitting one … corrupting the full geometry gradient” above means in numbers. For the thrust the objective path dominates at the two ends, where the gradient is gA0=−0.878g_{A_0}=-0.878 and gA12=0.892g_{A_{12}}=0.892. The boundary data have one path each: the multipliers of the replaced rows (Section 4).

网格加密：从节点导数到梯度密度

Refinement: from nodal derivatives to a gradient density

gAkg_{A_k} 是对一个节点值的导数，随网格加密而变小。除以节点 kk 的帽函数面积 hkh_k（内部为 hh，两端为 h/2h/2），得到的梯度密度在加密时趋于附录 A.4 的连续密度 d(x)=jA+λ′TF−(jA′+λ2p)′d(x)=j_A+\lambda'^TF-\bigl(j_{A'}+\lambda_2p\bigr)'（推力 jA′=pj_{A'}=p 时括号内是 (1+λ2)p(1+\lambda_2)p；离散与连续之间 λ≈−ψ\lambda\approx-\psi）。图 12 用 N=12, 24, 48, 96N=12,\ 24,\ 48,\ 96 的离线计算说明这一点：反设计的内部密度逐渐贴近 d(x)d(x)，在喉部 x=0.5x=0.5 依次为 0.0080248, 0.024035, 0.028094, 0.0285510.0080248,\ 0.024035,\ 0.028094,\ 0.028551，连续值为 0.0285420.028542。N=96N=96 时它与连续值相差 0.032%；再加密到 N=192N=192 得 0.028560.02856，相差 0.062%：第四位以后数列不再单调地趋于连续值，这一列只支持前三位数字。两端附近的几个节点另外承担 A.4 的端点项，不形成密度。推力的连续密度恒为零（A.4），管道中段（0.25≤x≤0.750.25\le x\le0.75）的离散密度，其最大绝对值从 N=12N=12 的 0.470.47 降到 N=96N=96 的 0.00360.0036（两端附近的节点带着端点项，不算在内），而两端的导数趋于 −p(0)=−0.9-p(0)=-0.9 与 p(1)=0.9p(1)=0.9：N=96N=96 时为 −0.89974-0.89974 与 0.899990.89999。

gAkg_{A_k} is the derivative by one nodal value and shrinks as the mesh is refined. Divided by the area hkh_k of the hat function of node kk (hh inside, h/2h/2 at the two ends), it becomes a gradient density that tends under refinement to the continuous density of Appendix A.4, d(x)=jA+λ′TF−(jA′+λ2p)′d(x)=j_A+\lambda'^TF-\bigl(j_{A'}+\lambda_2p\bigr)' (for the thrust jA′=pj_{A'}=p, and the bracket is (1+λ2)p(1+\lambda_2)p; between discrete and continuous λ≈−ψ\lambda\approx-\psi). Figure 12 shows this with offline runs at N=12, 24, 48, 96N=12,\ 24,\ 48,\ 96: the interior density of the inverse design approaches d(x)d(x), at the throat x=0.5x=0.5 it takes the values 0.0080248, 0.024035, 0.028094, 0.0285510.0080248,\ 0.024035,\ 0.028094,\ 0.028551 against the continuous 0.0285420.028542. At N=96N=96 it differs from the continuous value by 0.032%; one grid finer, N=192N=192, it is 0.028560.02856, differing by 0.062%: beyond the third digit the sequence no longer approaches the continuous value monotonically, so this column supports the first three digits only. A few nodes near each end also carry the end terms of A.4 and do not form a density. The continuous density of the thrust is identically zero (A.4); on the middle of the duct (0.25≤x≤0.750.25\le x\le0.75) the largest absolute discrete density falls from 0.470.47 at N=12N=12 to 0.00360.0036 at N=96N=96 (the nodes near the ends carry the end terms and are not counted), and the two end derivatives tend to −p(0)=−0.9-p(0)=-0.9 and p(1)=0.9p(1)=0.9: −0.89974-0.89974 and 0.899990.89999 at N=96N=96.

第 13 节Section 13

有限差分：改变变量、改变步长、重新收敛

Finite differences: change variables and steps, reconverge

差分验证必须重新求解扰动后的完整流场。中心差分误差含 O(h²) 截断误差与约 O(ε/h) 的舍入及求解误差：步长越小不一定越准确。下面保留全部面积和边界变量、前向／中心／后向差分，以及从 10⁻¹ 到 10⁻¹² 的扫描。若扰动离开当前亚声速分支，显示失败而不伪造数值。

Each finite-difference sample reconverges the full perturbed flow. Central differences combine O(h²) truncation with approximately O(ε/h) roundoff and solver error; smaller steps are not always better. Select any area or boundary variable, forward/central/backward differences, and scan steps from 10⁻¹ to 10⁻¹². Perturbations leaving the subsonic branch are reported as failures.

gkCD(h)=Q(U(D+hek),D+hek)−Q(U(D−hek),D−hek)2h.g_k^{\mathrm{CD}}(h)=\frac{Q(U(D+h e_k),D+h e_k)-Q(U(D-h e_k),D-h e_k)}{2h}.
target = fixed_target_from_baseline()
for h in steps:
    Uplus  = reconverge(D+h*ek, start=Ustar)
    Uminus = reconverge(D-h*ek, start=Ustar)
    fd = (Q(Uplus,D+h*ek)-Q(Uminus,D-h*ek))/(2*h)
    report(fd, abs(fd-adjoint_gradient[k]), true_primal_residuals)

四种误差要分开：空间离散误差由网格加密检查；非线性求解误差由原始残差检查；线性求解误差由 tangent/adjoint 真残差检查；求导实现由转置、差分与复数检查。点积相等只证明两条传播互为转置；共同遗漏同一项也可能通过。近零梯度分量请同时查看绝对误差。

Separate four errors: spatial error through refinement; nonlinear solve error through primal residuals; linear solve error through true tangent/adjoint residuals; derivative implementation through transpose, finite differences and complex checks. A dot test alone only establishes paired transposes; jointly omitting a term may still pass. Inspect absolute errors for near-zero gradient components.

Taylor 实验使用固定设计方向（种子）Ḋ，每个步长重新收敛原始问题，并保持目标场不变。E₀=|Q(D+hḊ)−Q(D)|，E₁=|Q(D+hḊ)−Q(D)−h gTḊ|。光滑且 gTḊ≠0 时，预期 E₀ 为一阶、E₁ 为二阶；驻点或特殊方向可能有更高阶。步长过小后，求解误差与浮点消减会破坏这些斜率，不能把这一段当作空间精度。

The Taylor experiment reconverges each perturbed primal along a fixed design direction (seed) Ḋ with a fixed target. E₀=|Q(D+hḊ)−Q(D)| and E₁=|Q(D+hḊ)−Q(D)−h gTḊ|. For a smooth problem and nonzero gTḊ, expect first- and second-order behaviour; stationary points or special directions can give higher orders. At tiny steps, solve errors and cancellation spoil the slopes. These slopes are not spatial accuracy.

容差实验固定当前设计、目标与差分步长，分别放宽扰动原始问题的容差、伴随线性系统的容差。表中差分误差与梯度误差以严格收敛的当前梯度为参照；残差是代数求解指标，不是空间误差。

The tolerance experiment fixes design, target and finite-difference step, then independently relaxes perturbed-primal and adjoint linear tolerances. Differences are measured against the tightly converged current gradient; algebraic residuals are not spatial errors.

第 14 节Section 14

复数步长：独立复数残差验证

Complex step: an independent complex-residual check

把同一原始代数运算换为复数运算，令 DkD_k 增加 ih，h=10⁻²⁵；不做两个近似数的相减。程序从已收敛实部出发，用精确实部 Jacobian 校正复数残差的虚部，最后检查 Im(R)/h 的范数。输出来自复数目标函数，不是直接返回前向导数。

Execute the primal algebra with independent complex arithmetic and perturb DkD_k by ih, h=10⁻²⁵. Starting from the converged real state, correct the imaginary residual using the real exact Jacobian, then check the norm of Im(R)/h. The result comes from the complex objective, not from returning a tangent derivative.

gkCS=Im⁡Q(U(D+ihek),D+ihek)h+O(h2).g_k^{\mathrm{CS}}=\frac{\operatorname{Im}Q(U(D+ih e_k),D+ih e_k)}h+O(h^2).

光滑分支的开方、幂和边界选择都保持解析延拓。状态有效性判断只决定是否接受实部基准，不能在复数残差内对虚部取绝对值。激波限制器中的 min/max 分支必须另行分析，附录 B 解释其局限。

Square roots, powers and boundary choices follow analytic continuation on the smooth branch. Admissibility concerns the real baseline, not absolute values of imaginary quantities inside the residual. Limiter min/max branches in shock problems require a separate analysis, discussed in Appendix B.

第 15 节Section 15

精度阶：同一物理问题上的网格加密

Accuracy order: refinement of the same physical problem

本节实验：线性重构精确、PDE 解达到二阶、目标或梯度达到二阶，是三种不同的结论。本节检查重构和加密解，第 16 节比较梯度的加密。

Experiment: Exact linear reconstruction, second-order PDE solutions and second-order functionals or gradients are distinct claims. This section checks reconstruction and refined solutions; Section 16 compares gradients under refinement.

精确参考不是把细网格离散解当作真解，而是独立求解等熵面积—马赫数关系。格心比较精确单元平均值，格点比较精确节点值。面积仍由越来越密的节点作分片线性逼近；对数图和实测相邻阶数显示真实误差，不把“二阶重构”直接当作二阶收敛证据。

The reference independently solves the isentropic area–Mach relation rather than treating a fine discrete solution as exact. Compare cell averages on the cell page and nodal values on the node page. Piecewise-linear area is refined with the grid. Log plots and measured adjacent-grid rates report observed error rather than equating reconstruction order with demonstrated convergence.

qm=ρuA=AγM(1+0.2M2)−3,Me=5(pb−2/7−1),EN=13m∑i,k(Uik−Uikref)2,q=log⁡2(EN/E2N).q_m=\rho uA=A\sqrt\gamma M(1+0.2M^2)^{-3},\quad M_e=\sqrt{5(p_b^{-2/7}-1)},\quad E_N=\sqrt{\frac1{3m}\sum_{i,k}(U_{ik}-U_{ik}^{ref})^2},\quad q=\log_2(E_N/E_{2N}).

上式中 qmq_m 是质量流量；各式按默认的 p₀=T₀=1、R=1 写出，第 15、16 节的加密表都用这组参数。

Here qmq_m is the mass flow; the formulas are written for the default p₀=T₀=1 and R=1, which the refinement tables of Sections 15 and 16 use.

第 16 节Section 16

伴随一致性：离散正确与连续极限分开检查

Adjoint consistency: discrete correctness and continuum limits

研究性探索 · 选读Research exploration · optional

研究性部分是解释当前格心／格点、边界行及目标定义下离散乘子与连续场的加密极限，并建立误差阶或一致稳定性结论。现有射击法与差分对照提供本算例证据，不构成任意跨声速流道的收敛或适定性证明。连续方程的分部积分和边界零空间推导仍属进阶教学。

The research-oriented part is the refinement limit of discrete multipliers versus continuous fields for these cell/node schemes, boundary rows and objectives, and establishing error rates or uniform stability. Shooting and finite differences provide case-specific evidence, not convergence or well-posedness proofs for arbitrary transonic ducts. Integration by parts and boundary null-space derivations remain advanced teaching.

点积、前向／伴随、差分及复数步长检查的是当前离散程序。连续伴随则从微分方程独立推导与求解，用来观察网格加密后的极限。两者不是互相替代的验证。完整推导、边界条件、独立 ODE 求解和图形位于本页附录 A。

Dot products, tangent/adjoint agreement, finite differences and complex step test the discrete program. The continuous adjoint is independently derived and solved from the differential equation to study the refinement limit. Neither replaces the other. Appendix A contains the complete derivation, boundary conditions, independent ODE solution and plots.

光滑、正密度正压力、远离声速点以及可逆的两端边界算子，是本页连续参考的前提。在声速点，通量 Jacobian 有零特征值；在激波处，平滑 ODE 和普通分部积分不再覆盖全部变化。出现不一致时先区分离散实现错误、网格未收敛与连续问题不适定。

The reference assumes smooth positive states, separation from sonic points and an invertible two-end boundary operator. A sonic point makes the flux Jacobian singular; shocks add variations absent from a smooth ODE. Disagreement must be classified as an implementation defect, unresolved mesh error or ill-posed continuous problem.

离散乘子与连续场为什么不能直接混用

Why a discrete multiplier is not automatically a continuous field

正文使用普通数组点积定义 JTJ^T。若另选带权内积，算子的伴随就会改变：状态权矩阵为 WUW_U、残差权矩阵为 WRW_R 时，带权伴随是 WU−1JTWRW_U^{-1}J^TW_R。代码的普通转置不能在没有换元说明的情况下被写成该带权算子。

The main derivation defines JTJ^T using ordinary array dot products. A weighted inner product changes the adjoint: with state and residual weights WUW_U and WRW_R it is WU−1JTWRW_U^{-1}J^TW_R. The coded ordinary transpose cannot be relabelled as that weighted operator without a change of variables.

⟨Jv,Rˉ⟩WR=vTJTWRRˉ=⟨v,J†Rˉ⟩WU,\langle Jv,\bar R\rangle_{W_R}=v^TJ^TW_R\bar R=\langle v,J^\dagger \bar R\rangle_{W_U},
J†=WU−1JTWR.J^\dagger=W_U^{-1}J^TW_R.

残差的归一化也会改变乘子的数值。若改为 R𝒩=𝒩−1RR_{\mathcal N}={\mathcal N}^{-1}R，𝒩{\mathcal N} 为可逆的行尺度矩阵（例如各控制体的体积），则在收敛解上 J𝒩=𝒩−1JJ_{\mathcal N}={\mathcal N}^{-1}J，ψ𝒩=𝒩Tψ\psi_{\mathcal N}={\mathcal N}^T\psi；目标总梯度保持不变。即使 𝒩{\mathcal N} 随设计改变，由 𝒩˙\dot {\mathcal N} 产生的项也乘以 RR，在精确收敛时为零。把控制体积分残差改成体积平均残差后，不能仍直接比较原来的乘子曲线。

Residual normalization also changes multiplier values. For R𝒩=𝒩−1RR_{\mathcal N}={\mathcal N}^{-1}R with an invertible row-scaling matrix 𝒩{\mathcal N} (for example the control-volume sizes), at convergence J𝒩=𝒩−1JJ_{\mathcal N}={\mathcal N}^{-1}J and ψ𝒩=𝒩Tψ\psi_{\mathcal N}={\mathcal N}^T\psi, while the total objective gradient is unchanged. Even when 𝒩{\mathcal N} depends on the design, the terms from 𝒩˙\dot {\mathcal N} multiply RR and vanish at exact convergence. Multipliers of integrated and volume-normalized residuals cannot be compared without rescaling.

连续附录从微分方程、积分目标和分部积分出发；正文从实际离散残差及其有限维链式法则出发。两者可以比较同一设计变量的目标总导数与加密极限，但还须匹配符号、变量、积分权重和边界约束。被替换的边界行的乘子尤其不能直接解释为连续场采样值。

The continuous appendix starts from differential equations, integral objectives and integration by parts; the main text starts from actual discrete residuals and finite-dimensional chain rules. Compare total derivatives of the same objective and design variable and their refinement limits, after matching signs, variables, weights and boundary constraints. Multipliers of replaced boundary rows especially are not direct samples of a continuous field.

第 17 节Section 17

传统固定点与 GS 预处理 GMRES

Fixed-point iteration and GS-preconditioned GMRES

两种方法解同一个精确系统 Jx=b。传统缺陷校正每步应用 B 后按固定系数更新，收敛要求谱半径 ρ(I−ωBJ)<1；这个条件不是“P 很像 J”就自动满足的。GMRES 则在 Krylov 子空间中选组合系数，减少真残差。这里使用右预处理：解 JB y=b，再取 x=B y。

Both methods solve the same exact Jx=b. Fixed-point defect correction applies B with a prescribed relaxation; convergence requires ρ(I−ωBJ)<1, which is not guaranteed merely because P resembles J. GMRES chooses combinations in a Krylov subspace to reduce the residual. Right preconditioning solves JB y=b and recovers x=B y.

𝒦k(JB,r0)=span⁡{r0,JBr0,…,(JB)k−1r0},yk=arg⁡min⁡y∈𝒦k∥b−JBy∥2.\mathcal K_k(JB,r_0)=\operatorname{span}\{r_0,JBr_0,\ldots,(JB)^{k-1}r_0\},\qquad y_k=\arg\min_{y\in\mathcal K_k}\|b-JBy\|_2.

本页 GMRES 采用两次正交化，每一步都用精确算子重新计算真残差，返回前再算一次。一次 GMRES 步含两次精确算子乘积（一次用于 Krylov 步，一次是真残差）和一次 GS 预处理（12 次内扫描），不能仅凭迭代次数宣布性能优势。下面在同一收敛流场上独立求解伴随系统，比较解差与真残差历史；固定点的转置预处理同样经过点积检查。

GMRES uses two orthogonalisation passes, recomputes the true residual with the exact operator at every step and once more before returning. Each Krylov step includes two exact operator products (one for the Krylov step, one for the true residual) and one application of the GS preconditioner (12 inner sweeps), so iteration count alone is not a timing comparison. The panel solves the same adjoint system independently with both methods and compares solutions and true residual histories. The transposed preconditioner also has a dot-product test.

第 18 节Section 18

总结：从重构到经过验证的设计梯度

Summary: from reconstruction to verified design gradients

Euler 的新增内容不是把 Burgers 的标量换成长度为三的数组就结束了：热力学使三个分量耦合，特征边界限制允许的扰动，面积同时进入面和体积分。二阶重构还要求源项、目标函数、前向与反向路径一起升级。

Euler requires more than replacing a Burgers scalar by a three-entry array: thermodynamics couples components, characteristic boundaries constrain perturbations, and area enters both face and volume terms. Second-order reconstruction also requires consistent source, objective, tangent and reverse paths.

本页实现光滑亚声速的一阶／二阶离散、matrix-free 精确导数、低阶 GS 固定点和 GS 预处理 GMRES、全变量差分与复数验证，并用独立连续伴随作对比。附录 B 进一步分析激波跳跃与位置变化，提供局部跳跃计算，并推出激波处的内部伴随条件；B.5 用整条流道的激波拟合给出约化伴随，B.6 给出激波捕捉格式的离散 tangent 与 adjoint 及其加密研究。这些都是独立实验；当前稳态流道求解器仍限于光滑分支，尚未把限制器或激波移动混入已验证的光滑实现。

This page implements first/second-order smooth subsonic discretisations, exact matrix-free derivatives, low-order GS defect correction, GS-preconditioned GMRES, all-variable finite differences and complex checks, with an independent continuous reference. Appendix B analyses shock jumps and location variations, provides a local jump calculator and derives the internal adjoint conditions at the shock; B.5 gives a reduced adjoint by fitting the shock over the whole duct, and B.6 the discrete tangent and adjoint of a shock-capturing scheme with a refinement study. These are independent experiments; the steady duct solver remains on the smooth branch, and limiter and moving-shock solves are not part of that verified implementation.

附录 A：连续伴随的完整推导与实现

Appendix A: complete continuous-adjoint derivation and implementation

进阶教学 · 选读Advanced teaching · optional

这里主要是已有连续伴随理论在简单光滑算例上的推导与独立验证，不因推导较长而归为研究成果。接近声速、出现间断或改变边界类型时，原有推导的假设需重新检查；不能仅由离散／连续不一致判定连续问题不适定。

This is primarily established continuous-adjoint theory derived and independently checked for a simple smooth case, not a research result because the derivation is lengthy. Sonic states, discontinuities or different boundary types require revisiting its assumptions; discrete/continuous disagreement alone does not establish ill-posedness.

A.1 先明确问题和符号

A.1 Specify the problem and sign convention

取固定区间 [0,1]，截面积 A(x)>0，稳态残差 ℛ=(AF)′−A′pe₂=0，目标 Q=∫j(U,A,A′,x)dx。U 是连续状态，B=FUF_U 是 3×3 通量 Jacobian；本附录用 B 表示通量导数，与正文第 6、17 节的 GS 预处理映射不是同一对象。令 ℒ=Q−∫λTℛdx。先只改变 U，再改变面积及边界数据，避免把两类变化混在一起。

On the fixed interval [0,1], let A(x)>0, ℛ=(AF)′−A′pe₂=0 and Q=∫j(U,A,A′,x)dx. U is continuous and B=FUF_U is the 3×3 flux Jacobian; this B is unrelated to the GS preconditioner map of Sections 6 and 17. Set ℒ=Q−∫λTℛdx. Vary U first, then area and boundary data, keeping the two variations distinct.

B=[010−3−γ2u2(3−γ)uγ−1(γ−1)u3−γuEγE−32(γ−1)u2γu],pU=(γ−12u2,−(γ−1)u,γ−1),E=e/ρ.B=\begin{bmatrix}0&1&0\\-\frac{3-\gamma}{2}u^2&(3-\gamma)u&\gamma-1\\(\gamma-1)u^3-\gamma uE&\gamma E-\frac32(\gamma-1)u^2&\gamma u\end{bmatrix},\quad p_U=\left(\frac{\gamma-1}{2}u^2,-(\gamma-1)u,\gamma-1\right),\quad E=e/\rho.

A.2 逐项变分和分部积分

A.2 Variation and integration by parts

δUℛ=(ABδU)′−A′e2pUδU.\delta_U\mathcal R=(AB\delta U)'-A'e_2p_U\delta U.
δUℒ=∫01jUδU dx−∫01λT(ABδU)′dx+∫01A′λ2pUδU dx.\delta_U\mathcal L=\int_0^1j_U\delta U\,dx-\int_0^1\lambda^T(AB\delta U)'dx+\int_0^1 A'\lambda_2p_U\delta U\,dx.
δUℒ=∫01(jUT+ABTλ′+A′λ2pUT)TδU dx−[λTABδU]01.\delta_U\mathcal L=\int_0^1\left(j_U^T+AB^T\lambda'+A'\lambda_2p_U^T\right)^T\delta U\,dx-\left[\lambda^TAB\delta U\right]_0^1.

分部积分作用在整个 ABδU 上。因此体内伴随包含 ABTλ′，不能再额外补一个 (AB)′Tλ；那会重复计算原始保守形式已经包含的系数变化。令任意内部扰动的系数为零，得到以下三分量一阶 ODE。

Integrate the derivative of the entire ABδU product. The volume adjoint contains ABTλ′; adding (AB)′Tλ would double-count coefficient variations already in the conservative primal form. Set the coefficient of arbitrary interior variations to zero to obtain a three-component first-order ODE.

−ABTλ′−A′λ2pUT=jUT,jUT={A′pUTQT,A(p−p⋆)pUTQI.-AB^T\lambda'-A'\lambda_2p_U^T=j_U^T,\qquad j_U^T=\begin{cases}A'p_U^T&Q_T,\\A(p-p^\star)p_U^T&Q_I.\end{cases}

A.3 边界条件来自允许的状态扰动

A.3 Boundary conditions follow admissible state variations

固定入口总压和总温时，C₀,UδU(0)=0，其中 C₀=(p₀,T₀)T；固定出口静压时，C₁,UδU(1)=0，其中 C₁=p。入口零空间是一维，出口零空间是二维。取它们的列基 N₀、N₁，把 δU=Nξ 代入边界项。只有对所有允许的 ξ 消去边界项，才得到正确的伴随条件，而不是随意令三个 λ 都为零。

For fixed inlet totals, C₀,UδU(0)=0 with C₀=(p₀,T₀)T. At fixed exit pressure, C₁,UδU(1)=0 with C₁=p. The inlet null space is one-dimensional and the outlet null space two-dimensional. Let N₀,N₁ span them and substitute δU=Nξ into the boundary term. Cancel it for every admissible ξ; setting all three λ values to zero arbitrarily is incorrect.

N0TABTλ(0)=0,N1TABTλ(1)=0.N_0^TAB^T\lambda(0)=0,\qquad N_1^TAB^T\lambda(1)=0.

本实现显式求总量的梯度。由 T=p/ρ、T₀=T+u²/7 得 dT₀=dT+2u du/7，再由 p₀=p(T₀/T)³·⁵ 得 dp₀。入口零空间用 ∇p₀×∇T₀ 归一化；出口可取 (1,0,−pρ/pe)T 与 (0,1,−pm/pe)T。这些公式不调用离散残差 Jacobian。

The implementation differentiates total quantities explicitly: T=p/ρ, T₀=T+u²/7, dT₀=dT+2u du/7 and p₀=p(T₀/T)³·⁵. Normalise ∇p₀×∇T₀ for the inlet null vector. At the outlet use (1,0,−pρ/pe)T and (0,1,−pm/pe)T. These formulas never call the discrete residual Jacobian.

逐步推导：边界条件的个数与形式

Step by step: how many boundary conditions, and in which form

亚声速拟一维 Euler 有三族特征速度 u−c<0<u<u+cu-c<0<u<u+c。原始问题在一端给定的量，恰好等于从这一端进入的特征数：入口进入 uu 与 u+cu+c，给定 p0p_0、T0T_0；出口只进入 u−cu-c，给定 pbp_b。伴随方程沿同样的特征反向传递信息，所以个数对调。

Subsonic quasi-1-D Euler has three characteristic speeds, u−c<0<u<u+cu-c<0<u<u+c. The primal problem prescribes at an end exactly as many data as characteristics enter there: uu and u+cu+c enter at the inlet, which receives p0p_0 and T0T_0; only u−cu-c enters at the outlet, which receives pbp_b. The adjoint carries information along the same characteristics in reverse, so the counts swap.

形式由 A.2 的边界项决定。出口只约束静压：允许的 δU(1)\delta U(1) 是 ker⁡pU\ker p_U 中任意向量，写成 δU(1)=N1ξ1\delta U(1)=N_1\xi_1，N1∈ℝ3×2N_1\in\mathbb R^{3\times2}。边界项对所有 ξ1\xi_1 为零：

The form follows from the boundary term of A.2. The outlet constrains only the static pressure: admissible δU(1)\delta U(1) are arbitrary vectors of ker⁡pU\ker p_U, written δU(1)=N1ξ1\delta U(1)=N_1\xi_1 with N1∈ℝ3×2N_1\in\mathbb R^{3\times2}. The boundary term must vanish for every ξ1\xi_1:

λ(1)TA1B1 N1ξ1=0∀ξ1⟺N1TA1B1Tλ(1)=0⟺A1B1Tλ(1)=pUT μ1.\begin{aligned}&\lambda(1)^TA_1B_1\,N_1\xi_1=0\quad\forall\xi_1\\ \Longleftrightarrow\quad&N_1^TA_1B_1^T\lambda(1)=0\\ \Longleftrightarrow\quad&A_1B_1^T\lambda(1)=p_U^T\,\mu_1.\end{aligned}

最后一式说的是：向量 q1=A1B1Tλ(1)q_1=A_1B_1^T\lambda(1) 与整个允许平面正交，只能平行于约束梯度 pUTp_U^T，差一个标量 μ1\mu_1。入口有两个约束，允许的扰动只剩一条直线 n0∝∇p0×∇T0n_0\propto\nabla p_0\times\nabla T_0，于是只得一个条件：

The last form says that the vector q1=A1B1Tλ(1)q_1=A_1B_1^T\lambda(1) is orthogonal to the whole admissible plane and can only be parallel to the constraint gradient pUTp_U^T, up to a scalar μ1\mu_1. The inlet has two constraints, the admissible variations reduce to the line n0∝∇p0×∇T0n_0\propto\nabla p_0\times\nabla T_0, and a single condition results:

n0TA0B0Tλ(0)=0⟺A0B0Tλ(0)=C0,UTμ0,μ0∈ℝ2.n_0^TA_0B_0^T\lambda(0)=0\quad\Longleftrightarrow\quad A_0B_0^T\lambda(0)=C_{0,U}^T\mu_0,\qquad \mu_0\in\mathbb R^2.

两端合计 2+1=32+1=3 个条件，与三分量一阶伴随 ODE 的阶数相同。μ0\mu_0、μ1\mu_1 正是 A.4 中边界数据导数用到的乘子：改变 p0p_0、T0T_0 或 pbp_b 时，梯度由这些乘子给出，(p0,T0)(p_0,T_0) 的梯度是 μ0\mu_0，pbp_b 的梯度是 −μ1-\mu_1。

The ends give 2+1=32+1=3 conditions, the order of the three-component first-order adjoint ODE. μ0\mu_0 and μ1\mu_1 are exactly the multipliers used for the boundary-data derivatives in A.4: when p0p_0, T0T_0 or pbp_b change, the gradients are given by these multipliers: that with respect to (p0,T0)(p_0,T_0) is μ0\mu_0 and that with respect to pbp_b is −μ1-\mu_1.

A.4 面积导数和边界数据导数

A.4 Area and boundary-data derivatives

δAℛ=(δAF)′−δA′pe2,δQ=∫01[(jA+λ′TF)δA+(jA′+λ2p)δA′]dx−[λTFδA]01.\delta_A\mathcal R=(\delta A F)'-\delta A'pe_2,\quad\delta Q=\int_0^1\left[(j_A+\lambda'^TF)\delta A+(j_{A'}+\lambda_2p)\delta A'\right]dx-\left[\lambda^TF\delta A\right]_0^1.

推力有 jAj_A=0、jA′j_{A'}=p；反设计有 jAj_A=(p−p⋆)²/2、jA′j_{A'}=0。若希望只剩 δA，再对第二项分部积分，但必须同时保留新产生的端点项。本页验证方向 δA=−0.02sin²(πx) 在两端为零，所以上式最后一项消失；这不是对任意面积设计变量都成立的假设。

For thrust, jAj_A=0 and jA′j_{A'}=p. For inverse design, jAj_A=(p−p⋆)²/2 and jA′j_{A'}=0. One may integrate the δA′ term by parts again, but must retain the resulting endpoint terms. The tested direction δA=−0.02sin²(πx) vanishes at both ends, cancelling the displayed endpoint term. Arbitrary area variables need not do so.

q0=A0B0Tλ0=C0,UTμ0,q1=A1B1Tλ1=C1,UTμ1,δQboundary=μ0Tδ(p0,T0)−μ1δpb.q_0=A_0B_0^T\lambda_0=C_{0,U}^T\mu_0,\quad q_1=A_1B_1^T\lambda_1=C_{1,U}^T\mu_1,\qquad\delta Q_{boundary}=\mu_0^T\delta(p_0,T_0)-\mu_1\delta p_b.

上式利用边界伴随条件把 q 放入约束梯度的列空间。固定状态边界数据时这一项为零；改变入口或出口数据时必须保留。若目标还含端点函数，其状态导数也应并入边界条件，本页两个积分目标没有该项。

The adjoint boundary conditions place q in the range of the constraint-gradient transpose. This contribution vanishes for fixed boundary data, but remains when inlet totals or exit pressure change. Endpoint objective terms would also modify boundary conditions; the two integral objectives here have none.

逐步推导：推力为什么对内部面积没有导数

Step by step: why the thrust has no interior area derivative

推力可以不借助伴随直接分析。第一步，动量方程是 (AF2)′=A′p(AF_2)'=A'p，积分一次，推力等于两端动量通量之差：

The thrust can be analysed without the adjoint. First, the momentum equation is (AF2)′=A′p(AF_2)'=A'p; one integration shows that the thrust equals the difference of the end momentum fluxes:

QT=∫01pA′ dx=[AF2]01=A(1)F2(1)−A(0)F2(0).Q_T=\int_0^1pA'\,dx=\bigl[AF_2\bigr]_0^1=A(1)F_2(1)-A(0)F_2(0).

第二步，等熵、亚声速、不阻塞时，总压 p0p_0、总温 T0T_0 沿程不变，截面状态只由当地马赫数 MM 决定。对 γ=1.4\gamma=1.4，静压、动量通量和单位面积质量流量分别是

Second, for isentropic, subsonic, unchoked flow the total pressure p0p_0 and total temperature T0T_0 are constant and the state of a section is fixed by its Mach number MM. For γ=1.4\gamma=1.4 the static pressure, the momentum flux and the mass flow per unit area are

p=p0(1+0.2M2)3.5,F2=ρu2+p=p (1+γM2),ρu=p0T0 m(M),m(M)=γ M(1+0.2M2)3.\begin{gathered}p=\frac{p_0}{(1+0.2M^2)^{3.5}},\qquad F_2=\rho u^2+p=p\,(1+\gamma M^2),\\ \rho u=\frac{p_0}{\sqrt{T_0}}\,m(M),\qquad m(M)=\frac{\sqrt\gamma\,M}{(1+0.2M^2)^3}.\end{gathered}

第三步，记 M0=M(0)M_0=M(0)、M1=M(1)M_1=M(1)。出口马赫数由出口静压决定，质量守恒再把入口马赫数与两端面积联系起来：

Third, write M0=M(0)M_0=M(0) and M1=M(1)M_1=M(1). The exit Mach number is set by the outlet static pressure, and conservation of mass ties the inlet Mach number to the two end areas:

(1+0.2M12)3.5=p0pb,m(M0) A(0)=m(M1) A(1).\Bigl(1+0.2M_1^2\Bigr)^{3.5}=\frac{p_0}{p_b},\qquad m(M_0)\,A(0)=m(M_1)\,A(1).

所以 QT=A(1)F2(M1)−A(0)F2(M0)Q_T=A(1)F_2(M_1)-A(0)F_2(M_0) 只依赖 A(0)A(0)、A(1)A(1) 和边界数据，与中间形状无关。本页 A(0)=A(1)=1A(0)=A(1)=1、p0=1p_0=1、pb=0.9p_b=0.9：M0=M1=0.3909M_0=M_1=0.3909，两端状态完全相同，QT=0Q_T=0，任何保持两端的面积扰动都不改变它。

Hence QT=A(1)F2(M1)−A(0)F2(M0)Q_T=A(1)F_2(M_1)-A(0)F_2(M_0) depends only on A(0)A(0), A(1)A(1) and the boundary data, not on the shape in between. On this page A(0)=A(1)=1A(0)=A(1)=1, p0=1p_0=1 and pb=0.9p_b=0.9: M0=M1=0.3909M_0=M_1=0.3909, the two end states coincide, QT=0Q_T=0, and no perturbation that keeps both ends changes it.

Fourth, differentiate with respect to the end areas. With F2F_2 and mm as functions of MM, take the logarithmic derivatives; their ratio times F2F_2 gives the second line:

F2′F2=2γM1+γM2−γM1+0.2M2,m′m=1−M2M (1+0.2M2),F2′ mm′=γM2p.\begin{gathered}\frac{F_2'}{F_2}=\frac{2\gamma M}{1+\gamma M^2}-\frac{\gamma M}{1+0.2M^2},\qquad \frac{m'}{m}=\frac{1-M^2}{M\,(1+0.2M^2)},\\ F_2'\,\frac{m}{m'}=\gamma M^2p.\end{gathered}

质量守恒给出 ∂M0/∂A(0)=−m(M0)/(A(0) m′(M0))\partial M_0/\partial A(0)=-m(M_0)/\bigl(A(0)\,m'(M_0)\bigr) 与 ∂M0/∂A(1)=m(M1)/(A(0) m′(M0))\partial M_0/\partial A(1)=m(M_1)/\bigl(A(0)\,m'(M_0)\bigr)，M1M_1 不随面积变化。代入并用 m(M1)/m(M0)=A(0)/A(1)m(M_1)/m(M_0)=A(0)/A(1)：

Substituting, with m(M1)/m(M0)=A(0)/A(1)m(M_1)/m(M_0)=A(0)/A(1):

∂QT∂A(0)=−F2(M0)+F2′(M0)m(M0)m′(M0)=−p(0),∂QT∂A(1)=F2(M1)−γM02 p(0) A(0)A(1).\begin{aligned}\frac{\partial Q_T}{\partial A(0)}&=-F_2(M_0)+F_2'(M_0)\frac{m(M_0)}{m'(M_0)}=-p(0),\\ \frac{\partial Q_T}{\partial A(1)}&=F_2(M_1)-\gamma M_0^2\,p(0)\,\frac{A(0)}{A(1)}.\end{aligned}

入口一式对任何流道都成立。出口一式在本页 M0=M1=MM_0=M_1=M、A(0)=A(1)A(0)=A(1) 时化为 p(1)(1+γM2)−γM2p(1)=p(1)p(1)(1+\gamma M^2)-\gamma M^2p(1)=p(1)。

The inlet formula holds for any duct. On this page, with M0=M1=MM_0=M_1=M and A(0)=A(1)A(0)=A(1), the outlet formula reduces to p(1)(1+γM2)−γM2p(1)=p(1)p(1)(1+\gamma M^2)-\gamma M^2p(1)=p(1).

伴随给出同样的结论。把 A.4 中 δA′\delta A' 一项再分部积分一次：

The adjoint agrees. Integrating the δA′\delta A' term of A.4 by parts once more:

δQT=∫01[λ′TF−((1+λ2)p)′]⏟d(x)δA dx+[((1+λ2)p−λTF)δA]01.\delta Q_T=\int_0^1\underbrace{\Bigl[\lambda'^TF-\bigl((1+\lambda_2)p\bigr)'\Bigr]}_{d(x)}\delta A\,dx+\Bigl[\bigl((1+\lambda_2)p-\lambda^TF\bigr)\delta A\Bigr]_0^1.

图 A.3(b) 中推力的 λ 在两端为零，端点系数就是 p(1)p(1) 与 −p(0)-p(0)，与上式一致。体内密度 dd 恒为零：数值上 max⁡∣d∣\max|d| 只有 max⁡∣λ′TF∣\max|\lambda'^TF| 的 7.2×10−107.2\times10^{-10}，是 RK4 与差商的误差。所以本页验证方向 δA=−0.02sin⁡2(πx)\delta A=-0.02\sin^2(\pi x) 的伴随梯度是 −2.5×10−15-2.5\times10^{-15}，连续差分是 −1.6×10−13-1.6\times10^{-13}，都只是舍入误差。

The thrust λ of Figure A.3(b) vanishes at both ends, so the end coefficients are p(1)p(1) and −p(0)-p(0), as above. The interior density dd is identically zero: numerically max⁡∣d∣\max|d| is only 7.2×10−107.2\times10^{-10} of max⁡∣λ′TF∣\max|\lambda'^TF|, the error of RK4 and the difference quotient. Hence the adjoint gradient for this page's test direction δA=−0.02sin⁡2(πx)\delta A=-0.02\sin^2(\pi x) is −2.5×10−15-2.5\times10^{-15} and the continuous difference −1.6×10−13-1.6\times10^{-13}, both rounding.

两端 λ 为零也可以直接推出。由 A.4，μ0\mu_0 与 −μ1-\mu_1 就是 QTQ_T 对 (p0,T0)(p_0,T_0) 与 pbp_b 的导数。对称流道的两端状态对任何边界数据都相同，QTQ_T 恒为零，所以 μ0=0\mu_0=0、μ1=0\mu_1=0。亚声速时 det⁡B≠0\det B\ne0（A.5），由 A0B0Tλ(0)=C0,UTμ0=0A_0B_0^T\lambda(0)=C_{0,U}^T\mu_0=0 得 λ(0)=0\lambda(0)=0，同理 λ(1)=0\lambda(1)=0。λ 在内部不为零：它描述残差（源项）扰动的影响，而面积扰动沿解流形移动时，各项贡献恰好抵消。

That λ vanishes at both ends also follows directly. By A.4, μ0\mu_0 and −μ1-\mu_1 are the derivatives of QTQ_T with respect to (p0,T0)(p_0,T_0) and pbp_b. On a symmetric duct the two end states coincide for any boundary data, QTQ_T is identically zero, and so μ0=0\mu_0=0 and μ1=0\mu_1=0. In subsonic flow det⁡B≠0\det B\ne0 (A.5), so A0B0Tλ(0)=C0,UTμ0=0A_0B_0^T\lambda(0)=C_{0,U}^T\mu_0=0 gives λ(0)=0\lambda(0)=0, and likewise λ(1)=0\lambda(1)=0. Inside, λ is not zero: it measures the effect of residual (source) perturbations, while for area perturbations moving along the solution manifold the contributions cancel exactly.

A.5 独立原始参考、射击法和可解性

A.5 Independent primal reference, shooting and solvability

先由出口压力求 MeM_e，再用守恒质量流量在每个 x 上二分求 0<M<1 的等熵根。得到 U(x) 后，连续伴随是非齐次线性 ODE。积分一个零初值特解和三个单位初值齐次解，均使用 RK4；由左端一条、右端两条约束组成 3×3 系统，求线性组合系数。这与转置离散 Euler 矩阵是完全不同的计算。

Compute exit Mach from pressure, then use conserved mass flow and bisection to find the subsonic isentropic root at each x. Given U(x), integrate the affine linear adjoint ODE using RK4: one particular solution with zero initial value and three homogeneous solutions with unit initial values. One inlet and two outlet conditions determine three combination coefficients through a 3×3 solve. This is independent of transposing the discrete Euler matrix.

λ(x)=z(x)+Y(x)c,[N0TA0B0TN1TA1B1TY(1)]c=[0−N1TA1B1Tz(1)],Y(0)=I,  z(0)=0.\lambda(x)=z(x)+Y(x)c,\quad \begin{bmatrix}N_0^TA_0B_0^T\\N_1^TA_1B_1^TY(1)\end{bmatrix}c=\begin{bmatrix}0\\-N_1^TA_1B_1^Tz(1)\end{bmatrix},\quad Y(0)=I,\;z(0)=0.
U(x) = subsonic_isentropic_root(area(x), outlet_pressure)
f(x,lambda) = inverse(transpose(F_U(U(x)))) *
              (-j_U(x)-area_prime(x)*pressure_U(U(x))*lambda[1])/area(x)
z = RK4(f, initial=0)
Y[:,k] = RK4(homogeneous_part(f), initial=unit(k))
c = solve_3x3(left_and_right_boundary_conditions)
lambda(x) = z(x)+Y(x)*c
g = Simpson(j_explicit + dot(lambda_prime,F)*dA + lambda[1]*p*dA_prime)

局部条件 det B≠0 排除了 u=0 和 u=±c；还需上述射击矩阵可逆才能得到唯一两端解。接近阻塞、跨声速或激波时，不能靠把 ODE 步长变小解决适定性问题。下方可选 64／128／256／512 个步，检查解和梯度是否随 ODE 步长收敛，并与独立等熵流场中心差分比较。

Local invertibility det B≠0 excludes u=0 and u=±c. The shooting matrix must also be invertible for a unique two-end solution. Near choking, transonic transitions or shocks, reducing the ODE step does not repair ill-posedness. Select 64/128/256/512 steps below to test ODE and gradient convergence against independently recomputed isentropic finite differences.

A.6 与离散乘子比较时的约定

A.6 Conventions when comparing discrete multipliers

正文用积分残差和 Q+ψTR，所以内部有 λ≈−ψ；若残差除以体积，乘子还必须作相应缩放。格点端点的被替换行是边界约束，其乘子不是同位置的连续场分量。图中仅比较内部完整守恒块，并通过同一 δA 的总方向导数作更稳健的比较。目标压力在离散问题中固定为各阶各网格的离散目标，在连续问题中固定为等熵目标；两者只在加密极限趋于同一函数。

The main text uses integrated residuals and Q+ψTR, giving λ≈−ψ in the interior. Volume-normalised residuals require rescaled multipliers. Replaced endpoint rows on the node page carry constraint multipliers, not continuous field components. Compare only interior intact conservation blocks and also compare total derivatives along the same δA. Discrete targets use each grid/order’s fixed discrete flow; the continuous target is isentropic. They approach the same target only under refinement.

(function(root){'use strict';const Q=typeof module!=='undefined'?require('./core'):root.QEuler,{solve3,dot,norm}=Q;
const area=x=>1-.3*Math.sin(Math.PI*x)**2,areaD=x=>-.3*Math.PI*Math.sin(2*Math.PI*x),direction=x=>-.02*Math.sin(Math.PI*x)**2,directionD=x=>-.02*Math.PI*Math.sin(2*Math.PI*x),targetArea=x=>area(x)*(1-.04*Math.sin(Math.PI*x));

const baseFlow=flow;

Appendix B: from smooth solutions to discontinuities and shocks

进阶教学 · 选读Advanced teaching · optional

B.1–B.5 的跳跃守恒、移动界面项、位置拟合与约化伴随属于进阶教学。B.5 的标量乘子不等于完整连续 Euler 伴随场。将这些局部／单激波关系推广为任意流道、激波相互作用的存在唯一性或稳定性理论，超出当前实现。

Jump conservation, moving-interface terms, shock fitting and the reduced adjoint in B.1–B.5 are advanced teaching. The scalar multiplier in B.5 is not a full continuous Euler adjoint field. Extending these local/single-shock relations to existence, uniqueness or stability for arbitrary ducts and interacting shocks is outside this implementation.

B.1 先区分光滑流道与激波问题

B.1 Separate smooth duct flow from shock problems

主求解器检查全部状态保持亚声速，因此不能用降低出口压力的方式偷偷引入激波。激波扩展需要新的原始分支、熵条件、适用于间断的数值通量及限制器，还需要明确激波位置如何改变。这里先给出 Euler 激波的独立局部计算和伴随推导入口；B.1–B.4 的局部计算不是完整激波流道求解器；B.5 另给出独立的全流道位置拟合与约化伴随，B.6 提供独立的激波捕捉有限体积实验。

The main solver enforces subsonic states; lowering exit pressure cannot silently turn it into a shock solver. Shocks require a new primal branch, entropy selection, discontinuity-compatible flux/limiting and a treatment of shock-position changes. This appendix provides an independent local Euler shock calculation and the starting adjoint derivation, not a completed shock-containing duct solver in B.1–B.4; B.5 adds an independent whole-duct shock fit and reduced adjoint; B.6 provides an independent shock-capturing finite-volume experiment.

把守恒方程在激波两侧的小区间积分，区间长度趋零时有界几何源项消失，留下 Rankine–Hugoniot 跳跃条件。静止正激波的三条条件是质量、动量和总焓连续；满足它们还不够，需选择熵增加、超声速转为亚声速的物理解。

Integrate conservation over a shrinking interval surrounding the shock. The bounded geometry source vanishes, leaving the Rankine–Hugoniot condition. A stationary normal shock conserves mass, momentum and total enthalpy. Select the entropy-increasing supersonic-to-subsonic branch in addition to these conservation conditions.
