B.2 固定界面跳跃的 tangent 和 adjoint

B.2 Tangent and adjoint of a fixed jump interface

先固定激波位置与速度。在非声速上下游状态处，线性化 [F]=0 得 B+U˙+=B−U˙−B^+\dot U^+=B^-\dot U^-，于是跳跃映射 T=(B⁺)⁻¹B⁻。反向传播不是把上游下游简单交换，而是 TT。下方计算器同时检查跳跃守恒与这个点积恒等式。这只证明固定界面局部映射，不包括激波移动的导数。

First fix shock position and speed. Away from sonic states, linearising [F]=0 gives B+U˙+=B−U˙−B^+\dot U^+=B^-\dot U^-, so T=(B⁺)⁻¹B⁻. Reverse propagation is TT, not a simple swap of upstream and downstream states. The calculator checks jump conservation and this dot-product identity. This verifies only the local fixed-interface map, not shock motion.

U˙+=TU˙−,T=(B+)−1B−,Uˉ−=(B−)T(B+)−TUˉ+,(Uˉ+)TU˙+=(Uˉ−)TU˙−.\dot U^+=T\dot U^-,\quad T=(B^+)^{-1}B^-,\quad\bar U^-=(B^-)^T(B^+)^{-T}\bar U^+,\quad(\bar U^+)^T\dot U^+=(\bar U^-)^T\dot U^-.

B.3 移动界面不能忽略

B.3 The interface-position variation cannot be omitted

δ[AF]+[(AF)′]δξ=0,δ[AF]=[ABδU+FδA],δQ=∫0ξδj−dx+∫ξ1δj+dx+(j−−j+)δξ.\delta[AF]+[(AF)']\delta\xi=0,\quad\delta[AF]=[AB\delta U+F\delta A],\quad\delta Q=\int_0^\xi\delta j^-dx+\int_\xi^1\delta j^+dx+(j^--j^+)\delta\xi.

δU 表示固定坐标处的扰动；移动界面还要加 U′δξ 的迹变化。分别在两段做分部积分，界面贡献为 λ+TA⁺B⁺δU⁺−λ−TA⁻B⁻δU⁻，并叠加位置项与跳跃约束乘子。消去允许的两侧迹和 δξ 后，才得到完整内部伴随传递条件。若把 δξ=0 强行固定，算出的只是固定激波位置的问题。

Here δU is an Eulerian perturbation; moving traces also contain U′δξ. Integration by parts on each side produces λ+TA⁺B⁺δU⁺−λ−TA⁻B⁻δU⁻ at the interface, together with location and jump-constraint multiplier terms. Eliminate admissible traces and δξ to derive the full internal adjoint conditions. Imposing δξ=0 instead differentiates a fixed-shock problem.

B.3（续）内部伴随条件：消去 δU⁺ 与 δξ

B.3 (continued) Internal adjoint conditions: eliminating δU⁺ and δξ

沿用附录 A 的约定 ℒ = Q − ∫λTℛ dx、ℛ = (AF)′ − A′p e₂，在 (0, ξ) 与 (ξ, 1) 上分别分部积分。两侧的体积项给出与附录 A 相同的伴随方程，激波处剩下：

Keep the convention of Appendix A, ℒ = Q − ∫λTℛ dx with ℛ = (AF)′ − A′p e₂, and integrate by parts on (0, ξ) and (ξ, 1) separately. The volume terms give the adjoint equation of Appendix A on each side; at the shock what remains is:

δℒ∣x=ξ=[λTAB δU]+(j−−j+) δξ,[q]=q+−q−.\delta\mathcal L\big|_{x=\xi}=\big[\lambda^TAB\,\delta U\big]+(j^--j^+)\,\delta\xi,\qquad [q]=q^+-q^-.

A 在激波处连续且 [F] = 0，所以线化跳跃条件中的 δA[F] 为零；两侧的原始方程给出 (AF)′ = A′p e₂，于是 [(AF)′] = A′(ξ)[p]e₂。B.3 的线化条件成为：

A is continuous at the shock and [F] = 0, so the δA[F] term of the linearised jump vanishes; the primal equation on each side gives (AF)′ = A′p e₂, hence [(AF)′] = A′(ξ)[p]e₂. The linearised condition of B.3 becomes:

A(B+δU+−B−δU−)+A′(ξ) [p] e2 δξ=0.A\big(B^+\delta U^+-B^-\delta U^-\big)+A'(\xi)\,[p]\,e_2\,\delta\xi=0.

用它消去 B⁺δU⁺，激波处的项整理为：

Using it to eliminate B⁺δU⁺, the terms at the shock become:

δℒ∣x=ξ=(λ+−λ−)TA B−δU−+(j−−j+−A′(ξ) [p] λ2) δξ.\delta\mathcal L\big|_{x=\xi}=(\lambda^+-\lambda^-)^TA\,B^-\delta U^-+\big(j^--j^+-A'(\xi)\,[p]\,\lambda_2\big)\,\delta\xi.

上游是超声速流：三条特征都从上游到达激波，δU⁻ 由上游数据决定、可以取任意值，且 B⁻ 可逆；δξ 由整个问题决定，不能预先给定。两个系数都必须为零，这就是激波处的内部伴随条件：

Upstream the flow is supersonic: all three characteristics reach the shock from upstream, so δU⁻ is set by upstream data and can take any value, and B⁻ is invertible; δξ is decided by the whole problem and cannot be prescribed. Both coefficients must vanish, and these are the internal adjoint conditions at the shock:

[λ]=0,A′(ξ) [p] λ2(ξ)=j−(ξ)−j+(ξ).\boxed{[\lambda]=0},\qquad\boxed{A'(\xi)\,[p]\,\lambda_2(\xi)=j^-(\xi)-j^+(\xi)}.

对 j = w(x)p（压力积分 w = 1，壁面推力 w = A′），第二式给出 λ₂(ξ) = −w(ξ)/A′(ξ)：压力积分为 −1/A′(ξ)，推力为 −1，都与激波强度无关。代回两侧的伴随方程，右端恰好为零，所以伴随在激波两侧的导数也为零：

For j = w(x)p (pressure integral w = 1, wall thrust w = A′) the second condition gives λ₂(ξ) = −w(ξ)/A′(ξ): −1/A′(ξ) for the pressure integral and −1 for thrust, independent of the shock strength. Substituted into the adjoint equation on either side it makes the right-hand side vanish, so the adjoint also has zero slope at the shock:

λ2(ξ)=−w(ξ)A′(ξ),−ABTλ′∣ξ±=(w+A′λ2) pUT∣ξ±=0 ⟹ λ′(ξ±)=0.\lambda_2(\xi)=-\frac{w(\xi)}{A'(\xi)},\qquad -AB^T\lambda'\big|_{\xi^\pm}=\big(w+A'\lambda_2\big)\,p_U^T\big|_{\xi^\pm}=0\ \Longrightarrow\ \lambda'(\xi^\pm)=0.

条件的个数与特征方向一致。伴随特征的方向与原始流动相反：下游亚声速区有两条从出口进入，对应附录 A.3 的两个出口条件，一条从激波进入，对应上面的 λ₂ 条件；上游超声速区三条都从激波进入，由连续性 [λ] = 0 给出。反过来，若强行令 δξ = 0（B.2 的固定界面），下游扰动要同时满足三个跳跃条件和出口条件，一般无解：激波位置正是那个多出来的未知量。背压导数仍按附录 A.4 读出：

The number of conditions matches the characteristic directions. Adjoint characteristics run opposite to the flow’s: in the subsonic downstream region two enter from the outlet, matching the two outlet conditions of Appendix A.3, and one enters from the shock, matching the λ₂ condition above; in the supersonic upstream region all three enter from the shock and come from continuity [λ] = 0. Conversely, forcing δξ = 0 (the fixed interface of B.2) would ask the downstream perturbation to meet three jump conditions and the outlet condition at once, which in general has no solution: the shock position is exactly the extra unknown. The back-pressure derivative is read off as in Appendix A.4:

A1B1Tλ(1)=μ1 pU(1)T,dQdpb=−μ1.A_1B_1^T\lambda(1)=\mu_1\,p_U(1)^T,\qquad\frac{dQ}{dp_b}=-\mu_1.

图 B.3 的 λ(x) 就按这些条件计算：出口的两个条件留下一个未知数 μ₁，由激波条件确定，再以连续性为初值向喉部积分。它与 B.5 相互独立（B.5 把流场消元后只剩一个标量 ψ），两者应给出同一个导数。ξ = 0.75 时，压力积分的 −μ₁ = 0.915331474650869，B.5（每段 192 面板）为 0.915331474626099，与本页代码无共享的 30 位高精度参考为 0.915331474650867；推力为 1.156988045808，B.5 给出 1.156988045795。所以 B.5 的约化乘子 ψ 正是连续伴随的出口乘子 μ₁。另把 cos⁴ 形的面积凸起分别放在超声速区、下游区和跨过激波处，用这个伴随算出的梯度与重新求解激波位置的高精度差分相差不到 10⁻⁹（压力积分）。

The λ(x) of Figure B.3 is computed exactly this way: the two outlet conditions leave one unknown μ₁, the shock condition fixes it, and continuity starts the integration towards the throat. It is independent of B.5, which eliminates the flow and keeps a single scalar ψ, and the two must give the same derivative. At ξ = 0.75 the pressure integral gives −μ₁ = 0.915331474650869; B.5 (192 panels per segment) gives 0.915331474626099, and a 30-digit reference sharing no code with this page gives 0.915331474650867. For thrust: 1.156988045808 against 1.156988045795 from B.5. So the reduced multiplier ψ of B.5 is exactly the outlet multiplier μ₁ of the continuous adjoint. Area bumps of cos⁴ shape placed in the supersonic region, downstream, and straddling the shock give adjoint gradients within 10⁻⁹ of high-precision differences that re-solve the shock position (pressure integral).

图中喉部下游的推力伴随是常数：在这一段 λ₂ ≡ −1，λ = (λ₁, −1, λ₃) 由出口条件决定。完整收扩喷管还须补上喉部上游亚声速段；默认等端面积、非零压缩激波下，该段 λ₂ 严格大于 −1，并非常数场的延拓。这对应一个守恒事实：推力 ∫pA′dx 等于两端动量通量之差。喉部阻塞时质量流量 qmq_m（即 ρuA）正比于喉部面积 A*；入口状态由 A(0)/A* 决定，出口状态由 qmq_m、pbp_b 和总温决定。所以只要面积扰动不碰两端、也不改变喉部面积，两端状态就不变，推力也不变；伴随对上述三个凸起（都离开喉部）给出的梯度都在 10⁻¹³ 以内（精确值为 0）。改变喉部面积则改变 qmq_m 和两端状态，推力随之改变。这一贡献集中在声速喉部，本页在喉部截断的光滑伴随积分不包含它，喉部面积的导数需要单独处理，推导见下。压力积分的伴随则在喉部有对数奇点：x − 0.5 每缩小十倍，λ 约增加 (0.918, −0.992, 0.262)。激波处连续、导数为零、需要一个内部条件，以及声速喉部的对数奇点，都与 Giles 和 Pierce 对拟一维 Euler 伴随解析解的结论一致（J. Fluid Mech. 426, 2001）。

The plotted thrust adjoint is constant downstream of the throat: λ₂ ≡ −1 there, and λ = (λ₁, −1, λ₃) is fixed by the outlet conditions. The complete converging–diverging duct also needs the upstream subsonic part; for the default equal end areas and a nonzero compressive shock, its λ₂ is strictly greater than −1 and is not an extension of that constant field. This reflects a conservation fact: the thrust ∫pA′dx equals the difference of the end momentum fluxes. With the throat choked, the mass flow qmq_m (that is, ρuA) is proportional to the throat area A*; the inlet state is set by A(0)/A*, the outlet state by qmq_m, pbp_b and the total temperature. So an area change that leaves the ends and the throat area unchanged leaves both end states, and the thrust, unchanged; for the three bumps above, all away from the throat, the adjoint gradients are below 10⁻¹³ (exact value 0). Changing the throat area changes qmq_m and both end states, and so the thrust. That contribution is concentrated at the sonic throat: the smooth adjoint integral on this page, truncated at the throat, does not contain it, and the throat-area derivative needs a separate treatment, derived below. The pressure-integral adjoint, by contrast, has a logarithmic singularity at the throat: λ grows by about (0.918, −0.992, 0.262) for every tenfold decrease of x − 0.5. Continuity with zero slope at the shock, the need for one internal condition, and the logarithmic singularity at the sonic throat all agree with the analytic quasi-one-dimensional Euler adjoint solutions of Giles and Pierce (J. Fluid Mech. 426, 2001).

逐步推导：喉部面积的推力导数

Step by step: the thrust derivative with respect to the throat area

推力等于两端动量通量之差，F=(ρu2+p)A=qmu+pAF=(\rho u^2+p)A=q_mu+pA。两端面积与 pbp_b 固定时，两端状态只通过喉部面积 A∗A^* 变化：入口在 A(0)/A∗=Φ(M0)A(0)/A^*=\Phi(M_0) 的亚声速根上取等熵状态；出口由阻塞质量流量 qm=A∗ρ∗u∗q_m=A^*\rho^*u^*、p(1)=pbp(1)=p_b 与总温 T0=1T_0=1 决定（本页 p0=T0=R=1p_0=T_0=R=1，γ=1.4\gamma=1.4）。

The thrust is the difference of the end momentum fluxes, F=(ρu2+p)A=qmu+pAF=(\rho u^2+p)A=q_mu+pA. With both end areas and pbp_b fixed, the end states change only through the throat area A∗A^*: the inlet takes the isentropic state on the subsonic root of A(0)/A∗=Φ(M0)A(0)/A^*=\Phi(M_0); the outlet is set by the choked mass flow qm=A∗ρ∗u∗q_m=A^*\rho^*u^*, p(1)=pbp(1)=p_b and the total temperature T0=1T_0=1 (on this page p0=T0=R=1p_0=T_0=R=1 and γ=1.4\gamma=1.4).

QT=F(1)−F(0),F(1)=qm u1+pbA(1),F(0)=p(0)A(0)(1+γM02),Φ(M)=1M(1+0.2M21.2)3.\begin{gathered}Q_T=F(1)-F(0),\qquad F(1)=q_m\,u_1+p_bA(1),\\F(0)=p(0)A(0)\bigl(1+\gamma M_0^2\bigr),\qquad \Phi(M)=\frac1M\Bigl(\frac{1+0.2M^2}{1.2}\Bigr)^3.\end{gathered}

入口：由 Φ′(M)=Φ(M)(M2−1)/(M(1+0.2M2))\Phi'(M)=\Phi(M)(M^2-1)/\bigl(M(1+0.2M^2)\bigr) 得 dM0/dA∗dM_0/dA^*，再对 p(0)=(1+0.2M02)−3.5p(0)=(1+0.2M_0^2)^{-3.5} 与 F(0)F(0) 求导，两个因子 1−M021-M_0^2 恰好相消：

Inlet: Φ′(M)=Φ(M)(M2−1)/(M(1+0.2M2))\Phi'(M)=\Phi(M)(M^2-1)/\bigl(M(1+0.2M^2)\bigr) gives dM0/dA∗dM_0/dA^*; differentiating p(0)=(1+0.2M02)−3.5p(0)=(1+0.2M_0^2)^{-3.5} and F(0)F(0), the two factors 1−M021-M_0^2 cancel:

dM0dA∗=M0(1+0.2M02)(1−M02)A∗,dF(0)dM0=γA(0)p(0)M0(1−M02)1+0.2M02⟹dF(0)dA∗=γp(0)A(0)M02A∗.\begin{gathered}\frac{dM_0}{dA^*}=\frac{M_0(1+0.2M_0^2)}{(1-M_0^2)A^*},\qquad \frac{dF(0)}{dM_0}=\frac{\gamma A(0)p(0)M_0(1-M_0^2)}{1+0.2M_0^2}\\\Longrightarrow\quad \frac{dF(0)}{dA^*}=\frac{\gamma p(0)A(0)M_0^2}{A^*}.\end{gathered}

出口：R=1R=1 时 u1=qmT1/(pbA(1))u_1=q_mT_1/\bigl(p_bA(1)\bigr)，总温不变给出 dT1=−(u1/cp) du1dT_1=-(u_1/c_p)\,du_1；消去 dT1dT_1，并用 qmu1/(cppbA(1))=(γ−1)M12q_mu_1/\bigl(c_pp_bA(1)\bigr)=(\gamma-1)M_1^2 与 dqm/dA∗=qm/A∗dq_m/dA^*=q_m/A^*：

Outlet: with R=1R=1, u1=qmT1/(pbA(1))u_1=q_mT_1/\bigl(p_bA(1)\bigr), and the constant total temperature gives dT1=−(u1/cp) du1dT_1=-(u_1/c_p)\,du_1; eliminate dT1dT_1 and use qmu1/(cppbA(1))=(γ−1)M12q_mu_1/\bigl(c_pp_bA(1)\bigr)=(\gamma-1)M_1^2 and dqm/dA∗=qm/A∗dq_m/dA^*=q_m/A^*:

du1dqm=u1/qm1+(γ−1)M12,dF(1)dA∗=qmA∗ d(qmu1)dqm=qmu1A∗ 2+(γ−1)M121+(γ−1)M12.\frac{du_1}{dq_m}=\frac{u_1/q_m}{1+(\gamma-1)M_1^2},\qquad \frac{dF(1)}{dA^*}=\frac{q_m}{A^*}\,\frac{d(q_m u_1)}{dq_m}=\frac{q_m u_1}{A^*}\,\frac{2+(\gamma-1)M_1^2}{1+(\gamma-1)M_1^2}.
dQTdA∗=qmu1A∗ 2+(γ−1)M121+(γ−1)M12−γp(0)A(0)M02A∗\boxed{\frac{dQ_T}{dA^*}=\frac{q_m u_1}{A^*}\,\frac{2+(\gamma-1)M_1^2}{1+(\gamma-1)M_1^2}-\frac{\gamma p(0)A(0)M_0^2}{A^*}}

本页 pb=0.8289p_b=0.8289（ξ=0.75\xi=0.75）：M0=0.4129M_0=0.4129，M1=0.4419M_1=0.4419，qm=0.6847q_m=0.6847，u1=0.5129u_1=0.5129；dF(1)/dA∗=0.6770dF(1)/dA^*=0.6770，dF(0)/dA∗=0.3289dF(0)/dA^*=0.3289，所以 dQT/dA∗=0.3480dQ_T/dA^*=0.3480。独立核对：在同样的激波拟合关系下把面积换成 A+ϵβA+\epsilon\beta（β\beta 是以喉部为中心的 cos⁡4\cos^4 凸起，β(0.5)=1\beta(0.5)=1，两端为零），每个 ϵ\epsilon 重新求激波位置，直接对 ∫pA′dx\int pA'dx 作中心差分，与上式之差小于 10−710^{-7}。

On this page pb=0.8289p_b=0.8289 (ξ=0.75\xi=0.75): M0=0.4129M_0=0.4129, M1=0.4419M_1=0.4419, qm=0.6847q_m=0.6847, u1=0.5129u_1=0.5129; dF(1)/dA∗=0.6770dF(1)/dA^*=0.6770 and dF(0)/dA∗=0.3289dF(0)/dA^*=0.3289, so dQT/dA∗=0.3480dQ_T/dA^*=0.3480. An independent check replaces the area by A+ϵβA+\epsilon\beta (β\beta a cos⁡4\cos^4 bump centred on the throat, β(0.5)=1\beta(0.5)=1, zero at both ends), re-solves the shock position for each ϵ\epsilon, and takes central differences of ∫pA′dx\int pA'dx directly; the difference from the formula is below 10−710^{-7}.

因此对任何保持两端面积不变的扰动都有 δQT=(dQT/dA∗) δA(0.5)\delta Q_T=(dQ_T/dA^*)\,\delta A(0.5)：A′(0.5)=0A'(0.5)=0，喉部面积的一阶变化就是 δA\delta A 在喉部的值。推力对面积的全部灵敏度集中在声速喉部这一点，喉部以外的光滑伴随积分部分为零，这正是上面三个凸起得到 0 的原因。增大喉部面积使 qmq_m 增大，出口动量通量的增量大于入口，推力增大。

Hence for every perturbation that keeps both end areas, δQT=(dQT/dA∗) δA(0.5)\delta Q_T=(dQ_T/dA^*)\,\delta A(0.5): since A′(0.5)=0A'(0.5)=0, the first-order change of the throat area is the value of δA\delta A at the throat. The whole area sensitivity of the thrust sits at the single sonic point, and the smooth adjoint integral away from the throat contributes zero, which is why the three bumps above give 0. Enlarging the throat raises qmq_m; the outlet momentum flux grows more than the inlet flux, and the thrust increases.

展开带内部激波条件的连续伴随的完整实现Complete implementation of the continuous adjoint with internal shock conditions
/* Continuous adjoint of the shock-fitted nozzle of Appendix B.5, with the
   internal shock conditions obtained by finishing the elimination of B.3.

   Convention of Appendix A: L = Q - int lambda^T R dx with (Q the objective,
   J the residual Jacobian on these pages), R = (AF)' - A' p e2, and
   [q] = q+ - q- across the shock at x = xi.
     interior:  -A B^T lambda' - A' lambda_2 p_U^T = j_U^T      (each side)
     shock:     [lambda] = 0,   A'(xi) [p] lambda_2(xi) = j- - j+
     outlet:    A B^T lambda(1) = mu_1 p_U(1)^T,   dQ/dp_b = -mu_1
   Objectives j = w(x) p with w = 1 (pressure integral) or w = A' (thrust).

   The flow is the isentropic / normal-shock solution of B.5 (same area,
   gamma = 1.4, inlet p0 = T0 = 1, R = 1). Downstream of the shock the
   linear adjoint ODE is integrated with RK4 in x from the outlet, as a
   particular solution plus mu_1 times a homogeneous one, and the shock
   condition fixes mu_1. Upstream of the shock, in the supersonic branch,
   continuity alone starts the integration; it runs in s = log(x - 1/2)
   because the pressure-integral adjoint has a logarithmic singularity at
   the sonic throat. Area-bump gradients are integrated alongside:
     dQ = int (j_A + lambda'^T F) dA + (j_A' + lambda_2 p) dA' dx. */
(function (root) {
  'use strict';
  const G = 1.4;
  const area = x => 1 + 2.2 * (x - 0.5) ** 2, areaX = x => 4.4 * (x - 0.5);
  const ratio = M => ((5 / 6) * (1 + 0.2 * M * M)) ** 3 / M;

  function mach(r, sup) {
    if (!(r >= 1 - 1e-14)) throw Error('Area below the sonic area');
    if (Math.abs(r - 1) < 1e-15) return 1;
    let lo = sup ? 1 : 1e-7, hi = sup ? 20 : 1;
    for (let k = 0; k < 60; k++) {
      const m = (lo + hi) / 2;
      if ((ratio(m) < r) === sup) lo = m; else hi = m;
    }
    let M = (lo + hi) / 2;
    for (let k = 0; k < 4; k++) {
      const f = ratio(M) - r, d = ratio(M) * (1.2 * M / (1 + 0.2 * M * M) - 1 / M);
      M -= f / d;
    }
    return M;
  }
  function state(M, p0) {
    const T = 1 / (1 + 0.2 * M * M), p = p0 * T ** 3.5, rho = p / T, u = M * Math.sqrt(G * T);
    return { M, p, rho, u, E: p / (G - 1) / rho + 0.5 * u * u };
  }
  function shock(xi) {
    const M1 = mach(area(xi), true), p1 = state(M1, 1).p;
    const M2 = Math.sqrt((1 + 0.2 * M1 * M1) / (G * M1 * M1 - 0.2));
    const p2 = p1 * (1 + 7 / 6 * (M1 * M1 - 1)), p02 = p2 * (1 + 0.2 * M2 * M2) ** 3.5;
    return { xi, M1, M2, p1, p2, p02 };          // downstream sonic area A*,+ = 1 / p02
  }
  const outletPressure = xi => { const s = shock(xi); return state(mach(area(1) * s.p02, false), s.p02).p; };
  function position(pb) {
    let a = 0.52, b = 0.98;
    const fa = outletPressure(a) - pb, fb = outletPressure(b) - pb;
    if (!(fa * fb < 0)) throw Error('Back pressure is outside the interior-shock bracket');
    let flo = fa;
    for (let k = 0; k < 200 && b - a > 1e-16; k++) {
      const m = (a + b) / 2, fm = outletPressure(m) - pb;
      if (fm * flo > 0) { a = m; flo = fm; } else b = m;
    }
    return (a + b) / 2;
  }
  /* side is explicit: at x = xi the two branches meet, and a rounded x must
     not pick the wrong one */
  const flow = (x, s, side) => side === 'up' ? state(mach(area(x), x > 0.5), 1) : state(mach(area(x) * s.p02, false), s.p02);

  function solve3(A, b) {
    const a = A.map((r, i) => [...r, b[i]]);
    for (let k = 0; k < 3; k++) {
      let p = k;
      for (let i = k + 1; i < 3; i++) if (Math.abs(a[i][k]) > Math.abs(a[p][k])) p = i;
      [a[p], a[k]] = [a[k], a[p]];
      for (let i = k + 1; i < 3; i++) { const f = a[i][k] / a[k][k]; for (let j = k; j < 4; j++) a[i][j] -= f * a[k][j]; }
    }
    const x = [0, 0, 0];
    for (let i = 2; i >= 0; i--) { let t = a[i][3]; for (let j = i + 1; j < 3; j++) t -= a[i][j] * x[j]; x[i] = t / a[i][i]; }
    return x;
  }
  /* A B^T and p_U^T at a state (B = F_U as in Appendix A.1, E = e / rho) */
  function ABt(q, A) {
    const { u, E } = q;
    return [[0, -(3 - G) / 2 * u * u, (G - 1) * u ** 3 - G * u * E],
            [1, (3 - G) * u, G * E - 1.5 * (G - 1) * u * u],
            [0, G - 1, G * u]].map(r => r.map(v => A * v));
  }
  const pU = q => [(G - 1) / 2 * q.u * q.u, -(G - 1) * q.u, G - 1];
  const fluxF = q => [q.rho * q.u, q.rho * q.u * q.u + q.p, (q.rho * q.E + q.p) * q.u];
  const weight = (kind, x) => kind === 'pressure' ? 1 : areaX(x);

  /* lambda' for the particular (with source) or homogeneous part */
  function slope(x, lam, s, side, kind, withSource) {
    const q = flow(x, s, side), P = pU(q), c = (withSource ? weight(kind, x) : 0) + areaX(x) * lam[1];
    return solve3(ABt(q, area(x)), P.map(v => -c * v));
  }
  /* a C3 bump: cos^4 has three continuous derivatives at its edges, so the
     RK4 quadrature of the gradient integrals keeps its order */
  function bump(c, w) {
    return {
      c, w,
      f: x => Math.abs(x - c) < w ? Math.cos(Math.PI * (x - c) / (2 * w)) ** 4 : 0,
      df: x => Math.abs(x - c) < w ? -4 * Math.cos(Math.PI * (x - c) / (2 * w)) ** 3 * Math.sin(Math.PI * (x - c) / (2 * w)) * Math.PI / (2 * w) : 0
    };
  }
  /* integrand of the area-bump gradient for the particular or homogeneous part */
  function bumpDensity(x, lam, s, side, kind, b, withSource) {
    const q = flow(x, s, side), dl = slope(x, lam, s, side, kind, withSource), F = fluxF(q);
    const jAp = withSource && kind === 'thrust' ? q.p : 0;
    return (dl[0] * F[0] + dl[1] * F[1] + dl[2] * F[2]) * b.f(x) + (jAp + lam[1] * q.p) * b.df(x);
  }

  /* RK4 for the pair (z, y) plus the bump integrals, in a variable t with
     x = X(t) and dx/dt = Xt(t) */
  function march(t0, t1, n, X, Xt, z0, y0, s, side, kind, bumps, keep) {
    const h = (t1 - t0) / n, out = [];
    let z = z0.slice(), y = y0.slice(), Iz = bumps.map(() => 0), Iy = bumps.map(() => 0);
    const deriv = (t, z, y) => {
      const x = X(t), j = Xt(t);
      return {
        z: slope(x, z, s, side, kind, true).map(v => v * j),
        y: slope(x, y, s, side, kind, false).map(v => v * j),
        Iz: bumps.map(b => bumpDensity(x, z, s, side, kind, b, true) * j),
        Iy: bumps.map(b => bumpDensity(x, y, s, side, kind, b, false) * j)
      };
    };
    const axpy = (a, v, k) => a.map((x, i) => x + k * v[i]);
    if (keep) out.push([X(t0), z.slice(), y.slice()]);
    for (let k = 0; k < n; k++) {
      const t = t0 + k * h;
      const k1 = deriv(t, z, y);
      const k2 = deriv(t + h / 2, axpy(z, k1.z, h / 2), axpy(y, k1.y, h / 2));
      const k3 = deriv(t + h / 2, axpy(z, k2.z, h / 2), axpy(y, k2.y, h / 2));
      const k4 = deriv(t + h, axpy(z, k3.z, h), axpy(y, k3.y, h));
      const comb = (a, key) => a.map((v, i) => v + h / 6 * (k1[key][i] + 2 * k2[key][i] + 2 * k3[key][i] + k4[key][i]));
      z = comb(z, 'z'); y = comb(y, 'y'); Iz = comb(Iz, 'Iz'); Iy = comb(Iy, 'Iy');
      if (keep) out.push([X(t + h), z.slice(), y.slice()]);
    }
    return { z, y, Iz, Iy, out };
  }

  function field(pb, kind = 'pressure', { steps = 4000, throat = 1e-4, bumps = [] } = {}) {
    if (!['pressure', 'thrust'].includes(kind)) throw Error('Choose pressure or thrust');
    const xi = position(pb), s = shock(xi), bs = bumps.map(([c, w]) => bump(c, w));
    const q1 = flow(1, s, 'down');
    const y1 = solve3(ABt(q1, area(1)), pU(q1));                     // lambda(1) per unit mu_1
    const id = t => t, one = () => 1;
    const down = march(1, xi, steps, id, one, [0, 0, 0], y1, s, 'down', kind, bs, true);
    /* shock condition, written out from the two shock states */
    const jm = weight(kind, xi) * s.p1, jp = weight(kind, xi) * s.p2;
    const lam2 = (jm - jp) / (areaX(xi) * (s.p2 - s.p1));
    const mu1 = (lam2 - down.z[1]) / down.y[1];
    const up = march(Math.log(xi - 0.5), Math.log(throat), steps, t => 0.5 + Math.exp(t), t => Math.exp(t),
      down.z, down.y, s, 'up', kind, bs, true);
    const lam = (z, y) => z.map((v, i) => v + mu1 * y[i]);
    const samples = [...up.out.slice().reverse(), ...down.out.slice().reverse().slice(1)]
      .map(([x, z, y]) => [x, lam(z, y)]);
    const qs = flow(xi, s, 'down'), qm = flow(xi, s, 'up'), lxi = lam(down.z, down.y);
    const slopeAt = q => { const c = weight(kind, xi) + areaX(xi) * lxi[1]; return solve3(ABt(q, area(xi)), pU(q).map(v => -c * v)); };
    return {
      pb, kind, xi, shock: s, mu1, gradient: -mu1, lam2Shock: lam2, lamShock: lxi,
      slopeMinus: slopeAt(qm), slopePlus: slopeAt(qs), samples,
      /* integrals run from 1 down to xi and from xi down to the throat, so
         both carry a minus sign relative to int_throat^1 */
      bumpGradients: bs.map((b, k) => -(down.Iz[k] + mu1 * down.Iy[k]) - (up.Iz[k] + mu1 * up.Iy[k]))
    };
  }

  /* the fitted flow itself, sampled on each side of the shock (Mach number,
     static and total pressure) */
  function profile(pb, n = 160) {
    const xi = position(pb), s = shock(xi), up = [], down = [];
    for (let k = 0; k <= n; k++) {
      const a = xi * k / n, qa = flow(a, s, 'up');
      up.push([a, qa.M, qa.p, 1]);
      const b = xi + (1 - xi) * k / n, qb = flow(b, s, 'down');
      down.push([b, qb.M, qb.p, s.p02]);
    }
    return { pb, xi, shock: s, up, down };
  }

  const api = { field, profile, position, shock, outletPressure, area, areaX };
  if (typeof module !== 'undefined') module.exports = api; else root.QShockAdjoint = api;
})(typeof window !== 'undefined' ? window : globalThis);

B.4 激波离散实现应如何验证

B.4 Verification required for shock discretisation

采用限制器后，必须保存并区分活跃分支：固定分支的离散导数、跨分支的有限差分以及网格极限中的移动激波导数不是同一对象。稳态残差、限制器、波速、边界与源项应进入同一计算图；复数步长只能验证基准分支的解析延拓。B.5–B.6 分别展示位置拟合与固定网格捕捉；应通过逐步长差分与网格加密报告分支变化、误差或不收敛，不能仅凭点积测试声称激波伴随已解决。原 B.6 二阶模型的 N=24 有向证书定位了背压约 0.7391592513074169 的精确稳态切换根：压力目标两侧导数约为 0.5938613640 和 0.6220204651，严格不同。这否定普遍经典可微性，不否定默认背压 0.75 的网格极限。

With limiting, record active branches and distinguish fixed-branch discrete derivatives, finite differences crossing branches and moving-shock derivatives in a mesh limit. Residual, limiter, wave speed, boundary and source must share the differentiated graph. Complex step checks only analytic continuation of the baseline branch. B.5–B.6 distinguish shock fitting from fixed-grid capturing. Step-size sweeps and refinement must report branch changes, errors and failed convergence. A dot-product test alone does not establish a correct moving-shock adjoint. A directed N=24 certificate for the original second-order B.6 model locates an exact steady switch root at back pressure approximately 0.7391592513074169: the pressure objective has unequal one-sided derivatives, about 0.5938613640 and 0.6220204651. This refutes universal classical differentiability; it does not refute the default back-pressure 0.75 mesh limit.

B.5 整个流道的激波位置拟合与约化伴随

B.5 Full-duct shock fitting and a reduced adjoint

下面是与顶部亚声速算例独立的实验。采用 A(x)=1+2.2(x−0.5)²、γ=1.4、入口 p₀=T₀=1，在喉部阻塞。上游由亚声速转为超声速，在扩张段 x=ξ 处发生正激波，下游为亚声速。两段光滑流动用等熵关系消元，激波满足质量、动量和能量跳跃；出口压力决定未知激波位置。它求解整个流道中的移动激波敏感度，不是正文有限体积格式，也不是完整连续伴随场或激波捕捉离散伴随。

This experiment is independent of the subsonic controls above. Use A(x)=1+2.2(x−0.5)², γ=1.4 and inlet p₀=T₀=1, with a choked throat. The upstream flow goes from subsonic to supersonic, a normal shock sits in the divergent branch at ξ, and the downstream flow is subsonic. Isentropic relations eliminate the smooth flow on each side; the shock satisfies mass, momentum and energy jumps. Outlet pressure determines its unknown position. This computes moving-shock sensitivities for a whole duct, but is not the main finite-volume scheme, a full continuous-adjoint field, or a shock-capturing discrete adjoint.

AA∗=1M[2γ+1(1+γ−12M2)]γ+12(γ−1),A∗,+=A∗,−p0,−p0,+.\frac{A}{A_*}=\frac1M\left[\frac{2}{\gamma+1}\left(1+\frac{\gamma-1}{2}M^2\right)\right]^{\frac{\gamma+1}{2(\gamma-1)}},\qquad A_{*,+}=A_{*,-}\frac{p_{0,-}}{p_{0,+}}.

先给 ξ：上游面积关系给 M⁻，正激波关系给 M⁺ 与下游总压 p₀,+，再从下游等熵关系求出口压力 P(ξ)。在 0.52<ξ<0.98 中求 G(ξ,pbp_b)=P(ξ)−pbp_b=0。只接受括区内部的压力；离开此分支不能把端点伪装成收敛激波。

Given ξ, the upstream area relation gives M⁻, the normal-shock relations give M⁺ and downstream total pressure, and downstream isentropic propagation gives outlet pressure P(ξ). Solve G(ξ,pbp_b)=P(ξ)−pbp_b=0 for 0.52<ξ<0.98. Only pressures inside the bracket are accepted; outside this branch an endpoint is not a converged interior shock.

Gξdξdpb=1,Gξψ=−Qξ,dQdpb=Qpb+ψGpb=−ψ.G_\xi\frac{d\xi}{dp_b}=1,\qquad G_\xi\psi=-Q_\xi,\qquad\frac{dQ}{dp_b}=Q_{p_b}+\psi G_{p_b}=-\psi.

这里 Q 没有显式 pbp_b 项，所有依赖经 ξ 以及已消元的下游流场传递。ψ 是一个约化系统乘子，不能画成三个连续 Euler 伴随分量。面积–马赫数方程用二分法求根，其导数通过隐函数关系求出；局部状态、跳跃和积分链式求导不使用差分步长。差分另行重求激波位置，用于检查。

Q has no explicit pbp_b term here; dependence passes through ξ and the eliminated downstream flow. ψ is one reduced-system multiplier, not three continuous Euler adjoint components. The area–Mach equation is solved by bisection and differentiated implicitly; local states, jumps and integration use chain-rule derivatives without finite-difference steps. The independent finite-difference check re-solves shock position.

Q(ξ)=∫0ξj−(x,ξ) dx+∫ξ1j+(x,ξ) dx,Qξ=∫0ξ∂ξj−dx+∫ξ1∂ξj+dx+j−(ξ)−j+(ξ).Q(\xi)=\int_0^\xi j^-(x,\xi)\,dx+\int_\xi^1j^+(x,\xi)\,dx,\quad Q_\xi=\int_0^\xi\partial_\xi j^-dx+\int_\xi^1\partial_\xi j^+dx+j^-(\xi)-j^+(\xi).

可选压力积分 j=p 或壁面推力 j=pA′。表格单独显示界面位移项与光滑区域贡献，并给出漏掉界面项后的错误梯度。积分在喉部和激波处分段；改变积分面板数可区分求积误差与求根误差。质量流率、跳跃残差，以及推力与端面动量通量差提供另外的守恒检查。

Choose pressure integral j=p or wall thrust j=pA′. The table separates interface motion from smooth-region contributions and reports the wrong gradient obtained by omitting the interface term. Quadrature is split at the throat and shock; changing its panel count separates quadrature from root-solving error. Mass flow, jump residuals and thrust versus end momentum flux provide additional conservation checks.

适定性在这里可直接观察：局部唯一位置要求 G_ξ≠0，位置敏感度为 1/G_ξ。把激波推近喉部时，激波变弱，出口压力对位置的区分能力下降，位置导数可能很大。较小差分步长只能减小截断误差，不能消除这种物理条件数；本实验也没有证明分支以外或任意流道中的唯一性。

Well-posedness is visible here: a locally unique position requires G_ξ≠0, and its sensitivity is 1/G_ξ. As the shock approaches the throat it weakens, outlet pressure distinguishes positions less strongly, and position sensitivity can become large. Smaller finite-difference steps reduce truncation error but cannot remove this physical conditioning. The experiment does not establish uniqueness outside this branch or for arbitrary ducts.

B.6 完整激波捕捉离散 tangent 与 adjoint

B.6 Shock-capturing discrete tangent and adjoint

研究性探索 · 选读Research exploration · optional

本节是混合内容：完整离散残差求导、tangent／adjoint 点积、LU 对照和完整重算差分是进阶教学；与 B.5 位置拟合梯度比较并据此分析网格极限属于研究性探索。24／48／96 网格上的非单调误差不建立收敛阶，也不证明最终不收敛。格点页复用同一个格心参考实验，不能作为格点激波格式的验证。

This is mixed content: complete residual differentiation, transpose tests, LU checks and full-rerun differences are advanced teaching. Comparing gradients with B.5 shock fitting to investigate mesh limits is research exploration. Nonmonotone errors on 24/48/96 cells establish neither an asymptotic rate nor eventual nonconvergence. The node page reuses the cell-centred experiment and does not validate a node-centred shock scheme.

本节新增独立的格心有限体积流道；格点页面也展示同一参考实现。几何和边界与 B.5 相同，但未知流场由守恒残差求解，激波位置没有作为约束。拟合解只用于初值和独立验证。它完整求导所选离散残差；不宣称实现任意激波相互作用或完整连续 Euler 伴随场。

This independent cell-centred finite-volume duct is displayed on both page variants. It uses B.5 geometry and boundaries, but solves conservative residuals without constraining shock position. Shock fitting supplies initialization and independent validation only. It differentiates the selected discrete residual completely; arbitrary shock interactions and a full continuous Euler adjoint field are not claimed.

Ri=Ai+1/2F^i+1/2−Ai−1/2F^i−1/2−[0∫IipAx dx0],A(x)=1+2.2(x−0.5)2.R_i=A_{i+1/2}\widehat F_{i+1/2}-A_{i-1/2}\widehat F_{i-1/2}-\begin{bmatrix}0\\\int_{I_i}pA_x\,dx\\0\end{bmatrix},\quad A(x)=1+2.2(x-0.5)^2.

面积在网格顶点取值并分片线性插值。二阶在无量纲原始变量 (ρ,u,p) 上逐分量限幅，再转换回守恒变量；体积分使用相同重构。数值通量采用固定耗散速度 α=3，所有重构面状态必须满足 |u|+c<3、ρ>0.01、p>0.01、u>0；失败会拒绝更新，未使用改变残差的正性裁剪。表中出口与入口的比熵差是物理诊断，不构成对整个二阶格式离散熵不等式的证明。未满足波速上界时，本模型不适用。

Area is sampled at mesh vertices and interpolated piecewise linearly. Second order limits each nondimensional primitive component (ρ,u,p), converts to conservative states, and uses the same reconstruction for volume integration. The flux has fixed dissipation speed α=3. All reconstructed traces must satisfy |u|+c<3, ρ>0.01, p>0.01 and u>0; invalid updates are rejected without residual-altering positivity clipping. The displayed outlet-minus-inlet entropy is a physical diagnostic, not a proof of a discrete entropy inequality for the second-order scheme. Outside that wave-speed bound this model does not apply.

F^(UL,UR)=12(FL+FR)−α2(UR−UL),Jhv=−Rpb,JhTψ=−QUT.\widehat F(U_L,U_R)=\tfrac12(F_L+F_R)-\tfrac\alpha2(U_R-U_L),\qquad J_hv=-R_{p_b},\quad J_h^T\psi=-Q_U^T.

入口给总压与总温，保留来自内部的出射信息；出口给背压。这一闭合要求入口、出口均处于正向亚声速分支，内部允许超声速。Newton 使用一阶块 GS 预处理 GMRES，必要时增加伪时间对角项并回溯；最终以未加移位的真实守恒残差判断收敛。非线性迭代轨迹不是稳态伴随的求导对象。

The inlet prescribes total pressure and temperature while retaining outgoing interior information; the outlet prescribes back pressure. Both boundaries must remain on positive-flow subsonic branches, while interior states may be supersonic. Newton uses first-order block-GS-preconditioned GMRES, with pseudo-time diagonal shifts and backtracking when needed. Convergence uses the unshifted conservative residual. The nonlinear iteration trajectory is not the differentiated object of the steady adjoint.

reconstruct primitive variables, including limiter derivatives
convert reconstructed traces to conservative variables
scatter conservative face fluxes and integrate p*dA/dx
solve R(U,p_b)=0 using damped Newton / block-GS GMRES
record the exact residual graph at the converged U
apply J*U_d forward; apply J^T*R_bar by reverse accumulation
solve tangent and adjoint using the same exact linearization
assemble J only for the independent LU diagnostic
re-solve R(U,p_b±h)=0 for every finite-difference step

完整导数包括边界闭合、原始变量转换、limiter、数值通量、面积源项和目标积分。所有面积节点、入口总量和背压均进入计算图；下方逐步演示背压方向。有限差分使用完整原始模型，冻结 limiter 对照若产生梯度偏差应被保留。粗网格一阶耗散可能抹掉整个超声速区域；此时仅能称为已收敛的粗网格离散解。

The derivative includes boundary closure, variable conversion, limiting, fluxes, area sources and objective integration. Every area node, inlet total and back pressure enters the graph; the panel demonstrates the back-pressure direction. Finite differences re-solve the full primal model, retaining any bias from the frozen-limiter comparison. Coarse first-order dissipation may erase the supersonic region entirely; such a result is only a converged coarse discrete solution.

这里的压力积分与壁面推力分别为 ∫p dx 和 ∫pA′dx。离散梯度与全链路差分一致，只证明固定网格求导正确；与 B.5 梯度的误差需要另做加密研究。不要用最大梯度单元的索引作为可微激波位置目标。

The objectives are ∫p dx and wall thrust ∫pA′dx. Agreement with full-rerun differences verifies fixed-grid differentiation only; error against B.5 needs a separate refinement study. The index of the maximum-gradient cell is not a differentiable shock-location objective.

B.6（续）加密到 768 单元：与连续伴随比较

B.6 (continued) Refinement to 768 cells, against the continuous adjoint

上面的 24／48／96 网格不足以判断极限，下图把同一个捕捉格式在 pbp_b = 0.75 加密到 768 个单元，并与 B.3（续）由内部激波条件得到的连续伴随比较（该背压下 ξ = 0.8565，压力积分 dQ/dpb\mathrm dQ/\mathrm dp_b = 0.6585252175，推力 1.0809366136）。伴随与 tangent 在每个网格上都用精确的 matrix-free 算子和 GMRES 求解（页面的稠密 LU 只用于上面的小网格）。这是研究性探索：它说明这个格式在此算例上的梯度随网格加密接近连续值，但不证明一般收敛或收敛阶。

The 24/48/96 grids above are too coarse to judge a limit. The figures below refine the same capturing scheme at pbp_b = 0.75 to 768 cells and compare it with the continuous adjoint obtained from the internal shock conditions in B.3 (continued) (at this back pressure ξ = 0.8565, pressure integral dQ/dpb\mathrm dQ/\mathrm dp_b = 0.6585252175, thrust 1.0809366136). On every grid the adjoint and the tangent are solved with the exact matrix-free operators and GMRES (the page's dense LU is only for the small grids above). This is research exploration: it shows the scheme's gradient approaching the continuous value under refinement for this case, and proves neither general convergence nor a rate.

B.7 Giles–Pierce 的四类解析伴随解

B.7 The four Giles–Pierce analytic adjoint families

这里按 Giles–Pierce（JFM 426, 2001，§§3–7）的 Green 函数构造完整呈现压力积分目标的四类解：全超声速、全亚声速、无激波跨声速、含激波跨声速。令 x∈[−1,1]，面积 A(x)>0 可由调用者给出；图示使用 A=1+0.55x²。下列解析系数是逐段常数；代码只对一维已知积分做数值求积，未用伴随 ODE 求这四类曲线。

This follows the Green-function construction of Giles–Pierce (JFM 426, 2001, §§3–7) for the pressure-integral objective in all four regimes: wholly supersonic, wholly subsonic, isentropic transonic, and shocked transonic. The caller supplies a smooth positive area A(x) on [−1,1]; the figure uses A=1+0.55x². The analytic coefficients below are piecewise constant. Code quadrature evaluates only the resulting known one-dimensional integrals; it does not shoot the adjoint ODE to obtain these curves.

ℛ=(AF)′−A′p e2=0,Q=∫−11p dx,m=Aρu,H=cpT+12u2,p0=p(1+γ−12M2)γ/(γ−1).\mathcal R=(AF)' - A'p\,e_2=0,\quad Q=\int_{-1}^{1}p\,dx,\quad m=A\rho u,\quad H=c_pT+\tfrac12u^2,\quad p_0=p(1+\tfrac{\gamma-1}{2}M^2)^{\gamma/(\gamma-1)}.
δU=αAUm∣H,p0+βUH∣p0,M+χUp0∣H,M,pm=−u1−M2,pH=0,pp0=pp0.\delta U=\frac{\alpha}{A} U_m\big|_{H,p_0}+\beta U_H\big|_{p_0,M}+\chi U_{p_0}\big|_{H,M},\qquad p_m=-\frac{u}{1-M^2},\quad p_H=0,\quad p_{p_0}=\frac p{p_0}.

在 ξ 放置三个独立单位源 f₁=Fm、f₂=A Fh、f₃=A Fp0；每一源使相应的 α、β、χ 跨 ξ 跳 1。按入口、出口、声速喉部和激波条件求这些分段系数，再将压力响应与激波位移积分成 I₁、I₂、I₃。最后由 Green 对偶式逐点恢复三分量伴随。

Place three independent unit sources f₁=Fm, f₂=A Fh, f₃=A Fp0 at ξ; each raises its corresponding coefficient α, β or χ by one across ξ. Inlet, exit, sonic-throat and shock conditions determine the piecewise coefficients. Integrate the pressure response and shock displacement to obtain I₁, I₂ and I₃, then recover all three adjoint components pointwise by Green duality.

f1=(1,u,H)T,f2=A2H(−ρu,0,ρuH)T,f3=Ap0F,(f1 f2 f3)Tλ=(I1,I2,I3)T.f_1=(1,u,H)^T,\quad f_2=\frac{A}{2H}(-\rho u,0,\rho uH)^T,\quad f_3=\frac{A}{p_0}F,\qquad (f_1\ f_2\ f_3)^T\lambda=(I_1,I_2,I_3)^T.
分支 / regime质量源 α / mass source出口与内部条件 / conditions
全超声速 / supersonicξ 右侧 +1 / +1 right of ξ入口 M,H,p₀ 固定；出口自由 / fixed inlet M,H,p₀; free exit
全亚声速 / subsonicξ 左侧 −1 / −1 left of ξ入口 H,p₀；出口 p 固定 / inlet H,p₀; fixed exit p
无激波跨声速 / transonicξ<0：左侧 −1；ξ>0：右侧 +1 / left −1 or right +1入口 H,p₀；喉部 M=1 / inlet H,p₀; sonic throat
含激波跨声速 / shocked喉部与激波分段，再与出口耦合 / piecewise throat–shock–exit喉部 M=1、[F]=0、出口 p；δξ 未知 / sonic throat, RH, exit p and unknown shock shift

含激波分支对 ξ 与激波的相对位置分别求解。激波下游的质量响应与出口压力响应给出 2×2 系统；上游总压变化与马赫变化再通过正激波关系确定位移 δξ。目标响应含界面项 −[p]δξ。恢复的 λ 在激波处连续，λ₂=−1/A′(ξs)，两侧导数为零；默认二次非退化喉部附近按对数增长；这不适用于所有光滑面积。四次平坦喉部 A=1+(5/6)x⁴ 的压力伴随满足 |x|λ₂→−7/10。图中保留喉部奇性截断，不把有限图幅当作有界解。

The shocked branch solves separately for sources before and after the shock. Downstream mass balance and exit-pressure balance form a 2×2 system. The normal-shock relation then determines displacement δξ from upstream total-pressure and Mach variations. The objective response includes −[p]δξ. The reconstructed λ is continuous at the shock, has λ₂=−1/A′(ξs) and zero slope on both sides, and grows logarithmically near the default nondegenerate quadratic throat. This does not hold for every smooth area: at a quartic throat A=1+(5/6)x⁴, the pressure adjoint satisfies |x|λ₂→−7/10. The plot cuts off the sonic singularity.

可复核性：77 项检查覆盖四类 Green 对偶恒等式、独立伴随微分方程、非二次面积函数、与 B.3 激波射击解的一致性、激波连续性和喉部增长。这里的“任意面积”指满足相应稳态分支存在、正面积、光滑性及非退化激波位置条件的输入，不涵盖分支折叠或多激波。

Verification: 77 checks cover Green duality in all four regimes, the independent adjoint ODE, a nonquadratic area, agreement with the B.3 shock-shooting solution, shock continuity and sonic growth. Arbitrary area means a positive smooth input admitting the selected steady branch and a nondegenerate shock position; branch folds and multiple shocks are outside this family.

Green 函数实现 / Green-function implementation
/* Giles–Pierce (JFM 426, 2001), sections 3–7: pressure-integral Green functions.
   The equations below are analytic piecewise solutions in the invariant basis
   (mass flux m, stagnation enthalpy H, stagnation pressure p0). Only their
   one-dimensional integrals are evaluated numerically. The four branches share
   an arbitrary smooth converging–diverging area supplied by the caller.
   x in [-1,1], sonic throat at 0, ideal gas gamma=1.4, R=1. */
'use strict';
const gamma=1.4, cp=3.5, beta=.2;
const phi=M=>((5/6)*(1+beta*M*M))**3/M;
function mach(r,sup){
  if(!(r>=1-2e-13))throw Error('Area is smaller than the branch sonic area');
  if(Math.abs(r-1)<1e-13)return 1;
  let a=sup?1:1e-12,b=sup?30:1;
  for(let k=0;k<70;k++){const m=(a+b)/2;if((phi(m)<r)===sup)a=m;else b=m;}
  return (a+b)/2;
}
function solve3(A,b){
  const a=A.map((r,i)=>[...r,b[i]]);
  for(let k=0;k<3;k++){let p=k;for(let i=k+1;i<3;i++)if(Math.abs(a[i][k])>Math.abs(a[p][k]))p=i;
    if(Math.abs(a[p][k])<1e-14)throw Error('Dependent Green source vectors');
    [a[k],a[p]]=[a[p],a[k]];
    for(let i=k+1;i<3;i++){const c=a[i][k]/a[k][k];for(let j=k;j<4;j++)a[i][j]-=c*a[k][j];}}
  const x=[0,0,0];for(let i=2;i>=0;i--){let v=a[i][3];for(let j=i+1;j<3;j++)v-=a[i][j]*x[j];x[i]=v/a[i][i];}return x;
}
function create({regime='shocked',area=x=>1+.55*x*x,areaX=x=>1.1*x,p01=1,H=3.5,
                 inletMach=3,exitMach=.3,shockX=.5,panels=192}={}){
  if(!['supersonic','subsonic','transonic','shocked'].includes(regime))throw Error('Unknown Giles–Pierce branch');
  if(!(H>0&&p01>0&&area(0)>0&&area(-1)>0&&area(1)>0))throw Error('Invalid gas/area data');
  if(regime==='shocked'&&!(shockX>0&&shockX<1&&areaX(shockX)>0))throw Error('Shock must be inside the divergent branch');
  const T0=H/cp, Astar=regime==='supersonic'?area(-1)/phi(inletMach):regime==='subsonic'?area(1)/phi(exitMach):area(0);
  function state(x,side='up'){
    const down=regime==='shocked'&&(side==='down'||x>shockX), p0=down?shockData.p02:p01;
    const astar=down?Astar*p01/p0:Astar;
    const sup=regime==='supersonic'||(regime==='transonic'&&x>0)||(regime==='shocked'&&x>0&&!down);
    const M=mach(area(x)/astar,sup),T=T0/(1+beta*M*M),p=p0/(1+beta*M*M)**3.5;
    const rho=p/T,u=M*Math.sqrt(gamma*T),m=area(x)*rho*u;
    return {x,M,T,p,rho,u,m,p0,H,A:area(x),E:T/(gamma-1)+u*u/2};
  }
  let shockData=null;
  if(regime==='shocked'){
    const q=state(shockX,'up'),M1=q.M,pr=1+2*gamma/(gamma+1)*(M1*M1-1);
    const M2=Math.sqrt((1+beta*M1*M1)/(gamma*M1*M1-beta));
    const p02=p01*pr*((1+beta*M2*M2)/(1+beta*M1*M1))**3.5;
    shockData={M1,M2,p1:q.p,p2:q.p*pr,p02,pr,m:q.m};
  }
  const inlet=state(-1),outlet=state(1),K=regime==='shocked'?shockData.m/shockData.p02:0;
  const D=-outlet.u/(1-outlet.M*outlet.M)/area(1),E=outlet.p/outlet.p0;
  function coupled(target,extra){const c=(-extra-target*D)/(E-K*D);return {a:target-K*c,b:0,c};}
  function pressurePerMass(q){return -q.u/(1-q.M*q.M)/q.A;}
  function basis(q){
    const f1=[1,q.u,H],f2=[-q.A*q.rho*q.u/(2*H),0,q.A*q.rho*q.u/2],
      f3=[q.A*q.rho*q.u/q.p0,q.A*(q.rho*q.u*q.u+q.p)/q.p0,q.A*q.rho*q.u*H/q.p0];
    return [f1,f2,f3];
  }
  function shockShift(a1,c1,c2){
    const s=shockData,M=s.M1,den=gamma*M*M-beta,M2=s.M2;
    const dM2sq=-2*M*(gamma+beta*beta)/(den*den),dM2=dM2sq/(2*M2);
    const dpr=4*gamma*M/(gamma+1),
      dlog=dpr/s.pr+3.5*(2*beta*M2*dM2/(1+beta*M2*M2)-2*beta*M/(1+beta*M*M));
    const fp=(s.p02/p01)*dlog;
    const Mx=areaX(shockX)/area(shockX)*M*(1+beta*M*M)/(M*M-1);
    const Mm=M/s.m*(1+beta*M*M)/(1-M*M);
    return (c2-c1*s.p02/p01-p01*fp*a1*Mm)/(p01*fp*Mx);
  }
  function green(source,xi){
    if(!(source>=1&&source<=3&&Number.isInteger(source)&&xi>-1&&xi<1))throw Error('Invalid Green source/position');
    if((regime==='transonic'||regime==='shocked')&&Math.abs(xi)<1e-12)throw Error('Source at sonic throat');
    if(regime==='shocked'&&Math.abs(xi-shockX)<1e-12)throw Error('Source at shock');
    let delta=0,down={a:0,b:0,c:0};
    if(regime==='shocked'){
      if(source===1&&xi>0&&xi<shockX){down=coupled(1,0);delta=shockShift(1,0,down.c);}
      if(source===1&&xi>shockX){down=coupled(0,D);delta=shockShift(0,0,down.c);}
      if(source===3&&xi<shockX){down=coupled(shockData.m/p01,0);delta=shockShift(0,1,down.c);}
      if(source===3&&xi>shockX){down=coupled(0,E);delta=shockShift(0,0,down.c);}
    }
    function coeff(x){
      if(source===2)return {a:0,b:x>xi?1:0,c:0};
      if(regime==='supersonic')return {a:source===1&&x>xi?1:0,b:0,c:source===3&&x>xi?1:0};
      if(regime==='subsonic')return {a:source===1&&x<xi?-1:source===3?-E/D:0,b:0,c:source===3&&x>xi?1:0};
      if(regime==='transonic')return {a:source===1&&((xi<0&&x<xi)||(xi>0&&x>xi))?(xi<0?-1:1):0,b:0,c:source===3&&x>xi?1:0};
      if(source===1&&xi<0)return {a:x<xi?-1:0,b:0,c:0};
      if(x<shockX){
        if(source===1)return {a:x>xi?1:0,b:0,c:0};
        return {a:0,b:0,c:x>xi?1:0};
      }
      if(source===1)return {a:down.a+(xi>shockX&&x>xi?1:0),b:0,c:down.c};
      return {a:down.a,b:0,c:down.c+(xi>shockX&&x>xi?1:0)};
    }
    function density(x){const t=coeff(x);if(!t.a&&!t.c)return 0;
      const q=state(x,regime==='shocked'&&x>shockX?'down':'up');
      return (t.a? t.a*pressurePerMass(q):0)+t.c*q.p/q.p0;}
    const cuts=[-1,0,1,xi];if(regime==='shocked')cuts.push(shockX);
    cuts.sort((a,b)=>a-b);let integral=0;
    for(let j=1;j<cuts.length;j++){
      const a=cuts[j-1],b=cuts[j];if(b-a<1e-13)continue;
      const n=panels+panels%2,h=(b-a)/n;
      // Offset interval endpoints to avoid selecting an adjacent branch or M=1.
      let z=density(a+Math.min(1e-10,h*1e-5))+density(b-Math.min(1e-10,h*1e-5));
      for(let k=1;k<n;k++)z+=(k%2?4:2)*density(a+k*h);
      integral+=z*h/3;
    }
    const I=integral-(regime==='shocked'?(shockData.p2-shockData.p1)*delta:0);
    return {source,xi,I,delta,coeff};
  }
  function adjoint(xi){const G=[1,2,3].map(j=>green(j,xi)),q=state(xi,regime==='shocked'&&xi>shockX?'down':'up');
    const F=basis(q),v=solve3(F,G.map(g=>g.I));
    return {xi,v,I:G.map(g=>g.I),delta:G.map(g=>g.delta),sourceVectors:F};
  }
  return {regime,area,areaX,p01,H,Astar,shockX,shockData,inlet,outlet,state,green,adjoint,basis};
}
module.exports={create,phi,mach};

B.8 Roe 激波捕捉与离散伴随的相位实验

B.8 Roe shock capturing and discrete-adjoint phase study

Giles、Duta、Müller 与 Pierce（AIAA J. 41, 2003，§5）指出：原始压力积分即使随加密趋近正确值，尖锐 Roe 激波随背压跨单元时产生的目标误差仍可能有 O(h) 的齿纹，其背压导数保持 O(1) 相位误差。本实验用同一物理机制重新构造一个可重复的拟一维 Euler 算例，数据不是论文图的数字化副本。

Giles, Duta, Müller and Pierce (AIAA J. 41, 2003, §5) show that a convergent pressure integral can still have O(h) scallops as a sharp Roe shock moves cell by cell with exit pressure, leaving an O(1) phase error in its derivative. This is a new reproducible quasi-1-D Euler experiment driven by the same mechanism, not digitized data from their figures.

Fx+A′A(F−P)=0,A(x)=1+0.5x+0.3x2,Min=1.5,Q=∫01p dx,pb=Pfit(ξ),ξ=0.5+θN.F_x+\frac{A'}{A}(F-P)=0,\quad A(x)=1+0.5x+0.3x^2,\quad M_{\rm in}=1.5,\quad Q=\int_0^1p\,dx,\quad p_b=P_{\rm fit}(\xi),\quad \xi=0.5+\frac{\theta}{N}.

一阶格心有限体积使用 Roe 通量及完整计算图 JVP/VJP。零声学波速且波强非零时，未光滑 Roe 通量不可微；此处计算图给出所选分支的线性映射，不能称为经典 Jacobian。原 B.8 模型的 N=24 有向证书已定位背压约 0.6888970486283346 的精确稳态声学切换根，压力目标左右导数约为 2.6453294685 和 1.3921358415，差的绝对值严格大于 1.25；此有限非默认背压反例不替代下面固定相位序列的网格极限。另一组用固定 LF 波速 3，第三组取 LF 波速 3N^{1/4}，对应数值黏性物理宽度 ε≈3h^{3/4}：激波跨越的单元数增加而物理宽度减小。每个背压都重求原始解，并独立求 tangent 与离散伴随；参考值从激波拟合流动分段积分后作收敛的四点差分。

The first-order cell-volume scheme uses Roe flux and full computational-graph JVP/VJP. With a zero acoustic speed and nonzero wave strength, the unsmoothed Roe flux is not differentiable; its graph products describe the selected branch, not a classical Jacobian. A directed N=24 certificate for the original B.8 model locates an exact steady acoustic switch root at back pressure approximately 0.6888970486283346. The pressure objective has left/right derivatives about 2.6453294685 and 1.3921358415, with a gap strictly exceeding 1.25; this finite nondefault-pressure counterexample does not settle the fixed phase sequences below. Comparators use fixed LF speed 3 and LF speed 3N^{1/4}, corresponding to physical viscosity width ε≈3h^{3/4}: more cells span the shock while its physical width shrinks. Every back pressure gets a fresh primal solve and independent tangent and discrete-adjoint solves. The reference differentiates a separately shock-fitted, piecewise integrated flow with a stabilized four-point formula.

表中 Roe 梯度的相位跨度在四次加密中仍保持明显量级，而两类 LF 的梯度相位差收缩。增宽 LF 在粗网格有较大的耗散偏差，因此不能仅看一个网格断言它更准确；单元数增加与物理宽度缩小需同时检查。独立解析分析已构造本 Roe 格式的完整精确局部单激波根：对本节数学序列 θ=0、1/6、1/3，压力梯度极限分别约为 1.390108、2.145405、1.809748，连续值约为 1.699205，误差绝对下极限严格大于 0.3、0.4、0.1，原解和目标值仍收敛。保存的默认背压另保持为其实际 dyadic 有理值；区间认证和整数网格相位子列给同一固定背压的无限加密反例，子列梯度误差下极限大于 0.3。这些是理想精确十进制 Euler 的局部精确根结论；默认求解器全部细网格根身份、binary64 全程序、数值网格阈值和完整 Euler Lean 尚未证明。Giles（2003）及 Giles–Ulbrich（2010）的严格收敛分析是标量守恒律/Burgers，不能直接移植为 Euler 定理。

Roe gradient spread remains substantial over four refinements, whereas both LF phase spreads shrink. Broadening LF has a large coarse-grid bias, so one grid cannot establish better accuracy; its cell count and physical shock width must be checked together. A separate analytic construction gives exact local single-shock roots of this complete Roe residual. For the mathematical sequences theta=0, 1/6 and 1/3, pressure-gradient limits are approximately 1.390108, 2.145405 and 1.809748, versus the continuous 1.699205. Absolute limiting errors exceed 0.3, 0.4 and 0.1 even though states and objective values converge. The saved default pressure is also held fixed as its actual dyadic rational: interval certification and an integer-grid phase subsequence give a refinement counterexample at this same fixed pressure, with subsequence gradient error exceeding 0.3. These are local exact-root results for ideal exact-decimal Euler. All-fine-grid default solver root identity, binary64 execution, a numeric mesh threshold and full Euler Lean remain unproved. The rigorous analyses of Giles (2003) and Giles–Ulbrich (2010) concern scalar conservation laws/Burgers and do not transfer directly to Euler.

Roe 固定输入的严格反例与相位动画 / Fixed-input Roe counterexample and phase animation

下图菱形是解析局部精确根的梯度极限（系数有向认证）；圆点是原页面有限浮点观察。动画只显示冻结一格层及极限公式，不把该层称为完整喷管稳态根。默认全部细网格根身份仍未证明。

Diamonds display analytic local exact-root gradient limits with directed-certified coefficients; circles are finite original-page floating observations. The animation displays frozen one-cell profiles and the limiting formula. Those profiles are not full nozzle steady roots. Default all-grid root identity remains open.

离散相位实验实现 / Discrete phase-study implementation
/* Euler counterpart of the sharp-shock sensitivity experiment in Giles et al.
   AIAA J. 41 (2003), §5: Roe FDS versus fixed/broadening LF diffusion.
   The residual is their dF/dx + (A'/A)(F-P)=0 form in a divergent duct;
   inlet is fully supersonic, exit pressure fixes a normal-shock position.
   This is a fresh controlled experiment, not a digitization of their figures.
   Run from this directory: node giles_discrete_study.js
   The JSON includes source provenance and nonlinear/tangent/adjoint diagnostics. */
'use strict';
const fs=require('fs'),path=require('path'),crypto=require('crypto');
const E=require('../../experiments/giles_euler');
const SOURCES=[__filename,path.join(__dirname,'../../experiments/giles_euler.js'),path.join(__dirname,'../../experiments/numerics.js'),path.join(__dirname,'math.js')];
const provenance=()=>{const h=crypto.createHash('sha256');SOURCES.forEach(p=>h.update(fs.readFileSync(p)));return h.digest('hex');};
const GRIDS=[24,48,96,192],PHASES=[0,1/6,1/3],SCHEMES=['roe','fixed-lf','broad-lf'];
const root=E.model({geometry:'diverging'});
function position(pb){let a=.001,b=.999,fa=root.fittedBackPressure(a)-pb,fb=root.fittedBackPressure(b)-pb;
  if(fa*fb>=0)throw Error('Back pressure outside shock branch');
  for(let k=0;k<58;k++){const x=(a+b)/2,f=root.fittedBackPressure(x)-pb;if(f*fa>0){a=x;fa=f;}else b=x;}return (a+b)/2;}
function objective(pb){const xi=position(pb),fit=root.fittedProfile(xi);
  const integral=(a,b,down)=>{const n=384,h=(b-a)/n;let s=0;
    for(let k=0;k<=n;k++)s+=(k===0||k===n?1:k%2?4:2)*fit.state(a+k*h,down).p;
    return h*s/3;};
  return integral(0,xi,false)+integral(xi,1,true);}
function reference(pb){const h=2e-5;
  const four=(objective(pb-2*h)-8*objective(pb-h)+8*objective(pb+h)-objective(pb+2*h))/(12*h);
  const half=(objective(pb-h)-8*objective(pb-h/2)+8*objective(pb+h/2)-objective(pb+h))/(6*h);
  if(Math.abs(four-half)>2e-7)throw Error('Fitted-reference differentiation did not stabilize');
  return four;}
function run(){const rows=[];
  for(const n of GRIDS)for(const phase of PHASES){
    const xi=.5+phase/n,pb=root.fittedBackPressure(xi),ref=reference(pb);
    for(const scheme of SCHEMES){
      const options={n,geometry:'diverging',sourceForm:'giles',pb,order:1,objective:'pressure',
        fluxScheme:scheme==='roe'?'roe':'rusanov',llfSpeed:scheme==='broad-lf'?3*n**.25:3};
      const m=E.model(options),t0=Date.now(),s=m.solve();
      if(!s.converged)throw Error(`Primal ${scheme} n=${n} phase=${phase}: ${s.reason} ${s.history.at(-1)}`);
      const L=m.linearize(s.U),P=m.firstOrderMatrix(s.U),zero=Array(m.nd).fill(0),dp=Array(m.params.length).fill(0);
      dp[n+1]=1;
      const jU=L.vjp(zero,1).U;
      const adj=m.linearSolve(L,jU.map(v=>-v),P,true,'gmres',2e-11);
      const tan=m.linearSolve(L,L.jvp(zero,dp).R.map(v=>-v),P,false,'gmres',2e-11);
      if(!adj.converged||!tan.converged)throw Error(`Linear solve ${scheme} n=${n} phase=${phase}`);
      const gradient=L.vjp(adj.x,1).p[n+1],tangentGradient=L.jvp(tan.x,dp).J;
      if(Math.abs(gradient-tangentGradient)>2e-8)throw Error(`Tangent/adjoint mismatch ${scheme} n=${n} phase=${phase}`);
      const mach=m.x.map((_,i)=>{const q=m.physics.prim(s.U.slice(3*i,3*i+3));return q.u/q.a;});
      rows.push({n,phase,xi,pb,scheme,gradient,tangentGradient,reference:ref,error:gradient-ref,
        objective:m.evaluate(s.U).J,fittedObjective:objective(pb),transitionCells:mach.filter(v=>v>.9&&v<1.3).length,
        primalResidual:s.history.at(-1),seconds:(Date.now()-t0)/1000});
      console.log(`n=${n} phase=${phase.toFixed(3)} ${scheme.padEnd(8)} gradient=${gradient.toFixed(8)} error=${(gradient-ref).toExponential(2)} cells=${rows.at(-1).transitionCells}`);
    }
  }
  return {provenance:provenance(),metadata:{area:'1 + 0.5 x + 0.3 x^2',inletMach:1.5,p01:1,T0:1,sourceForm:'dF/dx + (A\'/A)(F-P) = 0',grids:GRIDS,phases:PHASES,schemes:SCHEMES},rows};
}
if(require.main===module){const out=run(),file=path.join(__dirname,'giles_discrete_study.json');fs.writeFileSync(file,JSON.stringify(out));console.log('wrote '+file);}
module.exports={run,provenance,reference,objective,position};

附录 C：小规模伴随方程的直接求解

Appendix C: direct adjoint solves for small systems

本附录的一阶、二阶均不采用 matrix-free 求解：先显式组装并存储完整精确 Jacobian，再对其转置作带主元 LU 分解和三角求解。用精确导数取得矩阵列属于组装步骤；matrix-free 反向算子只在直接解完成后用于独立残差验证。

For both first and second order, this appendix does not use a matrix-free solve: explicitly assemble and store the complete exact Jacobian, then factor its transpose with pivoted LU and solve triangular systems. Derivative products used to obtain columns belong to assembly; the matrix-free reverse operator is used only afterwards for independent residual verification.

C.1 小系统为什么值得直接求解

C.1 Why use a direct method for a small system

默认 12 区间时，格心有 36 个状态未知量，格点有 39 个。这个规模下，可以把精确 Jacobian 全部写出来，采用带部分主元选取的 LU 分解直接解伴随方程。它避免许多次 GS 或 Krylov 算子调用，通常是这种教学小系统中很快的选择；是否最快由下方同条件实测决定，不能只比较迭代次数。

With the default 12 intervals there are 36 cell-centred or 39 node-centred state unknowns. At this size we can assemble the exact Jacobian and solve the adjoint with partial-pivot LU. This avoids many GS or Krylov operator applications and is often a fast choice for a small teaching system. The benchmark below determines which is fastest under the same conditions; iteration counts alone cannot establish that.

J=RU(U∗,D),JTψ=−QUT≡r,g=QDT+RDTψ.J=R_U(U^*,D),\qquad J^T\psi=-Q_U^T\equiv r,\qquad g=Q_D^T+R_D^T\psi.

正文仍保留 matrix-free 精确算子。本附录额外提供显式矩阵路径：以单位种子 U˙=ej\dot U=e_j 做一次精确前向传播，得到第 j 列 R˙=Jej\dot R=Je_j，然后转置得到 JT。这里的 J 必须与顶端所选的一阶或二阶残差一致，包含重构、波速、源项与边界行。不能把一阶预处理矩阵 P 的转置直接解当成二阶伴随解。解出 ψ 后，以 Rˉ=ψ\bar R=\psi、Qˉ=1\bar Q=1 为种子做一次反向传播，得到梯度 Dˉ=g\bar D=g。

The main text retains exact matrix-free operators. This appendix adds an explicit-matrix path: one exact tangent sweep with the unit seed U˙=ej\dot U=e_j gives column R˙=Jej\dot R=Je_j, then transpose J. The matrix must match the selected first- or second-order residual, including reconstruction, wave speed, source and boundary rows. Solving with the first-order preconditioner PT alone is not a second-order adjoint solution. After ψ is solved, one reverse sweep with the seeds Rˉ=ψ\bar R=\psi and Qˉ=1\bar Q=1 gives the gradient Dˉ=g\bar D=g.

# column j of J: the tangent R_d of the seed U_d = e_j
for j = 0,...,n-1:
    J[:,j] = residual_d(U, U_d=unit_vector(j))
M = transpose(J)
rhs = -objective_state_gradient
LU, permutation = factor_with_partial_pivoting(M)
psi = triangular_solve(LU, permutation, rhs)
# one reverse sweep with the seeds R_bar = psi, Q_bar = 1
D_bar = residual_bar(U, R_bar=psi, Q_bar=1)   # = g

C.2 主元、消元、前代与回代

C.2 Pivoting, elimination and triangular solves

在第 k 列，从尚未消元的行中选绝对值最大的主元，把整行交换到第 k 行；右端项也必须按照相同置换重排。用主元消去下面的元素，把乘数保存在严格下三角，更新后的上三角保存 U。L 的对角线默认为 1。完整行交换也交换已经保存的 L 乘数，否则分解关系就会被破坏。

In column k, select the largest-magnitude remaining entry and swap its entire row into position k. Apply the same permutation to the right-hand side. Eliminate entries below the pivot, storing multipliers in the strict lower triangle and the updated U in the upper triangle. L has unit diagonal. Full row swaps also swap previously stored L multipliers, preserving the factorisation.

ΠJT=LU,Ly=Πr,Uψ=y,ℓik=mik/mkk,mij←mij−ℓikmkj.\Pi J^T=L U,\quad Ly=\Pi r,\quad U\psi=y,\quad \ell_{ik}=m_{ik}/m_{kk},\quad m_{ij}\leftarrow m_{ij}-\ell_{ik}m_{kj}.
yi=(Πr)i−∑j<iℓijyj,ψi=yi−∑j>iuijψjuii.y_i=(\Pi r)_i-\sum_{j<i}\ell_{ij}y_j,\qquad\psi_i=\frac{y_i-\sum_{j>i}u_{ij}\psi_j}{u_{ii}}.

不显式计算逆矩阵。LU 分解一次之后，不同目标只需重新计算右端项并做两次三角求解；只有流场、网格、边界或空间阶数改变导致 J 改变时才必须重新分解。主元接近机器精度尺度时停止并报告数值奇异，不能用人为小数替换零主元。

Do not form a matrix inverse. Once LU is factored, another objective needs a new right-hand side and two triangular solves. Refactor when changes in state, geometry, boundary data or spatial order change J. A pivot near machine precision triggers a numerical-singularity error rather than substitution of an arbitrary small pivot.

逐步推导：Euler 块矩阵为什么要换行

Step by step: why the Euler block matrix needs row swaps

JTJ^T 由 3×33\times3 块组成（本页 N = 12 时 39 维）。一阶时每个块只与相邻块耦合，按标量计下、上带宽都是 5；二阶重构把耦合延伸到隔一个节点，带宽变为 8。与 Burgers 不同，对角元并不总是本列剩余元素中绝对值最大者，所以部分主元真的会交换行：一阶 3 次、二阶 16 次。一阶第一次换行发生在 k=0k=0：当前对角元的绝对值是 0.0379，第 2 行同列元素的绝对值是 0.399，于是交换这两行。

JTJ^T consists of 3×33\times3 blocks (dimension 39 here for N = 12). At first order each block couples only to its neighbours, giving lower and upper scalar bandwidths 5; second-order reconstruction reaches one node further and the bandwidths become 8. Unlike Burgers, the diagonal is not always the largest remaining entry of its column, so partial pivoting really swaps rows: 3 times at first order and 16 at second. The first first-order swap happens at k=0k=0: the current diagonal entry has magnitude 0.0379 and row 2 has 0.399 in the same column, so the two rows are exchanged.

换行最多让 UU 变宽多少：带宽为 pp、qq 时，第 kk 步的主元只能来自第 kk 到 k+pk+p 行（更下面的行在第 kk 列为零）。被换到第 kk 行的行，非零元至多到第 k+p+qk+p+q 列，所以 UU 的上带宽不超过 p+qp+q。

How much wider can swaps make UU? With bandwidths pp and qq, the pivot of step kk can only come from rows kk to k+pk+p (rows further down are zero in column kk). A row moved to position kk has nonzeros at most up to column k+p+qk+p+q, so the upper bandwidth of UU never exceeds p+qp+q.

一阶的 3 次换行都发生在两端节点的同一块行内，被交换的两行非零列完全相同，换行不改变非零结构，所以 UU 的上带宽仍是 5，这次分解也没有产生任何填充。二阶有行从下面的块行换上来，带着更靠右的非零元：UU 的上带宽从 8 增加到 9（不超过 p+q=16p+q=16），消元还在原来为零的位置产生 21 个新的非零元（填充）。图 C.1 是两种阶数的 JTJ^T，图 C.2 是二阶分解后的因子。

At first order all 3 swaps stay inside one block row of the two end nodes; the two rows exchanged have the same nonzero columns, so the swaps leave the pattern unchanged, the upper bandwidth of UU stays 5, and this factorisation creates no fill at all. At second order rows move up from block rows below, bringing entries further right: the upper bandwidth of UU grows from 8 to 9 (never beyond p+q=16p+q=16), and elimination creates 21 new nonzeros where the matrix had zeros (fill). Figure C.1 shows JTJ^T for both orders and Figure C.2 the factors of the second-order one.

C.3 看清矩阵和直接求解过程

C.3 Inspect the matrix and direct solution

下方随页面阶数和目标更新。矩阵图显示 JT 的非零耦合；可选行查看数值，拖动消元步查看主元交换及存储在同一数组中的 L/U。右端、前代结果 y、伴随 ψ 和网格图均来自实际计算。直接法没有外层迭代收敛曲线：消元步不是 GS 迭代。

The panel follows the selected order and objective. Its matrix map shows nonzero couplings in JT. Select a row to inspect values and an elimination step to inspect pivot swaps and packed L/U. The right-hand side, forward-substitution y, adjoint ψ and mesh plot are computed live. Elimination steps are not GS iterations; the direct method has no outer convergence history.

C.4 验证与公平计时

C.4 Verification and fair timing

ra=JTψ+QUT,η=∥ra∥∞∥JT∥∞∥ψ∥∞+∥QUT∥∞.r_a=J^T\psi+Q_U^T,\qquad\eta=\frac{\|r_a\|_\infty}{\|J^T\|_\infty\|\psi\|_\infty+\|Q_U^T\|_\infty}.

真残差用正文的 matrix-free 反向算子重新计算，另比较 GS、GMRES 的伴随解与全部设计梯度。小后向误差表示解满足附近的线性系统，不保证病态系统中解的前向误差也小。

Recompute the true residual with the main text’s matrix-free reverse operator and compare adjoint solutions and every design gradient against GS and GMRES. A small backward error means the computed result solves a nearby system; it does not ensure a small forward error for an ill-conditioned system.

计时共享同一个已收敛流场、精确线性化和右端项，不包含原始流场求解、绘图或源码展示。直接法计入精确矩阵组装、转置、LU 及三角求解；迭代法计入一阶 P 的组装和线性求解。另列已分解 LU 的重复右端求解时间。每种方法预热后重复 7 次并取中位数；浏览器、硬件及计时分辨率会影响结果。比较的是本页教学实现，不代表优化数值库的速度排名。

Timing shares the converged flow, exact linearisation and right-hand side, excluding primal solves, rendering and source display. Direct timing includes exact assembly, transpose, LU and triangular solves; iterative timing includes first-order P assembly and the linear solve. Reused-LU right-hand-side time is reported separately. Each method is warmed up, repeated seven times and reported by its median. Browser, hardware and timer resolution affect results. This compares these teaching implementations, not optimised numerical libraries.

逐步推导：一次分解同时服务 tangent 与 adjoint

Step by step: one factorisation serves both the tangent and the adjoint

本附录分解的是 JTJ^T。若改为分解 JJ，同一组因子也能解伴随：由 ΠJ=LU\Pi J=LU 得 JT=UTLTΠJ^T=U^TL^T\Pi，伴随只是把两次三角求解的顺序和方向换过来：

This appendix factors JTJ^T. Had it factored JJ, the same factors would also solve the adjoint: ΠJ=LU\Pi J=LU gives JT=UTLTΠJ^T=U^TL^T\Pi, and the adjoint merely swaps the order and direction of the two triangular solves:

Ly=Πt,Uv=y⏟J v=t=−RDD˙UTz=r,LTy=z,ψ=ΠTy⏟JTψ=r=−QUT.\underbrace{Ly=\Pi t,\quad Uv=y}_{J\,v=t=-R_D\dot D}\qquad\qquad \underbrace{U^Tz=r,\quad L^Ty=z,\quad \psi=\Pi^Ty}_{J^T\psi=r=-Q_U^T}.

逐步推导：后向误差换算成前向误差

Step by step: turning the backward error into a forward error

C.4 定义的 η\eta 恰好是使 ψ\psi 成为某个扰动系统精确解的最小相对扰动（Rigal–Gaches）：存在 EE、ff 使 (JT+E)ψ=r+f(J^T+E)\psi=r+f，∥E∥∞≤η∥JT∥∞\|E\|_\infty\le\eta\|J^T\|_\infty，∥f∥∞≤η∥r∥∞\|f\|_\infty\le\eta\|r\|_\infty，其中 r=−QUTr=-Q_U^T。精确解满足 JTψ∗=rJ^T\psi^*=r，两式相减得 JT(ψ−ψ∗)=f−EψJ^T(\psi-\psi^*)=f-E\psi，取范数：

The η\eta defined in C.4 is exactly the smallest relative perturbation for which ψ\psi solves a perturbed system (Rigal–Gaches): there are EE and ff with (JT+E)ψ=r+f(J^T+E)\psi=r+f, ∥E∥∞≤η∥JT∥∞\|E\|_\infty\le\eta\|J^T\|_\infty and ∥f∥∞≤η∥r∥∞\|f\|_\infty\le\eta\|r\|_\infty, where r=−QUTr=-Q_U^T. The exact solution satisfies JTψ∗=rJ^T\psi^*=r; subtracting gives JT(ψ−ψ∗)=f−EψJ^T(\psi-\psi^*)=f-E\psi, and taking norms:

∥ψ−ψ∗∥∞∥ψ∥∞≤κ∞(JT) η(1+∥r∥∞∥JT∥∞∥ψ∥∞)≲2 κ∞(JT) η.\frac{\|\psi-\psi^*\|_\infty}{\|\psi\|_\infty}\le\kappa_\infty(J^T)\,\eta\Bigl(1+\frac{\|r\|_\infty}{\|J^T\|_\infty\|\psi\|_\infty}\Bigr)\lesssim2\,\kappa_\infty(J^T)\,\eta.

本页 N = 12（格点，推力目标）：一阶 κ∞(JT)=449\kappa_\infty(J^T)=449、η=4.8×10−17\eta=4.8\times10^{-17}；二阶 κ∞(JT)=1503\kappa_\infty(J^T)=1503、η=4.6×10−17\eta=4.6\times10^{-17}。伴随的相对前向误差不超过约 1.4×10−131.4\times10^{-13}。作为检查，用补偿点积算残差、迭代细化三次得到 ψ∗\psi^*，LU 解的实际相对误差一阶是 3.1×10−163.1\times10^{-16}、二阶是 5.5×10−155.5\times10^{-15}，都在界内。

Here N = 12 (node, thrust objective): first order κ∞(JT)=449\kappa_\infty(J^T)=449 and η=4.8×10−17\eta=4.8\times10^{-17}; second order κ∞(JT)=1503\kappa_\infty(J^T)=1503 and η=4.6×10−17\eta=4.6\times10^{-17}. The relative forward error of the adjoint is therefore at most about 1.4×10−131.4\times10^{-13}. As a check, three steps of iterative refinement with residuals from a compensated dot product give ψ∗\psi^*; the actual relative error of the LU solution is 3.1×10−163.1\times10^{-16} at first order and 5.5×10−155.5\times10^{-15} at second, both within the bound.

稠密矩阵存储需要 O(n²)，LU 分解需要 O(n³)，重复右端求解需要 O(n²)。在默认 36／39 维系统中代价很小；工业非结构网格 RANS 的规模则完全不同，需要考虑稀疏分解的填充、内存与并行扩展。因此附录 C 是小规模问题的直接解基准，正文的 matrix-free／预处理方法仍是向大型问题发展的重要路线。

Dense storage costs O(n²), LU factorisation O(n³), and subsequent right-hand-side solves O(n²). These costs are small for 36/39 unknowns. Industrial unstructured RANS is a different scale, where sparse-factorisation fill, memory and parallel scaling matter. Appendix C supplies a small-system direct reference; matrix-free methods and preconditioning remain important for larger problems.

展开完整直接法实现Complete direct-solver implementation
/* Small-system exact adjoint: explicit assembly and partial-pivot LU. */
(function(root){'use strict';
const Q=typeof module!=='undefined'?require('./core'):root.QEuler,{norm}=Q;
function assemble(L,n){const A=Array.from({length:n},()=>Array(n).fill(0));for(let j=0;j<n;j++){const e=Array(n).fill(0);e[j]=1;L.jvp(e).R.forEach((v,i)=>A[i][j]=v);}return A;}
function factor(M,trace=false){const n=M.length,lu=M.map(r=>r.slice()),permutation=Array.from({length:n},(_,i)=>i),steps=[],scale=Math.max(...M.flat().map(Math.abs));if(!scale||!Number.isFinite(scale))throw Error('Invalid or zero matrix');for(let k=0;k<n;k++){let pivot=k;for(let i=k+1;i<n;i++)if(Math.abs(lu[i][k])>Math.abs(lu[pivot][k]))pivot=i;if(Math.abs(lu[pivot][k])<=Number.EPSILON*scale*n)throw Error('Numerically singular LU pivot at '+k);[lu[k],lu[pivot]]=[lu[pivot],lu[k]];[permutation[k],permutation[pivot]]=[permutation[pivot],permutation[k]];for(let i=k+1;i<n;i++){lu[i][k]/=lu[k][k];for(let j=k+1;j<n;j++)lu[i][j]-=lu[i][k]*lu[k][j];}if(trace)steps.push({k,pivot,lu:lu.map(r=>r.slice()),permutation:permutation.slice()});}return {lu,permutation,steps};}
function solve(F,b){const {lu,permutation}=F,n=b.length,y=permutation.map(i=>b[i]),x=Array(n).fill(0);for(let i=0;i<n;i++)for(let j=0;j<i;j++)y[i]-=lu[i][j]*y[j];for(let i=n-1;i>=0;i--){let r=y[i];for(let j=i+1;j<n;j++)r-=lu[i][j]*x[j];x[i]=r/lu[i][i];}return {x,y,permutedRhs:permutation.map(i=>b[i])};}
const transpose=A=>A[0].map((_,j)=>A.map(r=>r[j]));
function adjoint(f,solution,trace=false){if(f.objective==='inverse')f.target();const L=f.linearize(solution.U),A=assemble(L,f.nd),AT=transpose(A),rhs=L.vjp(Array(f.nd).fill(0),1).U.map(v=>-v),F=factor(AT,trace),s=solve(F,rhs),r=L.vjp(s.x).U.map((v,i)=>v-rhs[i]),matrixNorm=Math.max(...AT.map(row=>row.reduce((s,v)=>s+Math.abs(v),0))),max=a=>Math.max(...a.map(Math.abs)),den=matrixNorm*max(s.x)+max(rhs);return {...s,A,AT,rhs,F,residual:norm(r),backwardError:den?max(r)/den:0,gradient:L.vjp(s.x,1).p};}
const api={assemble,transpose,factor,solve,adjoint};if(typeof module!=='undefined')module.exports=api;else root.QDirect=api;
})(typeof window!=='undefined'?window:globalThis);

附录 D：光滑性、limiter 与求导收敛

Appendix D: smoothness, limiters and derivative convergence

进阶教学 · 选读Advanced teaching · optional

本附录混合了已有概念演示与研究性参数实验。D.1 和 D.2 的完整／冻结导数区别可作为求导注意事项学习；D.3 的一般收敛机制、D.4 的联合极限分析可留到研究阶段。限制器收敛和间断解的伴随收敛已有研究，本页没有建立这些问题“尚未被研究”的结论。

This appendix mixes established demonstrations with research-oriented parameter experiments. D.1 and the full/frozen derivative distinction in D.2 teach differentiation caveats. General convergence mechanisms in D.3 and joint-limit analysis in D.4 can be left for research study. Limiter convergence and adjoint convergence for discontinuous solutions have existing literature; this page does not establish that these questions are unstudied.

先分辨四种不同问题：原始残差是否收敛、经典导数是否存在、固定线性系统是否解收敛、网格加密后是否逼近物理敏感度。实验不预设硬 limiter 必然发散，也不把光滑 limiter 当作收敛保证。

Separate four questions: convergence of the primal residual, existence of a classical derivative, convergence of a fixed linear solve, and approximation of physical sensitivities under refinement. A hard limiter need not diverge, and a smooth limiter does not guarantee convergence.

本附录用独立的标量 Burgers 实验隔离机制；它不使用顶部 Euler 的网格或边界参数。Euler 的完整激波捕捉与 limiter 导数对照见本页 B.6。

This appendix isolates mechanisms with independent scalar Burgers experiments, separate from the Euler controls above. Euler shock capturing and limiter differentiation are in B.6.

D.1 光滑的线性分布，也会触及 minmod 切换

D.1 Even a smooth linear profile can reach a minmod switch

ui−1=uc−a,ui=uc+μ,ui+1=uc+a,si=minmod⁡(a+μ,a−μ)=a−∣μ∣(∣μ∣<a).u_{i-1}=u_c-a,\quad u_i=u_c+\mu,\quad u_{i+1}=u_c+a,\qquad s_i=\operatorname{minmod}(a+\mu,a-\mu)=a-|\mu|\quad(|\mu|<a).

μ=0 的左右导数分别为 +1 与 −1。程序相等时选择左分支，只给出该分支的线性化。中心差分得到零不代表导数存在。以下交互同时列出切换条件、局部 tangent 和反向累加权重。

At μ=0 the left and right derivatives are +1 and −1. The code selects the left branch at a tie, defining that branch’s linearization only. A zero central difference does not establish a derivative. Inspect the switch, local tangent and reverse accumulation weights below.

D.2 完整导数与冻结系数究竟差在哪里

D.2 Full derivatives versus frozen coefficients

研究性探索 · 选读Research exploration · optional

链式法则中不能漏掉 limiter 的导数，是教学结论。下方光滑有理重构只是可微的对照模型；若进一步研究其 TVD、正性、离散熵稳定性、ε 与网格尺度的匹配，则属于未在本项目证明的格式分析。光滑不等于这些性质成立，也不等于 tangent／adjoint 必然收敛。

Retaining limiter derivatives in the chain rule is a teaching conclusion. The smooth rational reconstruction below is a differentiable comparison model. TVD, positivity, discrete entropy stability and scaling epsilon with the mesh require scheme analysis not proved in this project. Smoothness establishes none of those properties and does not guarantee tangent/adjoint convergence.

uf=ui+ϕiΔi,u˙f=u˙i+ϕiΔ˙i+Δiϕ˙i.u_f=u_i+\phi_i\Delta_i,\qquad \dot u_f=\dot u_i+\phi_i\dot\Delta_i+\Delta_i\dot\phi_i.

冻结 limiter 系数删除最后一项；保存 minmod 的分支仍应对分支内部运算完整求导。两者都可能通过各自的转置点积测试，但冻结系数一般不是原始残差的完整导数。为了明确对比，冻结模式保持基态重构值相同，只替换线性化；它没有重新定义一个全局相同的可微残差。

Freezing the coefficient drops the final term. Saving a minmod branch still differentiates all operations within that branch. Both maps may pass their own transpose test, while coefficient freezing generally is not the full residual derivative. The frozen mode preserves the base reconstruction value and replaces only its linearization; it does not define the same globally differentiable residual.

sε(a,b)=ab(a+b)a2+b2+ε2,ε>0.s_\varepsilon(a,b)=\frac{ab(a+b)}{a^2+b^2+\varepsilon^2},\qquad \varepsilon>0.

光滑对照采用上述有理函数，对全部实数输入光滑；不再附加硬 min/max 或符号截断。它保持常值状态，但不是本页证明过的 TVD 或正性保持格式。ε 使用无量纲变量差分的尺度，改变 ε 就改变离散模型。Euler 若产生非正密度或压力、或超过固定耗散波速上界，将拒绝该状态而不静默裁剪。

The rational comparison is smooth for all real inputs, with no added hard min/max or sign clipping. It preserves constant states, but is not claimed to be TVD or positivity preserving. Epsilon uses the scale of nondimensional variable differences; changing it changes the discretization. Euler rejects nonpositive states or states beyond its fixed dissipation-speed bound rather than silently clipping them.

逐步推导：minmod 的单侧导数与有理限幅的导数

Step by step: the one-sided derivatives of minmod and the derivatives of the rational limiter

在 D.1 的线性分布上，两侧差为 a+μa+\mu 与 a−μa-\mu。∣μ∣<a|\mu|<a 时二者同号，minmod 取绝对值较小者：

On the linear profile of D.1 the two differences are a+μa+\mu and a−μa-\mu. For ∣μ∣<a|\mu|<a they have the same sign and minmod takes the smaller magnitude:

s(μ)=a−∣μ∣,s(τ)−s(−τ)2τ=0,lim⁡τ→0+s(τ)−s(0)τ=−1,lim⁡τ→0+s(0)−s(−τ)τ=+1.\begin{gathered}s(\mu)=a-|\mu|,\qquad \frac{s(\tau)-s(-\tau)}{2\tau}=0,\\\lim_{\tau\to0^+}\frac{s(\tau)-s(0)}{\tau}=-1,\qquad \lim_{\tau\to0^+}\frac{s(0)-s(-\tau)}{\tau}=+1.\end{gathered}

中心差分为零，却既不是左导数也不是右导数；程序在相等时选左分支 d=a+μd=a+\mu，返回的线性化是 +1+1。有理对照把两个差 aa、bb 放进一个商，求导用商法则：

The central difference is zero, yet it is neither one-sided derivative; the program picks the left branch d=a+μd=a+\mu at the tie and returns the linearisation +1+1. The rational comparison puts the two differences aa, bb into one quotient, differentiated by the quotient rule:

sε=Na2+b2+ε2,N=ab(a+b),∂sε∂a=b(2a+b)(a2+b2+ε2)−2a⋅ab(a+b)(a2+b2+ε2)2,∂sε∂b=a(a+2b)(a2+b2+ε2)−2b⋅ab(a+b)(a2+b2+ε2)2.\begin{gathered}s_\varepsilon=\frac{N}{a^2+b^2+\varepsilon^2},\qquad N=ab(a+b),\\\frac{\partial s_\varepsilon}{\partial a}=\frac{b(2a+b)(a^2+b^2+\varepsilon^2)-2a\cdot ab(a+b)}{(a^2+b^2+\varepsilon^2)^2},\\\frac{\partial s_\varepsilon}{\partial b}=\frac{a(a+2b)(a^2+b^2+\varepsilon^2)-2b\cdot ab(a+b)}{(a^2+b^2+\varepsilon^2)^2}.\end{gathered}

在相等点 a=b=ma=b=m，两个偏导相同：(2m4+3m2ε2)/(2m2+ε2)2(2m^4+3m^2\varepsilon^2)/(2m^2+\varepsilon^2)^2，ε→0\varepsilon\to0 时趋于 12\tfrac12，也就是中心平均的导数。本页默认 ε=0.01\varepsilon=0.01、m=1m=1 时为 0.500020.50002。沿 D.1 的切片（两差为 a0+μa_0+\mu、a0−μa_0-\mu），dsε/dμ=∂asε−∂bsεds_\varepsilon/d\mu=\partial_as_\varepsilon-\partial_bs_\varepsilon 在 μ=0\mu=0 按对称性为零：有理函数没有尖点。minmod 在同一点的所选分支导数是 (∂a,∂b)=(1,0)(\partial_a,\partial_b)=(1,0)，与 (12,12)(\tfrac12,\tfrac12) 不同：两个模型在光滑单调区域也给出不同的线性化。

At the tie a=b=ma=b=m the two partials coincide: (2m4+3m2ε2)/(2m2+ε2)2(2m^4+3m^2\varepsilon^2)/(2m^2+\varepsilon^2)^2, which tends to 12\tfrac12, the derivative of the central average, as ε→0\varepsilon\to0. With this page's default ε=0.01\varepsilon=0.01 and m=1m=1 it equals 0.500020.50002. Along the slice of D.1 (differences a0+μa_0+\mu and a0−μa_0-\mu), dsε/dμ=∂asε−∂bsεds_\varepsilon/d\mu=\partial_as_\varepsilon-\partial_bs_\varepsilon vanishes at μ=0\mu=0 by symmetry: the rational function has no kink. The selected-branch derivative of minmod at the same point is (∂a,∂b)=(1,0)(\partial_a,\partial_b)=(1,0), not (12,12)(\tfrac12,\tfrac12): the two models linearise differently even in a smooth monotone region.

D.3 无激波稳态 Burgers：分支、矩阵和误差

D.3 Smooth steady Burgers: branches, matrices and errors

研究性探索 · 选读Research exploration · optional

在同一固定状态上比较真实线性残差、冻结导数偏差和 LU／GS／GMRES，是进阶验证教学。把这些结果归因于 limiter 光滑性，并建立对网格、参数、预处理都成立的收敛判据，则属于研究。实验同时涉及离散算子与预处理质量，应控制变量；有限迭代预算未收敛、迭代矩阵范数大于 1，都不能单独证明渐近发散。

Comparing true linear residuals, frozen-derivative bias and LU/GS/GMRES at the same state is advanced verification teaching. Attributing those results to limiter smoothness and establishing criteria across meshes, parameters and preconditioners is research. Both the discrete operator and preconditioner quality matter, so control the comparison. Failure within a finite iteration budget or an iteration-matrix norm above one alone does not prove asymptotic divergence.

(12u2−νux)x=s(x,a),u∗(x)=1+asin⁡(2π(x−0.07)),a=0.2.\left(\tfrac12u^2-\nu u_x\right)_x=s(x,a),\quad u_*(x)=1+a\sin(2\pi(x-0.07)),\quad a=0.2.

两端给定解析 Dirichlet 值，源项积分由解析通量端点差计算。每次参数扰动都同时改变源项和边界，但数值未知量仍由残差求解，未填入解析解。设计变量为振幅 a，目标 Q=hΣ(1+xi)ui。一阶与二阶使用相同 Rusanov 波速 2 和中心黏性通量；边界扩散距离为 h/2，首末单元不重构。

Both ends use analytic Dirichlet data; integrated sources are analytic physical-flux differences. Perturbations change sources and boundaries together, but unknowns are solved from residuals, never filled with the analytic profile. The design variable is amplitude a and Q=hΣ(1+xi)ui. Both orders use Rusanov speed 2 and centred viscous fluxes; boundary diffusion distances are h/2, with no endpoint-cell reconstruction.

U = sampled reference as an initial guess only
repeat until ||R(U,a)|| is small:
    J = exact selected-branch Jacobian
